scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
What a nice day, isn't it!
Welcome to Cat Merchant Group. We do anything to please our customers. We would even lie on our back if you want!
scripts.translation:
[传送猫]
今天天气真不错，对吧！
欢迎光临猫咪商会。我们竭诚为顾客服务，只要您愿意，我们甚至可以四脚朝天躺给您看！

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
We provide teleport service between various regions based on our accumulated knowledge. We accept Malangdo Canned Specialties or Zeny, so you can pay however you like it~
scripts.translation:
[传送猫]
我们凭借积累的知识，提供各地区之间的传送服务。费用可用绵绵岛罐头特产或Zeny支付，您喜欢哪种都可以哦~

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'll see you later then.
scripts.translation:
[传送猫]
那我先告辞了，回头见。

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'm afraid it's not enough. Sorry, but it can't be done for free~
scripts.translation:
[传送猫]
恐怕还不够呢。抱歉，不能免费帮您传送哦~

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'm afraid it's not enough. Sorry, but it can't be done for free~
scripts.translation:
[传送猫]
恐怕还不够呢。抱歉，不能免费帮您传送哦~

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please wait a minute.
All first-time visitors to Eclage must fill out the necessary forms before entering.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
请稍等片刻。
首次到访埃克拉珠的访客，都必须填写相关表格才能入城。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
All first-time visitors to Eclage must fill out the necessary forms here before entering.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
首次到访埃克拉珠的访客，都必须在这里填写相关表格才能入城。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Great, you completed the forms.
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
很好，表格填好了。
欢迎来到拉菲尼的首都——埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
欢迎来到拉菲尼的首都——埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please submit your forms to the administrator over there after writing in your name, occupation, and level.
There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
请填写姓名、职业和等级，然后把表格交给那边的管理员。
可能需要等一会儿，请耐心等待。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please understand because of a recent increase in the influx of people from Midgard through Bifrost, we had to create this process.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
最近经由彩虹桥从米德加尔特前来的人越来越多，我们才不得不设立这套手续，还请谅解。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Of course, the documents will be secured away after their use in access regulations, so you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
当然，表格用于入城管理后会妥善收存，请不必担心。

scripts.text: Fill out the forms.
scripts.translation: 填写表格

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 不填了

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please note that you would not be able to enter the city without filling out the forms.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
请注意，不填写表格就无法进入城市。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please fill out your name, occupation, and level here.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
请在这里填写您的姓名、职业和等级。

scripts.text: Write your name.
scripts.translation: 填写姓名

scripts.text: Write your occupation.
scripts.translation: 填写职业

scripts.text: Write your level.
scripts.translation: 填写等级

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
If you completed your forms, please submit them to the administrator over there.
There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
如果表格已经填好，请交给那边的管理员。
可能需要等一会儿，请耐心等待。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
埃克拉珠受到彩虹桥的影响，各个种族之间可以顺畅交流。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
There would be no need for any separate translation, and there are enough bridges for on-foot races, so I hope you have a comfortable visit.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
因此不需要另外安排翻译，而且这里也有足够的桥梁供步行的种族通行。祝您在此访问愉快。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
埃克拉珠受到彩虹桥的影响，各个种族之间可以顺畅交流。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
There would be no need for any separate translation, and there are enough bridges for on-foot races, so I hope you have a comfortable visit.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
因此不需要另外安排翻译，而且这里也有足够的桥梁供步行的种族通行。祝您在此访问愉快。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
There's still a lot of people before you. Could you please wait until your turn?
It won't be too long.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
您前面还有不少人，请等轮到您再过来。
不用等太久。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Whew! I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
There are just too many visitors.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
呼！抱歉让您久等了。
来访的人实在太多了。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Alright, next person in line please!
Next!
Next person!
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
好了，下一位请上前！
下一位！
下一位！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
What do you need?
As you can see, I'm really busy here, so unless you need something, please don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
有什么事？
您也看到了，我忙得不可开交。没什么事的话，请别来打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
{0} Here, your documents are processed.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
哇，真是忙翻天了。
{0}，您的手续已经办好了。
去和保安说一声，就可以进城了。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
So if you will place your forms here...
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
那么，请把表格放在这里...

scripts.text:
[???]
Here!! These are my completed forms!!
This time it's all good, right?
Let me through quick!
scripts.translation:
[???]
在这里！！这是我填好的表格！！
这次总没问题了吧？
快放我过去！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
I'm taking care of visitors in the order they arrived, so please wait for your turn.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
我会按来访者抵达的先后顺序办理，请耐心等候。

scripts.text:
[???]
What are you talking about!
I was waaaay before all of these guys!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你说什么呢！
我可比他们早到老半天了！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Well, your turn was delayed because you had to fill out your forms, so you have to wait until later.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
可是您得先填写表格，所以轮到您的时间往后延了，只能再等等。

scripts.text:
[???]
What?! You just said you take care of visitors in the order they arrived!!!
scripts.translation:
[???]
什么？！你刚才明明说按抵达顺序办理的！！！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Yes, I did say that but...
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
我是这么说了，不过...

scripts.text: - SMACK!!! -

[???]
OW!! Why did you hit me?
scripts.translation:
[???]
好痛！！你为什么打我？

scripts.text:
[???]
I'm so sorry.
My stupid friend here is causing trouble.
scripts.translation:
[???]
真是抱歉。
我这个笨蛋朋友又在给您添麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Who are you calling stupid?!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你说谁是笨蛋？！

scripts.text:
[???]
If you hadn't filled out my name incorrectly in the first place, we wouldn't be waiting like this!
scripts.translation:
[???]
要不是你一开始把我的名字填错，我们哪用在这儿等这么久！

scripts.text:
[???]
Mark Esha or Madrid, they're all the same!
scripts.translation:
[???]
马克·艾沙也好，马德里也好，不都差不多嘛！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
They're not at all the same!
And what's more, how can you not know the name of your friend of 15 years?
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
哪里一样了！
再说，你怎么会连认识了十五年的朋友叫什么都不知道？

scripts.text:
[???]
It's not that I didn't know- I did it on purpose!!
Madrid is just fine! Madrid!
scripts.translation:
[???]
我不是不知道——我就是故意的！！
马德里就挺好！马德里！

scripts.text: - SMACK -

[Mark Esha]
Hu... I am so sorry that my friend is this stupid.
Please don't mind us and do what you need to do.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
呜...真抱歉，我这朋友实在太蠢了。
请别介意我们，您忙您的吧。

scripts.text:
[???]
AHHHH!!!
LET ME IN!!!!
How long do I have to wait out here!!!
scripts.translation:
[???]
啊啊啊！！！
放我进去！！！！
我还要在外面等多久啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Would you stay put just for a second?!!!
Sorry. So sorry.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
你就不能安分一会儿吗？！！！
抱歉，实在抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
{0} Here, your documents are processed.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
哇，真是忙翻天了。
{0}，您的手续已经办好了。
去和保安说一声，就可以进城了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Shuffle, shuffle
scripts.translation:
[???]
挪啊挪，挪啊挪

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
And Mr. Deu Lean, please take your group and enter. It's just way too noisy.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
杜连先生，也请带上您的同伴进城吧。这里吵得实在受不了了。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Mwahah!!
SEE THAT?!
Thanks to me, we got through faster!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哇哈哈！！
看见了吧？！
多亏了我，我们才能这么快通过！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
You mean slower...
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
你是说更慢吧...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
A real man does not get bogged down by the past!!
I may have been slow with the documentation but I will be the one to enter Eclage first!
Mwahah!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
真正的男子汉才不会纠结过去！！
办手续时我虽然慢了点，但我可是第一个进埃克拉珠的人！
哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
......Whew
I'm so sorry for everything.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
...呼
这一切真是抱歉。

scripts.text:
[???]
Well......
Mr. Mark, Mr. Du is already gone.
scripts.translation:
[???]
那个...
马克先生，杜先生已经走了。

[马克·艾沙]
哦...
哦...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
My goodness......
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
天哪...

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Ack...
I don't think it's all for the best to have so many visitors.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
唉...
访客这么多，看来也不全是好事。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I can't believe I have to wait this long......
When is it going to be my turn?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
真不敢相信要等这么久...
到底什么时候才轮到我？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm actually done with my documentation, but I'm just sticking around to appreciate all of these flowers.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我的手续其实已经办好了，只是想留下来欣赏这些花。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm just getting through the night with my sleeping bag!
It's alright as long as you can withstand the security guard's annoyance with you.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我带了睡袋，干脆就在这里过夜！
只要受得了保安的白眼，倒也没什么。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I wonder how beautiful of a city Eclage would be.
It just makes my heart beat thinking about it.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
埃克拉珠到底是座多么美丽的城市呢？
光是想想就让我心跳加速。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
No, I'm not a visitor. I'm an Eclage citizen!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
不，我不是游客。我是埃克拉珠的居民！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I can't believe I can't even enter because of all these tourists!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
真不敢相信游客这么多，害得我连家都进不去！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I hear their acorns are delicious without a hint of bitterness.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
听说那里的橡果很好吃，一点苦味都没有。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
You could probably make the world's best acorn jello.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
说不定能做出全世界最好吃的橡果凉粉。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's important to keep your belongings light when traveling.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
旅行时，行李还是轻便些好。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's going to increase as you go along anyways.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
反正走得越远，行李只会越变越多。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Perhaps you could consider it as the weight of life?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
或许可以把它当成人生的重量吧？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Cool cool.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
不错，不错。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Snorrrreee....Erhem....
scripts.translation:
[游客]
呼噜噜噜...咳嗯...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Err.... No.....
Curry.... Curry rice.... Snorrreeeee
scripts.translation:
[游客]
呃...不要...
咖喱...咖喱饭...呼噜噜噜...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh! Are you also from Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
哦！你也是从米德加尔特来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's encouraging to see so many Midgard people nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
最近能看到这么多米德加尔特人，真让人振奋。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ow.... My legs...
You're saying I have to wait after all this traveling through Bifrost?!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
哎哟...我的腿...
一路穿过彩虹桥来到这里，居然还得继续等？！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ahh...
Why are there so many people...?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
唉...
人怎么这么多啊...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I want to be alone......Sniff!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我只想一个人待着...（抽泣）

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hey!!!!!!!
Be careful over there!!
scripts.translation:
[妖精工匠]
喂！！！！！！
那边小心！！

scripts.text: - The bridge is broken. There should be some kind of a solution. -
scripts.translation: - 桥断了，应该有办法可以修好。 -

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Wait!!!!!
That's an unregistered visitor!!!!!!!
Security!!! Security!!!
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
等等！！！！！
那位访客还没登记！！！！！！！
保安！！保安！！

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Did you talk to the security guard before coming into the city?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
进城前你有和保安谈过吗？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
The bridge is kind of broken so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
桥有些损坏，请小心。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
This area is kind of broken, so be careful.
Otherwise, you'll fall aaaaaall the way down.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
这附近有些地方坏了，小心点。
不然会一路摔到底的。

scripts.text: The work being done right now
scripts.translation: 目前的工程

scripts.text: The reason for the bridge being broken
scripts.translation: 桥梁损坏的原因

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
As you can see, I'm doing some carpentry work.
There are more visitors to Eclage nowadays, so I'm primarily working on building bridges.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
如你所见，我正在做木工。
最近来埃克拉珠的访客多了起来，所以我主要负责修建桥梁。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Oh, just a minute ago, there was a human being who took a misstep and broke a tree branch while falling.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哦，就在刚才，有个人类一脚踩空，摔下来时撞断了一根树枝。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
修好之前你没法从这里通过，请多加小心。

scripts.text: [Fairy Carpenter]
scripts.translation: [妖精木匠]

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
In fact, Laphines can fly around so bridges are technically not necessary, but we are building them since there are many visitors who have been getting hurt by falling while climbing trees.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
拉菲尼族会飞，所以严格来说并不需要桥。不过，许多访客爬树时会摔伤，我们才修建这些桥。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Being close to the entrance and all, this really needs to be fixed soon.
I'm trying to decide whether I should put up a warning sign, gather the necessary materials for repair, or call a friend to help.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
这里离入口很近，得尽快修好。
我正琢磨着该立警告牌、收集维修材料，还是叫朋友来帮忙。

scripts.text: Give help.
scripts.translation: 帮忙

scripts.text: Don't give help.
scripts.translation: 不帮忙

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
修好之前你没法从这里通过，请多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Wow!!!
You are going to help me?!
So... so kind...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哇！！！
你愿意帮我？！
你...你人真好...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
I can't believe there's still this kind of kindness left in the world... Hmm, sweaty eyes...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
真没想到，这世上还有这么善良的人...呜，我都感动得眼眶湿了...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Would you then bring me a new bridge to use for repair?
Since other people can get hurt, I'll use my magic to maintain this bridge in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
那能麻烦你带一段新的桥材来吗？
为了不让其他人受伤，我会先用魔法稳住这座桥。

scripts.text: What if you use magic to repair it?
scripts.translation: 用魔法修好不行吗？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm, it's not impossible, but magic that deals with creation of life requires much magic power and shouldn't be used so freely.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嗯，也不是办不到。不过，创造生命的魔法需要消耗大量魔力，不能随便使用。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If I were to describe how stupid that would be... Well, it's like turning a deliciously baked chocolate cake back into flour.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
要说这有多蠢...就像把烤好的巧克力蛋糕重新变回面粉。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Since the broken part is about 19 meters from here...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
断掉的地方离这里大约有19米...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Ahh! Now that I remember, before we used to be able to order the exact necessary length, but because they are mass-producing them nowadays, they only provide preset lengths.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
啊！我想起来了，以前可以按需要订做特定长度的桥材。不过现在都改成批量生产，只能买到固定长度的了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
To maximize the stability, it's better to avoid connecting multiple bridge pieces together,
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
为了让桥尽可能稳固，最好不要把多段桥材拼接起来。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
and this broken bridge... from here to there it's about 19 meters and the prepieces come in 3 meters = 5 meters, and 10 meters......
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
这座断桥从这里到那边大约有19米，而预制桥材有3米、5米和10米三种长度...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm.......
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm......
......

[Fairy Carpenter]
......Hmm.........
- It's probably just my imagination that smoke is coming out of his head, right? -
scripts.translation: - 他头上好像在冒烟？大概是我看错了吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Oh ho!
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哦！
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
To make a bridge of 19 meters in length with the fewest number of pieces possible, how many of each 3, 5, or 10 meter length pieces would I need?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
要用最少的桥材搭出一座19米长的桥，3米、5米和10米的桥材各要几段？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Please write the number of pieces necessary for each length. If no pieces for that length are necessary, please write 0.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
请填写每种长度所需的桥材段数。不需要的长度请填0。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm that's kind of....
Would there be a better way?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嗯，这个嘛...
有没有更好的办法？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Yeah, that sounds good, right?
Especially since there wouldn't be a need to make them so straight.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
对，这主意不错吧？
这样也不用把桥材削得那么笔直了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Okay, if you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
好，去找在城外高塔附近工作的戈利。他会给你新的桥材。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
去找在城外高塔附近工作的戈利，他会给你新的桥材。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
去找在城外高塔附近工作的戈利，他会给你新的桥材。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Oh man, he's still worried about that kind of thing.
He's too serious for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
哎，他居然还在操心那种事。
真是想太多了。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Whoa! This isn't the time to be doing this. I should repair the bridge quickly and help out all the people who fell through.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
糟了！现在可不是做这个的时候。我得赶快把桥修好，去帮那些掉下去的人。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Ah!
Thank goodness!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
啊！
太好了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I would have been toast if it weren't for that tree branch.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
要不是那根树枝接住了我，我可就完蛋了。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I told you to be careful!
Exactly how much trouble do you want to cause?
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
我叫你小心点了！
你到底还想惹多少麻烦？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
...

[Du Lian]
No way!
They're those guys from earlier!
Oy!
I thought I got rid of them, but it looks like they aren't going to be that easy.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
不会吧！
是刚才那帮人！
喂！
我还以为已经甩掉他们了，看来没那么容易啊。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I'm sorry.
We just have not been our best ever since we met.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
抱歉。
自从遇见我们以后，你就一直没遇上什么好事。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Well, I'm going to let it pass this time around, but if you break the bridge again, I'm going to put you in jail!
You should know that I am pretty busy myself.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
这次就算了。要是你们再把桥弄断，我就把你们关起来！
我自己也忙得很，别忘了。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I'm sorry.
I'll take special caution, so please don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
抱歉，我会格外小心，请放心。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But for a bridge to break so easily after running a bit, isn't it just too weak?
Giants couldn't even visit Eclage in this wa...
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
不过，跑了几步桥就断了，也太不结实了吧？
这样一来，巨人岂不是根本没法来埃克拉珠了...

scripts.text: - SNAP -
scripts.translation: - 咔嚓 -

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
......

[Mark Esha]
Oh dear....
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Uh oh...
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
糟了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wait! No, it's really a mistake this time!
Look!
Even this warning sign tells you that you have to grab onto the hand rails since the bridge is so dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
等等！不，这次真的不是故意的！
你看！
警告牌上都写着桥很危险，要抓紧扶手。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
All I did was just place my hand on it!
I really didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
我只是把手搭上去而已！
我真的什么也没做！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
......

[Carpenter Fon]
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
唉...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Get out of here you troublemaker!!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
捣蛋鬼，给我滚出去！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I am so sorry.
I will come by to help out later even if it's by tying this guy up to a pole.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
实在抱歉。
我晚些会来帮忙，哪怕得先把这家伙绑在柱子上。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Don't come back!
Don't EVER come back!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
别再回来！
永远都别回来！！！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Oy........
I thought today I might be able to see my friends after finishing up my work.....
Looks like a long night again.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
唉...
我还以为今天忙完就能去见朋友...
看来今晚又得熬夜了。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Since it's not a big fix, I'm sure I can take care of this somehow.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
这不是什么大工程，我想办法应该能修好。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
{0} Well, you should get going to Eclage.
You just need to follow this path to the northern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
{0}，好了，你该去埃克拉珠了。
沿着这条路往前走，就能到城北。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
You'll find the main plaza as soon as you enter Eclage, and I'm sure you'll have easy time getting information from all the people there.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
进城后就是中央广场，那里的人应该能告诉你不少消息。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
And on your way, do you mind letting my friend Glasses that I won't make it today?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
顺路帮我转告朋友格拉西斯一声，就说我今天去不了了，可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
But where are the materials.
I need to start repairing soon...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
可是材料呢？
我得赶快开始维修了...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I really ask you this favor because I'm supposed to meet with my friends to discuss a birthday coming up, but I can't just keep them waiting.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
我本来约好和朋友们见面，商量即将到来的生日，可眼下实在走不开。真要拜托你帮忙了，不能让他们一直等。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
And on your way, do you mind letting my friend Glasses that I won't make it today?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
顺路帮我转告朋友格拉西斯一声，就说我今天去不了了，可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I really ask you this favor because I'm supposed to meet with my friends to discuss a birthday coming up, but I can't just keep them waiting.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
我本来约好和朋友们见面，商量即将到来的生日，可眼下实在走不开。真要拜托你帮忙了，不能让他们一直等。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I wanna see my friends real soon.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
真想早点见到朋友们啊。

scripts.text:
- Stop here !! -
- There are just too many types that -
- you cannot receive the item. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请停下！！ -
- 物品种类太多， -
- 无法接收该物品。 -
- 请先减轻负重， -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Golie]
They say that life is nature's greatest invention and death is just a scheme to obtain more life.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
常有人说，生命是大自然最伟大的发明，而死亡不过是孕育更多生命的一种安排。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
好了，可以把这个交给丰了。最近大家都很忙，还是麻烦你顺便转告他：请好好珍惜这些桥材。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
To grow Elder Willow trees,
since Spring, Peco Peco
must have cried as such.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
长老树精要生长，
从春天起，大嘴鸟便开始如此啼鸣。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
You lost the materials?
I will give you another since you are busy, but please take care.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
材料弄丢了吗？
看你这么忙，我再给你一份，不过这次可要收好了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
However, how about these sprouts that were born by magic- do they have life or not?
Would a bridge born by magic be considered dead or not?
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
不过，这些由魔法催生的嫩芽究竟算不算有生命？
魔法造出的桥，究竟算死物还是活物？

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Because I spend so much time nurturing a bridge from a seed, it hurts me to see so many getting broken and replaced.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
我花了那么多心血，从种子开始培育这些桥。看到它们一再损坏、被替换，实在令人心痛。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Would this be how the times are changing...? That must be why I am creating these objects of tragic destinies.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
这就是时代变迁吗...？也许我创造的这些东西，注定要承受这样的命运。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
This seed is named [Goliath] after my name, and it's a plant used as a bridge for its strange ability to grow into two stems and one leaf.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
这颗种子以我的名字命名为“戈利亚斯”。它会长出两根茎和一片叶子，形状奇特，因此被用作桥梁。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Thanks to Goliath, the dire need for bridges has been resolved, but I cannot shake the concern that one day, there are going to be fearsome consequences for utilizing magic to ignore the rules of nature.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
多亏了戈利亚斯，桥梁短缺的问题总算解决了。但我仍担心，有一天，滥用魔法、违背自然法则会酿成可怕后果。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
I am recently finding encouragement bit by bit as I work with the great Fili who stands next to me here, but one day, I assure you that all of this will be fixed.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
最近我和身旁这位了不起的菲利一起工作，渐渐又有了干劲。不过我向你保证，总有一天这一切都会得到解决。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Whenever you are disheartened and discouraged, try approaching Fili with your concerns. You will probably find new insights. 
And... Mm... the bridge was done while we were just jibber-jabbering.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
若你感到灰心沮丧，不妨找菲利谈谈，也许会有新的收获。
还有...嗯...我们聊着聊着，桥已经修好了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
好了，现在可以把这个交给丰了。还有，虽然知道最近大家都很忙，能不能顺便替我转告他：请好好珍惜它们？

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
最近我一直忙着帮菲利做事，不过桥梁似乎也坏得太频繁了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
最近我一直忙着帮菲利做事，不过桥梁似乎也坏得太频繁了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
To grow Elder Willow trees
the alarm in the clock tower
again must have cried as such.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
长老树精要生长，钟楼里的钟怪
想必又如此啼鸣。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
It's a song given to me by a bard from Midgard. The lyrical and nature-oriented words really resonated with me.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
这首歌是米德加尔特的一位吟游诗人送给我的。歌词既有韵律又贴近自然，让我很有共鸣。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
I would love to hear any songs that you might know also.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
你若也会唱什么歌，我很乐意听听。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hm......
The guys are late.
I can only imagine that they would be busy just looking at the number of people visiting Eclage nowadays but...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...
那几个人迟到了。
最近来埃克拉珠的访客这么多，他们大概忙得不可开交吧，不过...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm...
The guys are late.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...
那几个人迟到了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I can't leave this place since others might arrive, so if you see a fairy with a yellow, tangerine-stem-like head, please tell him Glaces is looking for him.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
唉，我不能离开这里，免得其他人来了找不到我。要是你看到一个头上长着黄色橘梗般东西的妖精，麻烦告诉他格拉西斯在找他。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh...
Moreng's age?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦...
莫伦的年龄？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
How dare you ask a lady's age!!!
We aren't exactly the same age, but since Murah is also 30 years apart from Moreng, ask Murah.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
你怎么敢问女士的年龄！！！
我们的年龄不完全一样，不过穆拉和莫伦也相差30岁，你去问穆拉吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Mm.. Something's missing... Mm, I couldn't tell you exactly...
You should go see Yube.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...好像还少了点什么...我也说不清楚。
你去找尤贝看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Whoa!
We would need an enormous cake to fit all these candles...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哇！
这么多蜡烛，得准备一个超大的蛋糕才插得下...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are those guys? They even took Yube with them?!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
那些人是谁？他们竟然把尤贝也带走了？！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
I wonder what's better, cream or chocolate...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
奶油和巧克力，到底哪个更好呢...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
I wonder what's better, cream or chocolate?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
奶油和巧克力，到底哪个更好呢？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
If he really seems like he might leave soon, we should grab him before he leaves and at least throw him a farewell party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
要是他真的快走了，我们得赶在他离开前拦住他，至少给他办场欢送会。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
It's going to feel really empty if Moreng leaves for Midgard.
It felt like this when Yube was dispatched to the Splendide unit before...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
要是莫伦去了米德加尔特，这里一定会变得冷清。
以前尤贝被派去辉煌领域时，我也有过这种感觉...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Shul lives in the eastern part of the city.
I'm guessing he's near his place?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
舒尔住在城东。
他应该就在家附近吧？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Tato is in the western part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
塔托在城西。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
A king lives in Eclage.
He is super good looking.
Hehe
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
埃克拉珠住着一位国王。
他可帅了。
嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
To think of it, I should probably visit Fon and Golie as well...
I guess I'll visit later.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
说起来，我好像也该去看看丰和戈利...
改天再去吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Why... why do I have so much time at hand...?
Am I the only one with so much free time?
Am I really the only one?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
为什么...我怎么这么闲？
难道只有我一个人这么清闲？
真的只有我吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me?

[Glaces]
Yes?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Ah...
Oh...Well...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
啊...
哦...那个...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Um... This is sort of awkward for me...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...这让我有点难为情...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that's not what I mean...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我不是那个意思...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm...
You see, I have a boyfriend already.
Man.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...
那个，我已经有男朋友了。
哎呀。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
This is why I don't like to be kept waiting for long. My popularity just doesn't let me go anywhere without being noticed.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
所以我不喜欢等太久。毕竟我太受欢迎了，走到哪儿都有人注意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I mean... Mr. Fon told me to let you know that he won't be able to make it because of his work...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，我是说...丰先生让我转告你，他工作忙，今天来不了了...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh, I see.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Yeah, I feel like I should hide somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
是啊，我觉得我该找个地方躲起来。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Anyways, Fon can't make it?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
总之，丰来不了了？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Moreng's birthday is not long from now, and without being able to meet all this time, it might turn out to be a terrible party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
莫伦的生日快到了，大家却一直碰不上面，这样下去生日派对恐怕会办砸。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Yube even flew here from Splendide for Moreng's birthday...
Speaking of which, where did that guy go?!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
尤贝甚至为了莫伦的生日从辉煌领域飞了过来...
说起来，那家伙跑哪儿去了？！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
He was the one who suggested that we should meet at his own place.
The least he could do is opening the door before disappearing!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
明明是他提议在自己家碰面的。
他就算要消失，也该先把门打开吧！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I can't leave this place since others might arrive, so if you see a fairy with a yellow, tangerine-stem-like head, please tell him Glaces is looking for him.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
唉，我不能离开这里，免得其他人来了找不到我。要是你看到一个头上长着黄色、像橘梗一样东西的妖精，麻烦告诉他格拉西斯在找他。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
And also please tell him that if he doesn't get back right away, I will pluck off that stem.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
还有，告诉他再不马上回来，我就把那根梗拔掉。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Great!!!
That
favor!
I will take care of it!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
太好了！！！
这个忙
就交给我吧！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Hey! I told you not to interfere in other people's conversations!
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
喂！我不是叫你别插手别人的谈话吗！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What are you talking about?
It's the job of a warrior to go wherever help is needed!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
你说什么呢？
哪里需要帮忙，战士就该出现在哪里！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
And you!
There must be some kind of destiny here running into you over and over again!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
还有你！
我们一次又一次碰上，肯定是命运安排的！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Okay!
I made up my mind!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
好！
我决定了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I don't usually recognize others like this, but I'll let you be my rival!
And as for the competition-!!
It is to help this girl fairy Graces!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
我可不轻易认可别人，不过这次就让你当我的对手吧！
至于比什么——！！
就比谁能帮到这位妖精格拉西斯！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are you calling a girl? You got my name wrong too!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
谁是姑娘啊？还有，你连我的名字都叫错了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Heh heh, don't you worry, baby girl.
I'll take care of you!!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嘿嘿，别担心，小姑娘。
一切包在我身上！！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Well!
I'm off to find that tangerine stem!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
好！
我这就去找那个橘梗头！！！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
And also please tell him that if he doesn't get back right away, I will pluck off that stem.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
还有，告诉他再不马上回来，我就把那根梗拔掉。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm... I think we are apart by about 30 years...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...我们大概差了30岁吧...

scripts.text: Then what's Glaces' age?
scripts.translation: 那格拉西斯几岁？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
How dare you ask a lady's age!!!
We aren't exactly the same age, but since Murah is also 30 years apart from Moreng, ask Murah.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
你怎么敢问女士的年龄！！！
我们的年龄不完全一样，不过穆拉和莫伦也相差30岁，你去问穆拉吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Murah is probably at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
穆拉应该在埃克拉珠广场。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Murah is probably at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
穆拉大概在埃克拉珠广场。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm... Since everyone seems so busy, I'm going to give up meeting them today and just go to bake a cake big enough to fit the candles.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...大家好像都很忙，今天就不去找他们了。我还是去烤个能插下所有蜡烛的大蛋糕吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
沿着这条路走就是莫伦家。顺便问问他生日想要什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Baby girl!
I brought the guy named Yube!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
小姑娘！
我把那个叫尤贝的家伙带来了！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
What, who is this fool?
Let me go!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
喂，这家伙是谁？
快放开我！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Do you mind not treating my friend like a piece of luggage?
And it's too late anyways!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
能不能别把我朋友当行李一样扛着？
而且现在也太迟了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What?!
But there are two of them!
I have the disadvantage!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
什么？！
可是他们有两个人！
这下我吃亏了！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
There are four of us.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
我们有四个人。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What do you mean?
We had that kid following us ever since we entered the city.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
你说什么？
从我们进城起，就一直有个小孩跟着我们。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Sure, he's kind of cute too, but we have our cutest Maggi to beat them all!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
没错，他是挺可爱的，不过我们还有最可爱的玛姬，绝对不会输给他们！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
...
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
...

scripts.text:
[???]
Can you see me?
scripts.translation:
[???]
你看得见我吗？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What are you saying?
Your clothes stick out like a sore thumb.
Where are you from really?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
你在说什么？
你的衣服显眼得不得了。
你到底是从哪儿来的？

scripts.text:
[???]
Ey~~
I thought you weren't able to see me but I guess not?
scripts.translation:
[???]
咦~~
我还以为你们看不见我呢，看来不是啊？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
How could I not see you?
Unless you were cloaking yourself like our Alp here!
Maybe it's because he is a Guillotine Cross, but he just seems so transparent even without using any skills.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
我怎么会看不见你？
除非你像阿尔普那样隐身了！
可能因为他是十字斩首者吧，就算不用技能，他也跟透明人一样没存在感。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Maybe it's because he doesn't have much presence to begin with.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
也许他本来就没什么存在感。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Now that I think about it, I think I saw you somewhere...
Where was it?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
这么说来，我好像在哪儿见过你...
到底是在哪里呢？

scripts.text:
[???]
Eh...
It's been awhile since I had such a vivid dream...
scripts.translation:
[???]
呃...
好久没做过这么逼真的梦了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wahahahahah!
A dream!
Hey Mark, this guy thinks it's a dream!
How adorable!
Can we take him around?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哇哈哈哈哈！
做梦？
嘿，马克，这家伙以为自己在做梦！
真可爱！
我们把他带着到处逛逛怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
What are you saying?!
Don't touch whoever you want like that!
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
你在说什么？！
别想对谁动手就动手！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Eeek~ I don't like this.
Besides, I'm not a kid or a child!
I have a great name called Oliver!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
哎呀~我不喜欢这样。
而且我不是小孩！
我有个很棒的名字，叫奥利弗！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I have been rejected straight up.
To put him next to our Maggi would be just downright adorable.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
我居然被当面拒绝了。
把他和我们的玛姬放在一起，一定可爱极了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm.
Wait, but don't you have something to give me?
You did earlier.
Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯。
等等，你们不是有东西要给我吗？
刚才还在的。
去哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Now that I am rejected!
Off to find Moreng!
I won't lose this time for sure!
Let us begin!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
既然被拒绝了！
那就去找莫伦！
这次我绝不会输！
我们走！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are those guys?They even took Yube with them!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
那些人是谁？竟然把尤贝也带走了！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I'm sure Yube will take care of himself.
Anyways...
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...尤贝应该能照顾好自己。
总之...
莫伦家就在这条路上，麻烦问问他生日想要什么礼物。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well... I'm sure Yube will take care of himself.
Anyways...
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...尤贝应该能照顾好自己。
总之...
莫伦家就在这条路上，麻烦问问他生日想要什么礼物。

scripts.text: - She seems really busy making the cake. Let's not bother her. -
scripts.translation: - 她正忙着做蛋糕，还是别打扰她了。 -

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh you're back.
Did you ask Moreng what he wants?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦，你回来了。
问到莫伦想要什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Huh!!!
The legend of the great bird?!
It's been close to a hundred years since I've known Moreng, and he's never talked about it before!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
什么！！！
巨鸟的传说？！
我认识莫伦快一百年了，他以前从没提过这件事！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
If he really seems like he might leave soon, we should grab him before he leaves and at least throw him a farewell party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
要是他真的快走了，我们就得赶在他离开前拦住他，至少给他办场欢送会。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
So sudden...
I'm going to try to talk with Moreng, so would you ask Yube for me?
He went inside to look for something, so I'm sure he's still inside.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
太突然了...
我想去和莫伦谈谈，你能替我问问尤贝吗？
他进去找东西了，应该还在里面。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
So sudden...
I'm going to try to talk with Moreng, so would you ask Yube for me?
He went inside to look for something, so I'm sure he's still inside.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
太突然了...
我想去和莫伦谈谈，你能替我问问尤贝吗？
他进去找东西了，应该还在里面。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I should first decide on what present to get him!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯，我得先决定送他什么礼物！

scripts.text:
- Shuffle shuffle -
He's working on something.
Let's not bother him.
scripts.translation:
- 沙沙，沙沙 -
他正在忙着做什么。
还是别打扰他了。

scripts.text: - Shuffle shuffle -
scripts.translation: - 沙沙，沙沙 -

scripts.text: - It looks like the fairy that Glaces was talking about. -
scripts.translation: - 看起来像是格拉西斯说的那个妖精。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whoa!
Who are you?!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
哇！
你是谁？！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whoa! Who's this? It's
{0}?
You seem more like a Warlock now!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
哇！这是谁？是
{0}？
你现在看起来倒更像大魔导士了！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I'm glad to see you at a place like this.
What's going on anyways?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
没想到会在这里见到你，真高兴。
对了，到底发生什么事了？

scripts.text: Share Glaces' story.
scripts.translation: 告诉尤贝格拉西斯的事

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I told her I'll be looking for materials to make candles with, but as expected, she wasn't listening.
She always loses her mind looking at herself through a mirror.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
我跟她说我要去找做蜡烛的材料，她果然没听进去。
她总是对着镜子欣赏自己，看得入迷。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, how old is Moreng now?
I think he was younger than me, but I'm not remembering it very well...
Would you mind asking Glaces about his age for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
对了，莫伦现在多大了？
我记得他比我小，不过记不太清了...
能帮我问问格拉西斯他的年龄吗？

scripts.text:
- Stop here !! -
- You have too many items -
- in your inventory right now. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请停下！！ -
- 你的物品栏已经满了， -
- 无法领取物品。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Oh!
You gathered enough already?
I also made enough wicks just in time!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
哦！
材料已经收集够了吗？
我也刚好做好了足够的烛芯！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
先把灰尘团捏成这样，再像这样插上烛芯！
大功告成！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
全都做好了！
请把蜡烛拿给格拉西斯。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
And also...
To return the favor, I'll let you use my house!
You can stay over whenever you want as long as you are in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
还有...
为了报答你，我把房子借给你住！
只要你人在埃克拉珠，随时都可以来。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I work at Splendide for the most part anyways, so I don't come to Eclage very often.
Alright, thanks a lot~
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
反正我大多时间都在辉煌领域工作，很少回埃克拉珠。
好了，多谢你啦～

scripts.text:
[Yube]
If you aren't too busy, could you bring me a clump of dust to make some candles with?
I have to make as many candles as Moreng's age, so if you could bring me that much clump of dust, that would be good.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
你要是不忙，能帮我带些灰尘团来做蜡烛吗？
蜡烛的数量得和莫伦的年龄一样，所以麻烦你带够数量的灰尘团。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Huh?!
So no one knows how old Moreng is?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
什么？！
所以谁都不知道莫伦几岁吗？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
先把灰尘团捏成这样，再像这样插上烛芯！
大功告成！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Wha.. You lost the candles?
I still have some wicks left, so if you bring me the clump of dust again, I'll remake them for ya.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
什么...蜡烛弄丢了？
我还剩些烛芯，你再带些灰尘团来，我就重新做给你。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, how old is Moreng now?
I think he was younger than me, but I'm not remembering it very well...
Would you mind asking Glaces about his age for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
对了，莫伦现在多大了？
我记得他比我小，不过记不太清了...
能帮我问问格拉西斯他的年龄吗？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Murah? Murah is at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
穆拉？她在埃克拉珠广场。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Shul? Shul is probably at the eastern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
舒尔？他大概在城东。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Tato? Tato is in the western part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
塔托？他在城西。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Have you ever been to Jotunheim?
There are amazing giants that live there!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
你去过约顿海姆吗？
那里住着很了不起的巨人！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm, at least to summarize what everyone has said...
He's younger than me; 30 years age gap wtih both Glaces and Murah but Glaces and Murah are not the same age,
Shul's age is to add Moreng's age to my age of 100 years before; Shul is 2 years older than Glaces; the average age of me and Shul is Tato and Tato's age is 146, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
嗯，我把大家说的线索整理一下...
莫伦比我小；他和格拉西斯、穆拉都相差30岁，但格拉西斯和穆拉并不同岁。
舒尔现在的年龄，等于莫伦的年龄加上我100年前的年龄；舒尔比格拉西斯大2岁；塔托的年龄是我和舒尔的平均数，而塔托是146岁。这样对吗？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
...
Then how old is he?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
...
那么，他到底几岁？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Yes!
That's right!
Now I remember!!!
I think that's what it was!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
对！
没错！
我想起来了！！！
应该就是这样！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm~ I don't think so.
Think harder.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
嗯～我觉得不对。
再仔细想想。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm that means I still have to make more than a hundred candles...
Oy......
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
嗯，这么说我还得做一百多支蜡烛...
唉...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
If you aren't too busy, could you bring me a clump of dust to make some candles with?
I have to make as many candles as Moreng's age, so if you could bring me that much clump of dust, that would be good.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
你要是不忙，能帮我带些灰尘团来做蜡烛吗？
蜡烛的数量得和莫伦的年龄一样，所以麻烦你带够数量的灰尘团。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
全都做好了！
请把蜡烛拿给格拉西斯。

scripts.text: Make the candles.
scripts.translation: 做蜡烛

scripts.text: Don't make the candles.
scripts.translation: 不做蜡烛

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Really?
If you need more, just let me know~
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
真的不做吗？
还需要的话，随时告诉我~

scripts.text:
- The weight is just too much that -
- you cannot receive the item. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 负重太重， -
- 无法领取物品。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I can make as many as 128. How many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
我最多能做128支。你要做几支？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
先把灰尘团捏成这样，再像这样插上烛芯！
大功告成！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
You aren't going to make them?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
你不打算做吗？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Mmm...
To make that much, I would probably need more clumps of dust...
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
嗯...
要做那么多的话，恐怕还得再找些灰尘团...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
Don't lose them again~~~
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
都做好了！
请把蜡烛交给格拉西斯。
这次可别再弄丢了哦~~~

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Moreng's age?
I don't know it exactly...
Maybe Shul might know?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
莫伦的年龄？
我不太确定...
也许舒尔知道？

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Shul's house is at the east end of the city, so he should be around there.
In any case, isn't it crazy how they were friends even before I was born?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
舒尔家在城东边，他应该就在那附近。
说起来，他们居然在我出生前就是朋友了，真不可思议。

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Hmm... What amazing present should I give?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
嗯...送什么特别的礼物好呢？

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Moreng, Yube, and Shul got to know each other a hundred years ago, and I remember that at that time, their age difference was pretty large that adding Moreng's and Yube's age equaled to that of Shul.
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
莫伦、尤贝和舒尔是在一百年前认识的。我记得那时他们年纪相差很大，莫伦和尤贝的年龄加起来正好等于舒尔的年龄。

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Shul's house is at the east end of the city, so he should be around there.
In any case, isn't it crazy how they were friends even before I was born?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
舒尔家在城东边，他应该就在那附近。
说起来，他们居然在我出生前就是朋友了，真不可思议。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Moreng's age?
Hmm...
It's been awhile since I kept track of everyone's age.
I just remember that Glaces was two years younger than me.
scripts.translation:
[舒尔]
莫伦的年龄？
嗯...
我已经很久没记大家的年龄了。
只记得格拉西斯比我小两岁。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Tato lives in the western part of the town, so try asking him there.
scripts.translation:
[舒尔]
塔托住在城西，去那边问问他吧。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Laphine's put their lives on the line to make Yai beautiful.
I'm a Laphine myself but that kind of priority is difficult to understand.
scripts.translation:
[舒尔]
拉菲尼族为了让雅伊更美，不惜冒着生命危险。
我也是拉菲尼族，却不太能理解这种取舍。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Come to think of it, not too long ago, Tato said that his age was the same as the average between my age and Yube's age.
Maybe Tato would remember it?
scripts.translation:
[舒尔]
说起来，前阵子塔托说过，他的年龄正好是我和尤贝年龄的平均数。
也许塔托还记得？

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Tato lives in the western part of the town, so try asking him there.
scripts.translation:
[舒尔]
塔托住在城西，去那边问问他吧。

scripts.text:
[Tato]
Moreng's age?
It hasn't been very long since I got to know him, so I don't know his age very well.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
莫伦的年龄？
我认识他还没多久，不太清楚他的岁数。

scripts.text:
[Tato]
But why is it that they don't know their own age either?!
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
不过，他们怎么连自己的年龄都不知道？！

scripts.text: What's Tato's age?
scripts.translation: 塔托几岁？

scripts.text:
[Tato]
I am 146 years old.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
我今年146岁。

scripts.text: - Although the exact information regarding Moreng's age is still unknown, let's return to Yube first.
scripts.translation: - 还不知道莫伦的确切年龄，先回去找尤贝吧。 -

scripts.text: - Although the exact information regarding Moreng's age is still unknown, let's return to Yube first.
scripts.translation: - 还不知道莫伦的确切年龄，先回去找尤贝吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Tato]
A friend of mine recently applied to the Splendide unit.
I heard Jotunheim is really cold. I hope he's doing well.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
我有个朋友最近申请加入辉煌领域部队。
听说约顿海姆非常冷，希望他一切都好。

scripts.text:
Eclage is a really nice place to live
The flowers are always in full bloom and the weather is always comfortable.
scripts.translation:
埃克拉珠真是个宜居的好地方。
鲜花常开，天气也总是舒适宜人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
If there were a beautiful Yai of my own, it would truly be a paradise!
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
要是我也有一座漂亮的雅伊，那就真是天堂了！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Yai actually signifies an egg.
And to Laphines, Yai could even signify what is beyond a home...
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
雅伊其实是“蛋”的意思。
对拉菲尼族来说，雅伊甚至代表着比家更重要的东西...

scripts.text:
Eclage is a really nice place to live
The flowers are always in full bloom and the weather is always comfortable.
scripts.translation:
埃克拉珠真是个适合居住的地方。
花儿总是盛开，天气也总是舒适宜人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
If there were a beautiful Yai of my own, it would truly be a paradise!
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
要是我也有一座美丽的雅伊，那就真是天堂了！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh, so you call those round houses a Yai.
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
哦，原来你们把那些圆房子称为雅伊啊。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Yai actually signifies an egg.
And to Laphines, Yai could even signify what is beyond a home...
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
雅伊其实是“蛋”的意思。
对拉菲尼族来说，雅伊甚至代表着比家更重要的东西...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
While I spent time and effort as much as putting my life into it, my Yai is nothing more than a fake.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
我倾注了许多心血，甚至为此赌上性命，可我的雅伊终究只是赝品。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
It's called an egg and looks like an egg, but it's really not an egg!
It's just something else that just looks like an egg!
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
它叫蛋，看起来也像蛋，但其实根本不是蛋！
只是某种长得像蛋的东西！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Hey, wait a minute!
Are you possibly from Midgard?!
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
嘿，等一下！
你难道是来自米德加尔特吗？！

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是

scripts.text: No, I am not.
scripts.translation: 不，我不是

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
I see...
You sure looked like it, but I guess not.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
原来如此...
你看起来的确很像，不过看来不是。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Ah, great!
Then would you happen to know anything about the legend that speaks of a great bird which lives in Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
啊，太好了！
那你是否听说过关于米德加尔特有一只巨鸟的传说？

scripts.text:
I heard a little from various travelers.
According to rumors, there is a legend of a great bird in Midgard that lays an egg as big as a house.
scripts.translation:
我从各地旅行者那里听到了一些消息。
据说米德加尔特有一只巨鸟，它下的蛋有房子那么大。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wow, if it's an egg as big as a house, how many days would it take to eat it all?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哇，如果蛋有房子那么大，吃完它得花多少天啊？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
......

[Moreng]
When I first heard of that legend, I was so excited that I couldn't sleep for days.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
第一次听说那个传说时，我兴奋得好几天睡不着。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
But as time went by, and as I aged more, I gradually forgot about it.
Isn't that how all childhood dreams are like?
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
可随着时间流逝，我渐渐长大，也慢慢把它忘了。
童年的梦想不都是这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
But not too long ago when I went to the plaza, I met my old neighbor who told me about a traveler from Midgard holding an incredibly enormous feather...
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
不过前阵子我去广场时，碰到一位老邻居。他说有个来自米德加尔特的旅行者，手里拿着一根大得惊人的羽毛...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Ever since I heard about it, I can't seem to put my mind on anything else.
Could that legend possibly be true?
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
自从听说这件事，我就再也没法专心做别的事了。
那个传说会不会是真的？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Truthfully, when I heard that story, I went searching all over the town but couldn't find anyone with a huge feather.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
说实话，听到这个故事后，我找遍了整座城，却没找到任何拿着巨大羽毛的人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
你觉得那位老人的故事是真的吗？还是在说谎？
我原以为那只是个被遗忘的传说，如今却害怕知道它究竟是真是假。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
If you are a real man, don't be so meek!
Face it head on! And if you must, you can crash and burn afterwards!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
真正的男子汉就别畏畏缩缩！
勇敢面对！就算最后碰得头破血流也认了！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Don't crash and burn anything...
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
别把什么东西撞得头破血流...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
For something like that-!
I'll be the one to ask the old man and let you know!
And if the legend sounds fake, I won't tell you so don't you worry!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
这点小事——！
我去问那个老人，再回来告诉你！
要是传说听起来是假的，我就不告诉你，放心吧！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Sometimes you should really remind yourself what it means to say 'ignorance is bliss.'
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
有时候你真该想想“无知是福”这句话是什么意思。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Regardless, I didn't hear anything about that legend either.
Although, for a typical Laphine, something that's insignificant to us could be considered really huge...
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
不管怎么说，我也没听过那个传说。
不过，对普通拉菲尼族来说，我们觉得微不足道的东西，或许已经算很大了...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
But since the land of Midgard is truly far and wide, there may be legends we haven't heard of...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
不过米德加尔特如此辽阔，说不定还有我们没听说过的传说...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Yes, it looks like there are no other ways than to meet the old man!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
没错，看来只能去找那位老人问问了！

scripts.text:
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
你觉得那位老人的故事是真的吗？还是在说谎？
我原以为那只是个被遗忘的传说，如今却害怕知道它究竟是真是假。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Yes, it looks like there are no other ways than to meet the old man!
Let's go to the plaza!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
没错，看来只能去找那位老人了！
我们去广场吧！

scripts.text:
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
你觉得那位老人的故事是真的吗？还是在说谎？
我原以为那只是个被遗忘的传说，如今却害怕知道它究竟是真是假。

scripts.text:
Is that for real?
I can't believe the legend was true...
scripts.translation:
那是真的吗？
我简直不敢相信这个传说竟然是真的...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
What can I say?
I feel like I can't just stay here anymore.
I have to quickly pack my bags and leave for Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
我还能说什么呢？
看来我不能再继续待在这里了。
得赶紧收拾行李，出发去米德加尔特！

scripts.text: - Moreng seems like he's really about to leave soon. I should let Glaces know. -
scripts.translation: - 莫伦看起来真的很快就要离开了。我得告诉格拉西斯。 -

scripts.text: I plan to leave for Midgard as soon as my birthday-farewell party with my friends is over.
scripts.translation: 等和朋友们办完生日兼送别派对，我就马上动身去米德加尔特。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
I would miss my friends for sure, but I should return that much quicker.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
我一定会想念朋友们，不过我会尽快回来的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hohoho
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Ooo~ So you changed your mind?
Ok then, I will tell you about the story that Light Standard told only me, about which he met a gold monster in the deep Midgard mountains that eats gems!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦～你改变主意了？
好吧，我就告诉你那个只有“光之标准”告诉过我的故事：他曾在米德加尔特深山遇到一只吃宝石的金色魔物！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hohoho~!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Looks like there are a lot of interesting visitors nowadays...
When I was young, you had to put your life on the line to go into the foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
最近来了不少有趣的访客啊...
我年轻时，要去异国旅行可是得冒着生命危险。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Nowadays, things are way more convenient with de-regulation and all.
And with the warps and flying to all these places, where's all the romance in adventures anymore?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
如今放宽管制后，出行方便多了。
再加上传送和飞行，想去哪儿就去哪儿，冒险也没了当年的浪漫。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Young people nowadays probably don't even know how frog eggs taste like.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
现在的年轻人大概连青蛙卵是什么味道都不知道吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It seems like yesterday when I saved enough Jellopies to buy a Tsurugi, but even that Tsurugi is deserted somewhere in the storage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
攒够杰勒比结晶买日本刀，仿佛还是昨天的事。可那把刀如今也被丢在仓库某个角落了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Time really is merciless... If I had known this then, I would have...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
时间真是无情啊...早知道当年会这样，我就...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hey! Have you heard of a Laphine hero named Light Standard?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嘿！你听说过一位叫“光之标准”的拉菲尼英雄吗？

scripts.text: No, I don't think so.
scripts.translation: 不，我没听说过

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 听说过

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
He's a hero from so long ago that this generation wouldn't even know who he is.
He is probably long forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...
他是很久以前的英雄，这一代人恐怕都不知道他是谁。他大概早就被遗忘了...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
It's surprising how a young person like you would know of him.
I thought he would be long forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...
没想到你这么年轻，竟然也知道他。
我还以为他早就被遗忘了...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
With a small physique, he was not even a high-level Laphine, but he fought against and defeated incredible monsters.
The word legend seemed to have been made for him.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他身材矮小，甚至不是高阶拉菲尼，却能与强大的魔物交战并将其击败。
“传奇”一词仿佛就是为他而生。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
His heroic accounts were so famous that kids would sing of them in the streets.
But as Ragnarok passed and peace was found, he suddenly retired.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他的英雄事迹广为人知，孩子们甚至会在街头传唱。
可仙境传说结束、和平降临后，他却突然隐退了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
And he was quickly forgotten...
He had great strength, superb intelligence, and strong, wonderful comrades, but he wasn't perfect....
scripts.translation:
[老人]
没多久，他就被人遗忘了...
他力量强大、头脑聪明，还有一群出色的伙伴，但他并非完美无缺...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Do you know what he was missing?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你知道他缺少什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It was a 'friend' like me.
If only if he had reliable and big-hearted friends...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他缺的是像我这样的“朋友”。
要是他当年有几个可靠又宽厚的朋友就好了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But old man, would you happen to know anything about a legend regarding the great bird in Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
老人家，您知道米德加尔特巨鸟的传说吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh!
You mean the legend of the great bird of Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦！
你说的是米德加尔特巨鸟的传说？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
For that, there's probably no one who knows it better than I in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
在埃克拉珠，恐怕没人比我更了解这个传说了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, it wasn't too long after Light Standard arrived in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
那是在光之标准来到米德加尔特后不久。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
He said he traveled in many adventures for a long time before coming to Midgard, but it was his first time seeing such a massive bird.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他说，来到米德加尔特之前，他经历过许多冒险，但从没见过那么巨大的鸟。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I also honestly did not believe that there would be such a big bird.
That is, until I ran into a traveler with an immense feather at the town's entrance during my walk.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
说实话，我原来也不相信世上会有那么大的鸟。
直到有天散步时，我在城镇入口遇见一位旅行者，手里拿着一根巨大的羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
As soon as I saw that feather, I began to believe all that Light Standard told me.
For example, a clump of dust that was wearing a cone hat in Jotunheim...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
一看到那根羽毛，我就开始相信光之标准说的话了。
例如，他在约顿海姆遇到过一团戴着尖帽子的灰尘...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm...
Earlier Moreng said he hasn't seen them in the city yet, so maybe he's still outside?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嗯...
刚才莫伦说还没在城里见到它们，也许它们还在城外？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Let's get to it then!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
那我们这就出发！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huh? But I haven't even begun to talk about a monster he met in Midgard who can break any kind of metal!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
咦？可我还没讲到他在米德加尔特遇到的那只魔物呢！那家伙能击碎任何金属！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
We will hear about it later~
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
以后再听嘛~

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Um...
Du already ran off...
If we let him be, I wonder what kind of trouble he'll create next.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
那个...
杜已经跑远了...
要是不管他，真不知道他接下来又会闯出什么祸。

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
To get to the city's entrance, we have to get through the bridge that Du broke, but I wonder if it has been fixed.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
要去城门口，得经过杜弄坏的那座桥。不知道现在修好了没有。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Looks like there are a lot of interesting visitors nowadays...
When I was young, you had to put your life on the line to go into the foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
最近来了不少有趣的访客啊...
我年轻时，要去异国旅行可是得冒着生命危险。

scripts.text:
Old Man#ep14_2
Nowadays, things are much more convenient with de-regulation and all.
And with the warps and flying to all these places, where's all the romance in adventures anymore?
scripts.translation:
老人#ep14_2
如今放宽管制后，出行方便多了。
再加上传送和飞行，想去哪儿就去哪儿，冒险也没了当年的浪漫。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Young people nowadays probably don't even know how frog eggs taste like.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
现在的年轻人大概连青蛙卵是什么味道都不知道吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It seems like yesterday when I saved enough Jellopies to buy a Tsurugi, but even that Tsurugi is deserted somewhere in storage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
攒够杰勒比结晶买日本刀，仿佛还是昨天的事。可那把刀如今也被丢在仓库某个角落了。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Who are you?
I've never seen you before.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
你们是谁？
我以前没见过你们。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hey you guys, you can get into Eclage, right?
There is a cat sack merchant who's doing business in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
嘿，你们能进埃克拉珠吧？
广场上有个卖猫包的商人。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Oh dear, my money...
I can't believe it was a fake...
Oy oy....
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哎呀，我的钱...
竟然是假的...
真倒霉...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Oh, you came to ask me about the feather, too?
It's just a plain old decoration, but everyone really likes to bother me about it.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哦，你们也是来问羽毛的？
那不过是普通的装饰品，大家却老来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
If you are thinking about selling it, you should just give up.
I have no wishes to sell it no matter how much you beg.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
想买的话就别费心了。
不管你们怎么求，我都不会卖。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
This feather.
It's not an ordinary feather.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
这根羽毛...
可不是普通羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Heh...
Well, it's actually too recent to even brag about...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
呵...
不过这事发生得太近，实在没什么好炫耀的...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
It's just luck that I ran into it not too long after I arrived in Alfheim.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我刚到艾尔海姆不久就遇上了它，只能说是运气好。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
It was so amazing. When it flapped its colossal wings, I couldn't even gather myself to attack because I was too busy just holding on.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那场面真是壮观。它扇动巨大的翅膀时，我光顾着抓稳自己，根本腾不出手攻击。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
But I am not one to give up so easily.
If I think about it, it was a very long fight.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
不过我可不会轻易认输。
回想起来，那场战斗持续了很久。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
That's weird. The old man earlier said that he saw it in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
奇怪了，刚才那位老人说是在米德加尔特看到它的。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Eck!
No... No way.
I definitely saw it at Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
咦！
不...不可能。
我明明是在米德加尔特看到它的。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I didn't want to show you this, but this scar is the proof.
It was truly a life-threatening battle.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我本来不想给你们看，不过这道伤疤就是证据。
那真是一场生死之战。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Hmm...
For a fight not too long ago, the scar seems very old.
From how the scar looks, it doesn't even seem like it's been treated by magic...
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
嗯...
既然战斗发生在不久前，这道伤疤看着却很旧。
而且看起来也不像受过魔法治疗...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Eeck!!!!
If... If I really think about, it might be awhile back actually.
I can't remember too well having so many memoirs and souvenirs.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
咦！！！！
仔细想想...可能确实是很久以前的事了。
我经历过太多事，也收了太多纪念品，记不太清了。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
But how did you travel to other places when you can't even enter Eclage?
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
可是你连埃克拉珠都进不去，是怎么去其他地方的？

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
If it came near here somewhere, there's no way others haven't seen it...
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
如果它曾在这附近出现过，不可能没人看见...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Keeeek!!!!
Yes!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
呃！！！！
好吧！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Actually, this isn't my first time here, but I had the opportunity to go to other places during when deregulation was at its peak awhile back.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
其实我不是第一次来，只是在前些年管制最宽松的时候，才有机会去过其他地方。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Hmm... But this feather...
If I look at it very closely, the shaft is too thick for its size
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
嗯...不过这根羽毛...
仔细看，它的羽轴和羽毛的大小比起来太粗了。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
And doesn't the end of it seem really jagged?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
而且末端看起来也很参差不齐，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Really?!
Wait! Let me see!!!!
Oh my, that's really true!
How dare that cat sell me a fake?!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
真的吗？！
等等！让我看看！！！！
天哪，真的有问题！
那只猫竟敢卖假货给我？！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Oh.... You bought it, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哦...这是买来的吧？

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
You bought it, right?
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
这是买来的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Hmm... Even so, I guess this is a great piece of work. It really seems like the real thing.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
嗯...即便如此，做得还真不错，简直跟真的一样。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hu....
You have no idea how expensive this was!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
唉...
你们根本不知道我花了多少钱！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hey you guys, you can get into Eclage, right?
There is a cat merchant who's doing business in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
嘿，你们能进埃克拉珠吧？
广场上有个猫商人在做生意。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That guy just stole my money and...
Hmm...
Please catch the cat before others also lose their money!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那家伙骗了我的钱，还...
嗯...
趁别人也被骗之前，快把那只猫抓起来！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
At least hold him until I can get into Eclage!
I ask you!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
至少先帮我拦住那只猫，等我进了埃克拉珠再说！
拜托了！
求求你们！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That guy just stole my money and...
Hmm...
Please catch the cat before others also lose their money!
scripts.translation:

I ask you!
Please!
scripts.translation:

至少先帮我拦住那只猫，等我进了埃克拉珠再说！
拜托了！
求求你们！

scripts.translation:

哦，你也是来打听羽毛的？
那不过是个普通的装饰品，大家却总拿这事来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
If you are thinking about selling it, you should just give up.
I have no wishes to sell it no matter how much you beg.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
想买的话就省省吧。
不管你们怎么求，我都不会卖。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
This feather..
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
这根羽毛...

scripts.text:

Meow?
Helloeow~
I have a treasure from a place very, very fareow~
Take a lookeow~
I'll give you a good priceow~
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵？
你好喵~
我这里有从非常非常远的地方带来的宝贝喵~
快来看看喵~
给你算个好价钱喵~

scripts.text: Talk about the feather.
scripts.translation: 打听羽毛的事

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
That's not trueow~!
I'm seriouseow~!
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
才不是那样喵~！
我说真的喵~！

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
That's definitely a precious item from Midgardeow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
那绝对是来自米德加尔特的珍贵宝物喵。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
This end of the feather here is not very convincing...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
这根羽毛的末端看起来不太像真的...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Meoweoweow!!!
I...I can't believe you noticedeow...Pretty sharpeow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵呜呜！！！
没、没想到被你发现了喵...眼光真尖喵...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Actually...
The feather is real for sure, but I modified just a tinyyy~tiny biteow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
其实...
羽毛本身绝对是真的，只是被我稍微、稍微加工了一点喵...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Because the feather was too big to carry around, I thought that I could cut it up into pieces and sell it to many moreow. But when I cut it, it was a bit weird so I just adjusted it, you seeow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
羽毛太大，不方便携带。我本想把它切成小块卖给更多人喵。可切开后总觉得有点奇怪，就稍微修饰了一下喵。

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
This is just a cut piece?
Then how big was the real thing?
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
这只是切下来的一小块？
那原来的羽毛到底有多大？

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Hmm..
It was from here to thereow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
嗯...
大概有从这里到那边那么长喵。

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
I couldn't possibly carry something that bigeow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
那么大的东西，我怎么可能搬得动喵...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Whoa whoa!
If it's that big, you could probably make a fried egg with the size of this plaza!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哇！
要真有那么大，煎出来的蛋恐怕比整个广场还大吧！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
That's probably too much...
Anyways, that was important to know, so we better let Moreng know.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
这也太夸张了...
总之，我们得到了重要线索，最好赶快告诉莫伦。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Anyways, that was important to know, so we better let Moreng know.
scripts.translation:

总之，我们得到了重要线索，最好赶快告诉莫伦。

快来看看喵~
给你算个好价钱喵~

scripts.text: - Looks like the door is locked. -
scripts.translation: - 门好像锁着。 -

scripts.text: - Something seems a bit different. -
scripts.translation: - 这里好像有些不对劲。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm, the legend of a great bird?
I think there was one, but since I don't believe in myths, I didn't pay much attention.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
嗯，巨鸟的传说？
好像是听过，不过我不相信神话，所以没怎么留意。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whew...
Done...
The ones I took last time couldn't be used because of a mistake, and I was scolded so much for that...
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
呼...
总算弄好了...
上次拿来的东西出了差错，没法使用，我因此挨了好一顿骂...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Now that I'm done with work that Master wanted, I should get going to help out with the party.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
师父交代的工作已经做完了，我该去帮忙准备派对了。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
How did you get in here?
Uninvited guests are not very welcome, you know?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
你是怎么进来的？
不请自来的客人可不怎么受欢迎哦。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Make yourself at home.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
请随意。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
You didn't tell Glaces?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
你没告诉格拉西斯吗？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I guess if you look at Glaces' Yai...
When I first saw the crack, I was reminded of Glace's Yai.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
说起来...看到那道裂痕时，我想起了格拉西斯的雅伊。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, finding the great bird's egg firsthand is probably better than receiving it as a gift, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
不管怎么说，亲自找到巨鸟的蛋，应该比收到别人送的礼物更好吧？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Ok, I should hurry with the party preparations.
I'll send whatever is urgent to Splendide first...
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
好了，我得赶紧准备派对。
先把急用的东西送去辉煌领域...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
It's always exciting to place seeds in a box...
One mistake can lead to immense consequences.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
把种子放进盒子时，总让人兴奋不已...
稍有差错，后果就会很严重。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Please give me a minute since this is a critical process.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
这一步很关键，请稍等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Ok, if you don't mind, could you take this to a delivery man at the plaza?
Master kindly sent me a delivery man specifically for this...
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
那能麻烦你把这个送到广场的送货员那里吗？
师父特意派了送货员来帮忙...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Maybe it's an underlying statement that I would be eliminated if it's not sent right away...
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
也许师父是在暗示我：要是不马上送出去，我就要遭殃了...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I will be on my way so I'll catch you later~
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
我这就出发，回头见~

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Be safe now~
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
路上小心哦~

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm, now what do we do?
Hey Mark, do we have some kind of schedule or whatever?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嗯，现在做什么好呢？
喂，马克，我们有行程安排之类的吗？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Aren't you even a bit tired after all that?
Let's rest up a bit.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
忙了这么久，你都不累吗？
先休息一会儿吧。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Hmm...
I'm hungry.
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
嗯...
我饿了。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Acorns!
I saw many acorns just outside the city!
I want them!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
橡果！
我刚才在城外看到好多橡果！
我想吃！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Acorns?!
Are they any good?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
橡果？！
好吃吗？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Alright then, shall we get some acorns?
I'll bring a bunch back!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
那我们去摘些橡果吧？
我会带一大堆回来！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Hey hey hey!
I told you not to pull on my cheeks!!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
喂喂喂！
我说过别捏我的脸！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Seriously, you just don't get tired huh...
Ok, I'm going to rest here with the others, so do what you need to do.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
真是的，你怎么一点都不累...
好吧，我和大家在这里休息，你去忙你的吧。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Greeeeat!
Let's go!{0}!

太棒了！
走吧，{0}！

Thanks!

哇，看起来好好吃的橡果！
谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Yawnnn... so sleepy...
I'm going to take a nap, so wake me up when we're leaving... Don't leave without me now~
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]

我要睡一会儿，出发时记得叫醒我...别丢下我先走哦～

scripts.translation:

很好吃。

Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]

我吃饱了。
呃...

scripts.text:

Oliver, eat more.

scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
可是我好困。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[送货员]
唉...
得赶紧出发，才能按时送到。

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
The road from Splendide to Eclage used to be dangerous, but nowadays, it's actually better to come all the way to Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[送货员]
以前从辉煌领域到埃克拉珠的路很危险，不过现在直接送到埃克拉珠反而更方便。

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
I don't know why people can't just make small amounts of pickled Poring for themselves instead of mailing them...
scripts.translation:
[送货员]
大家为什么不自己腌一点波利，非要寄过来呢...

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
Wait a minute...
Is it actually better to deliver it later...
I remember seeing so many boxes of pickled Poring in the storage waiting to be delivered...
scripts.translation:
[送货员]
等等...
晚点送说不定更好...
我记得仓库里堆了好多箱腌波利，都还等着寄出去呢...

scripts.text:
- Stop here !! -
- The weight is just too much that -
- you cannot receive the item. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请停下！！ -
- 负重太重， -
- 无法领取物品。 -
- 请减轻负重， -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm... Where did he go...?
Could he be... a ghost?!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嗯...他去哪儿了？
难道...是幽灵？！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
I didn't sense any use of magic or other things of the sort...
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
我没感觉到有使用魔法之类的迹象...

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Wait! Here's the hood that Oliver was wearing...
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
等等！这是奥利弗戴过的兜帽...

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
And... doesn't it feel like this room is different from before?
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
而且...你们不觉得这个房间跟刚才不一样了吗？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hey stop that!!
It's scaring me!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
喂，别闹了！！
吓死我了！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Arrrrr~~
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
啊啊啊~~

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Oh!!! I just remembered...
Oliver...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
哦！！！我想起来了...
奥利弗...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
...
Oliver Hilpert...
.........is also known as the dreaming novelist...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
...
奥利弗·希尔佩特...
...也就是那位“梦境小说家”...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
And this book...
Why didn't I remember this book when Oliver was around?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
还有这本书...
奥利弗在的时候，我怎么没想起这本书？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hey...
Did you just take that book out from your bag?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
喂...
你刚才是从包里拿出那本书的吗？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Yeah, that's because I'm a fan...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
嗯，因为我是他的粉丝...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Why didn't you remember the book when you are such a fan..?
Not only that, do people usually carry books with them when they're fans?? Especially hardcover books?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
既然是粉丝，怎么之前没想起这本书？
再说，粉丝会随身带着书吗？还是这么厚的精装书？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
......
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
You are a little bit weir...
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
你这人有点奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
More importantly... The title of this book...
is [The City of Fairies]?
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
先不说这个...这本书的书名是...
《妖精之城》？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
And...
It's been many years since this book was published...
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
而且...
这本书已经出版很多年了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
...This is getting kind of scary...?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
...这事怎么有点吓人？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
......
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
...

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
......
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
......
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But this is Volume 1. Does that mean there's more?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
但这是第一卷。难道还有后续？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
It has a total of 3 volumes.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
一共有三卷。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wow, how many are you carrying with you...
Why are you bringing all of them around...
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哇，你到底带了几本...
干嘛把它们全都随身带着...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Everybody calm down!!!
This has to be some kind of a dream!
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
大家冷静！！！
这一定是在做什么梦！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Why are you hitting me, calling it a dream and all!
It hurts!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
你说这是梦还打我干嘛！
好痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Ahhhh maybe it really isn't a dream after all!!!
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
啊啊啊，看来真的不是梦！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
...A...A...Aaaaahhhhhhhhh!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
...啊...啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Don't cry, Maggi~
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
玛姬，别哭~

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
I wonder...
Why didn't I remember this...?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
我在想...
我怎么会没想起这件事？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
I... I should have.. I should have gotten his autograph!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
我...我应该...应该找他签名才对！！！

scripts.text:
- Stop Here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- You cannot carry any more items. -
- Lighten your load and -
- try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请停下！！ -
- 你的物品太多了。 -
- 已经无法再携带物品。 -
- 请减轻负重， -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I haven't seen your face before... You aren't from around here?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我没见过你...你不是本地人吧？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
{0} - Hello, what brings you here?
I thought you were busy...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
{0}——你好，怎么有空过来？
我还以为你正忙着呢...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Have you met my brother yet?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你见过我哥哥了吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh, {0} Have you met my brother yet? How is he doing?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
哦，{0}，你见过我哥哥了吗？他还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh man, even the people we found are so apathetic... What could I possibly do now...?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
唉，连找到的人都这么冷淡...我现在还能怎么办呢？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What happened? Did you find out anything?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
怎么了？有查到什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I'm still in the process of looking through the report. It's very complex, so I'll need more time.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我还在看这份报告。内容很复杂，还得再花些时间。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Great, you got here at the right time.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
太好了，你来得正是时候。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
{0} Are you going to help me?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
{0}，你愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Did you find that high-level Laphine?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你找到那位高阶拉菲尼了吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Did you bring all the ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你把所有材料都带齐了吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ah... Is there anyone with more experience with this...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
唉...有没有人在这方面更有经验呢...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
The research is still ongoing. If I had a thread of hope, I would hang on it, but I can't seem to find it just yet.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
研究还在继续。哪怕只有一线希望，我也会抓住不放，可目前还没找到...

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [乌哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
If you are a person who has enough courage and wisdom to go to a foreign land all alone, I'm sure you have a lot of experience as well.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你有胆识和智慧，能独自去异国闯荡，想必也有丰富的阅历。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I would like to learn the name of a great adventurer like you, so that I can talk about you elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我想知道你这位大冒险家的名字，这样也能向别人聊起你的事迹。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}.

[Wuhari]
Wow! The name sure sounds like it has defeated many in the mountains, seas, and skies! It's amazing!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
哇！一听这名字，就知道你在山川海空间击败过不少强敌！太厉害了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's not much.
I am not really all that great.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没什么了不起的。
我也没那么厉害。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Um... {0} I ask because you look so dependable.
Could I please ask you a favor?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
那个...{0}，我看你很可靠，才想冒昧问一句。
能不能请你帮个忙？

scripts.text: I'm kind of busy right now...
scripts.translation: 我现在有点忙...

scripts.text: Of course!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really? Oh well...
