scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
是吗？那好吧...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
抱歉打扰您了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really?
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
真的吗？
太感谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
For me, I have a ^0000cd big brother^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我有一个^0000cd哥哥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
My brother is... not an extremely well-known scholar.
Although his fame lost a bit of flare these recent years because he was stuck at home getting too fond of housework.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我哥哥...算不上特别有名的学者。
这几年他总待在家里忙家务，名气也淡了不少。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's been long since the last time I saw his face because I was all over the place for a while.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
之前我到处奔波，已经很久没见过他了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I don't mean to brag, but I am also a distinguished intellectual myself, so I'm sought after by many, haha.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我不是自夸，我自己也是个出色的学者，所以总有人来找我，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Anyways, we wrote letters to each other regularly, but with a sudden drop in contact, I hurriedly came to see him to find out that ^0000cdhe was taken to jail^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我们一直定期通信，可后来联系突然中断了。我急忙去找他，才发现^0000cd他被关进了监狱^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
They said something about his research but I don't know the details myself. I would like to find out more, but I am not in a situation to make my way there.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
他们只说和他的研究有关，具体情况我也不清楚。我想打听更多，可眼下没法亲自过去。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
{0} would you mind ^0000cdvisiting my big brother in my place^000000 to find out what's going on and let me know?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
{0}，能不能替我^0000cd去探望哥哥^000000，查清楚发生了什么再告诉我？

scripts.text: I would like to help you but...
scripts.translation: 我想帮你，不过...

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I would really lke to help you, but...
Yeah, I would like to help, but...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我真的很想帮你...
可是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't really express my desire to help any other way...
But, I'm really sorry. I can't.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也不知道该怎么表达我想帮忙的心情...
但实在抱歉，我做不到。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh, no, no. I am sure you are really busy. I'm sorry to have asked such a favor.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
没关系，我知道你一定很忙。抱歉还拜托你做这种事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure. It's not a big deal.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然，小事一桩。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really? Thank you so much.
It seems that a person with so much experience like you has a wonderful heart as well.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
真的吗？太感谢你了。
像你这样经验丰富的人，心地也这么好。

scripts.text: I wanted to help you.
scripts.translation: 我想帮您

scripts.text: Just because.
scripts.translation: 只是顺手而已

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was just wondering how things are coming along.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是想问问事情进展得怎么样了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Nothing... Nothing really happened yet...
I can't do anything in my own strength... Nothing at all...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
没什么...事情还没有进展...
光靠我自己什么也做不了...真的什么都做不了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I just couldn't pass by without doing something about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是觉得不能袖手旁观。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Does that mean you would meet up with my brother?
Thank you so much!!!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你愿意去见我哥哥吗？
太感谢你了！！！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
The prison is inside the palace, but to find it, it might be a bit difficult.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
监狱就在宫殿里，不过可能不太好找。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
By the way, my brother ^0000cddoesn't talk very well to strangers.^000000
He's typically very shy and introverted.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
对了，我哥哥^0000cd不太会和陌生人交谈^000000。
他平时很害羞，也很内向。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
So you might have to be a bit patient with him. Please give this ^0000cdletter^000000 to him.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
跟他谈话时请多点耐心。麻烦把这封^0000cd信^000000交给他。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Well, you must have a long way to go, so please be on your way.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你还得赶很远的路，快出发吧。

scripts.text: I lost the letter.
scripts.translation: 我把信弄丢了

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 还没准备好

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Um... {0} It looks like what you have in your coat is my letter...?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
那个...{0}，你衣服里露出来的好像是我的信？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Sure, I'll write you another one {0}. Compared to the trouble you have to go through, this is not a problem at all.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
当然，我再给你写一封，{0}。比起你要费的工夫，这点事不算什么。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I know I'm the one asking a favor, but could you please hurry?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
虽然是我拜托你的，但还是想请你尽快一些。

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [乌哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I am really concerned about him.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我实在很担心他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your brother seems to be doing well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你弟弟看起来挺好的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Compared to how he was when I first met him, he surprisingly had... lots to say...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
和我第一次见到他时相比，他居然...说了好多话。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yeah... He's pretty talkative, isn't he?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
是啊...他确实挺健谈的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What did he say?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
他说了些什么？

scripts.text: - Wuhari is told about Wuhuru -
scripts.translation: - 乌哈里听说了乌胡鲁的事 -

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Why did he do such a thing...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
他为什么要这么做...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Well, I guess he always had a negative self-image of his physical self.
He thought that he would be able to do anything if he was big and beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
他一直对自己的体格很自卑。
他觉得只要自己长得高大又好看，就什么都能办到。

scripts.text: Do you have any complaints?
scripts.translation: 你有什么不满吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
No, I don't have any complaints at all.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不，我完全没有不满。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
He always told me that since we are disadvantaged physically, we need to at least be smart and taught me very diligently.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
他总说我们身体条件不如别人，至少要靠头脑取胜，还很用心地教我。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
For that, I am now able to support myself well, and my relationship with him is really strong.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
多亏了他，我现在能照顾好自己，和他的感情也一直很好。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
And since my physique is so small, many people adore me even when I age.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
而且我个子小，年纪再大也有不少人喜欢我。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thanks to that, many gave us lots of good things to eat, heh heh.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
所以有很多人送我们好吃的，呵呵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your brother asked me to figure out a way for him to recover his body.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你弟弟请我想办法帮他恢复原来的身体。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yes, that's not even a question. We need to not only recover his body but also rescue him from imprisonment.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
那是当然的。我们不只要帮他恢复身体，还得把他从监狱里救出来。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
With regards to that, I actually have another ^0000cdfavor^000000 to ask.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
说到这件事，我还想再拜托你一件事：^0000cd帮个忙^000000。

scripts.text: I would like to, but...
scripts.translation: 我愿意帮忙，不过...

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yes, of course, you would be very busy. I am grateful for even letting me know about my brother.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
当然，我知道你很忙。你愿意把我弟弟的消息带来，我已经很感激了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
非常感谢！

scripts.text: Well, I can help you.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我可以帮你

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh dear~ Is there anyone who can help~~ This world is so ruthless~
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
哎呀~有人能帮帮我吗~~这世道真是冷酷无情啊~

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Will you really?
Are you doing this because I look so sad?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你真的愿意帮我？
是看我这么难过才答应的吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Whatever it is, I thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不管怎样，真的太感谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
First, if we were to figure out how to recover his body, we have to know exactly what happened at that moment.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
首先，要想找到恢复他身体的方法，就必须弄清楚当时究竟发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It would be helpful to know on what basis he carried out his research. But, I don't really know despite listening to his story.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
要是能知道他当初依据什么进行研究就好了。可听完他的说法，我还是不太明白。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It looks like we don't have ways to figure that out right now. To explore it on my own, it just seems too difficult...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
看来现在没办法查清楚。要我一个人调查，实在太难了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It is probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople who may be familiar with what happened then^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
最好去问问^0000cd可能了解当时情况的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Please, I ask you. In the meantime, I'll carefully think about what my brother has said.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
拜托你了。我会趁这段时间仔细想想哥哥说过的话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm still looking into things.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我还在继续调查。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I see... I ask you, please take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我知道了...这件事就拜托你了。

scripts.text: They told me to give this to you.
scripts.translation: 他们让我把这个交给你

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
This is... ^0000cda research report^000000. My brother, he must have seen this and...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
这是...^0000cd一份研究报告^000000。弟弟一定是看了这个，才...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Umm... What is it that you brought?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
那个...你带来的是什么？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But hmm... this is... Were there any other reports?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不过，嗯...这是...还有别的报告吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that was the only one I was given.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有，他们只交给我这一份。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh... That's too bad...
Well, I'll have to analyze this in more depth. I would need some ^0000cdtime^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
哦...真遗憾...
看来我得仔细研究一番，需要一些^0000cd时间^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh! What the...!?
Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦！怎么回事！？
东西去哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I must have dropped it on the way here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我一定是来的路上把它弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll bring it to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会再拿给你。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I looked into this report, but I still don't really understand what it is telling.
The ingredients are written here but they were difficult to gather and the application methods are a bit hard to understand...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我看过这份报告，还是不太明白它的内容。
上面列了所需材料，可材料很难收集，使用方法也不容易看懂...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Why would they use a piece of a high-level Laphine's wings and hair from a Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
为什么要用高阶拉菲尼的翅膀碎片和萨法的毛发？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's not only difficult to obtain them, but the ways you would have to obtain them are brutal...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
这些材料不但难找，取得它们的手段也很残酷...

scripts.text: Your brother's physique was...
scripts.translation: 你哥哥当时的体格是...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What do you mean exactly by that?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你具体指什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
His body was bigger and glowing blue like a Sapha, and his wings were much bigger than that of a normal Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他的体型变得更大，像萨法一样泛着蓝光，翅膀也比普通拉菲尼大得多。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I wonder if it's ^0000cda method to merge the unique characteristics of both races^000000...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
这会不会是^0000cd把两个种族的独特特征融合起来的方法^000000...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But even for his own experiments, my brother would have needed someone's wing and someone's hair... Would he really...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
可是就算是哥哥自己的实验，也得用到别人的翅膀和毛发...他真的会...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
According to your brother, he received the ingredients from a high-level Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
听你哥哥说，这些材料是高阶拉菲尼给他的。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
The more I look at it, the stranger it gets... To think of this in the first place...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
越看越觉得可疑...竟然一开始就有人想到这种研究...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Regardless, to figure out a way to recover my brother's body, I would have to study this.
I wish the instructions were more detailed.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不管怎样，为了找到让哥哥恢复原状的方法，我得研究这份报告。
真希望上面的说明能写得更详细些。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then should I go and ask your brother again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我再去问问你哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
That's probably no use. My brother also must have used these instructions to experiment, but he must have become that way because he failed.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
恐怕没用。哥哥也是照着这份说明做实验的，他会变成那样，想必就是实验失败了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
To understand these instructions accurately, we have to ^0000cdfind the Laphine who provided this report^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
要弄懂这些说明，我们必须^0000cd找到提供报告的那位拉菲尼^000000。

scripts.text: That's seems too uncertain.
scripts.translation: 这听起来也太不靠谱了

scripts.text: Shall I look for that Laphine?
scripts.translation: 我去找那位拉菲尼？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yes. I know. That's why {0} I asked you to help.
{1} You have much experience and have the necessary skills.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
是啊，我知道。所以才请你帮忙，{0}。
{1}你经验丰富，也有足够的本领。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
That's exactly my request!
Wow, your veteran sensibilities are truly amazing.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
正是如此！
哇，你这位老手的直觉真厉害。

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [乌哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But I guess it's still too much.
It must be too much...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不过，这要求还是太过分了吧。
一定让你很为难...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
In any case, thanks so much!
It looks like I'll have to depend on you again! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
总之太感谢你了！
看来我又得拜托你了，真的谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
First, please go find that Laphine and ask how to return his body back. And also please ask why the report was given to my brother in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
先去找那位拉菲尼，问问怎样才能让哥哥恢复原状。也请问问他，当初为什么把报告交给我哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople in the village first^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
最好先问问^0000cd村里的人^000000。

scripts.text: It's important to help others.
scripts.translation: 帮助别人很重要

scripts.text: No, I'm just passing by.
scripts.translation: 不了，我只是路过

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thank you so much!!!
Awesome! The world hasn't let me down just yet! I know it was too big of a favor..
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
太感谢你了！！！
太好了，这世界还没让我失望！我知道这个请求实在有些过分...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really?
But I'm a little busy right now.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
真的吗？
不过我现在有点忙。

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [乌哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Please go find that Laphine and ask how to return his body back. And also please ask why the report was given to my brother in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
请去找那位拉菲尼，问问怎样才能让哥哥恢复原状。也请问问他，当初为什么把报告交给我哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople in the village first^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
最好先问问^0000cd村里的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... That Laphine ^0000cdwas already dead.^000000

[Wuhari]
What? He was dead?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
什么？他已经死了？

scripts.text: - It's probably better not to tell him Wuhuru's story -
scripts.translation: - 还是别把乌胡鲁的事告诉他比较好。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You see, when I went to the field where he was last seen, he was already dead.
Could it be that the palace noticed how a risky research was being done and sent a person to take care of things?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我去他最后出现的野外时，他已经死了。
会不会是宫里发现有人在进行危险研究，派人去处理了？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Possibly...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
有可能...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But why of all people did they entrust my brother with that research?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
可是为什么偏偏把这项研究交给我哥哥？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It might be that they took advantage of his inferiority complex toward his physique and his superb intellect.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们或许是利用了他对体格的自卑，以及他过人的才智。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If he succeeded, they might have involved lower-level Laphines into the matter for less than desirable purposes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果研究成功，他们可能会把低阶拉菲尼也卷进来，拿去做不好的用途。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ahh, how terrible..
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
啊...太可怕了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It could have been better off for your brother to have failed.
Even though it's unfortunate for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对你哥哥来说，实验失败或许反倒是件好事。
虽然这对他本人来说很不幸。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Could it mean that my brother is...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
难道哥哥他...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
No, I'm sure there is some way.
I'll recover his body no matter what even if I were to do it by myself.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不，一定还有办法。
无论如何，就算只能靠我自己，我也要让他恢复原状。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is there anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有什么我能帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
You already helped me so much... If so, I'll ask you for even another favor. It's probably going to be the last one.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你已经帮我很多了...既然如此，我还想再拜托你一件事。这大概是最后一次了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
All of the ^0000CDingredients^000000 in this research report are very difficult for me to gather myself. {0} I would like to ask for your help.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
这份研究报告里列出的^0000CD材料^000000，光靠我自己很难收集齐。{0}能请你帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ingredients I need are ^0000CDone of each of the following: Laphine's Wing Fragment, Hair of Sapha, Karvodailnirol, Purified Bradium, Rune of Darkness, Rune of Blood^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我需要以下材料各一份：^0000CD拉菲尼翅膀碎片、萨法毛发、卡勒波迪药水、纯化魔力之石、黑暗卢恩、鲜血卢恩^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
All I can trust is you {0}. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
{0}，我能信任的只有你了。谢谢。

scripts.text: I brought them all.
scripts.translation: 我全都带来了

scripts.text: What were they again?
scripts.translation: 要带哪些材料来着？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ingredients I need are ^0000cdone of each of the following: Laphine's Wing Fragment, Hair of Sapha, Karvodailnirol, Purified Bradium, Rune of Darkness, Rune of Blood ^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我需要以下材料各一份：^0000cd拉菲尼翅膀碎片、萨法毛发、卡勒波迪药水、纯化魔力之石、黑暗卢恩、鲜血卢恩^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course!

[Wuhari]
Um... Where did you say the items were {0}?
I couldn't work without them.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
那个...{0}，你说的材料放哪儿了？
没有材料我就没法继续研究。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It must have been really difficult! Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你一定费了不少功夫！太感谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I'll try to continue the research with these.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我会试着用这些材料继续研究。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thank you for helping me through all of this.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
谢谢你一路帮我解决这些事。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
This is nothing, but it's just a token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
这点东西不成敬意，就当作我的谢礼吧。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I wish you best of luck in the coming future {0}.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
{0}，祝你今后一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um... Excuse me.
I'm looking for someone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个...打扰一下。
我在找一个人。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello?

[Suspicious man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can you hear me?
EXCUSE ME!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你听得到吗？
请问！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who is this guy?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这人怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me. You can hear me, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不好意思，你听得到我说话吧？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not a bad person. I'm just looking for someone in this prison.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是坏人，只是来这座监狱找个人。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ahhh! How irritating!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊啊啊！烦死了！！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
...

scripts.text: - The suspicious man doesn't seem to want to talk at all -
scripts.translation: - 那个可疑男子似乎完全不想搭理人。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, if you are asked something, would you at least respond?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，别人问你话，至少回一句吧？！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All I am trying to do is just deliver this to him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是想把东西交给他！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This right here! This thing!
Right? Can you see this? This thing!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就是这个！这个东西！
对，你看得见吗？就是这个！！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
What did you say you have?
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
你刚才说你带了什么？

scripts.text: - The letter was nowhere to be found -
scripts.translation: - 信不见了。 -

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
A... letter...?
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
信...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes! A letter! I'm trying to deliver this to him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对！一封信！我正要把它交给他！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would you know who Wuhuru is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道乌胡鲁是谁吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
Wu...huru...? That's...
scripts.translation:
[可疑男子]
乌...胡鲁？那是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It looks like ^0000cdyou are Wuhuru^000000. Your little brother wanted me to deliver this ^0000cdletter^000000 to you.
Although I didn't expect the delivery to be this way.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来^0000cd你就是乌胡鲁^000000。你弟弟托我把这封^0000cd信^000000交给你。
没想到送信的过程会这么曲折。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Thank...you.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
谢...谢你。

scripts.text: - You leave Wuhuru alone to read through the letter -
scripts.translation: - 你让乌胡鲁独自读信。 -

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I, I can't believe I did this to my little bro... Is Wuhari alright?
Ah.. What have I done...?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我、我竟然对弟弟做了这种事...乌哈里还好吗？
啊...我到底做了什么...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Have you met Wuhari? What a relief.
I can finally relax a little bit even in this prison.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
你见过乌哈里了？那就好。
在这座监狱里，我总算能稍微安心一点。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Any good news?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
有好消息吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Please, I ask you.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
......

[Wuhuru]
If you have met Wuhari, as you can see, I didn't look like this originally. My brother and I had ^0000cdparticular small physiques.^000000 even among the lower-level Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
既然你见过乌哈里，也看到了，我原本并不是这副模样。
我和弟弟在低阶拉菲尼族中都算^0000cd特别瘦小^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
So among Laphines, who value aesthetics so much, we couldn't help but always feel inferior.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
拉菲尼族如此重视外表，我们因此总觉得自己低人一等。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Being physically disadvantaged relative to others, we always studied at home. Thanks to that, we were able to become much smarter than others.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
因为体格不如别人，我们一直待在家里读书。也因此，我们比其他人聪明得多。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
One day, a high-level Laphine named ^0000cdMwaridica^000000 came to visit me.
He said that he is a member of a research facility, and that he wanted my help in a secret research project they were working on.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
有一天，一位名叫^0000cd姆瓦迪里卡^000000的高阶拉菲尼族人来找我。
他说自己是研究设施的成员，希望我协助他们进行一项秘密研究。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And that's when he gave me a research report that had some instructions and necessary ingredients.
It was a research project to ^0000cdstrengthen one's physique to make the Laphines stronger and more beautiful^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他给了我一份研究报告，里面写着实验步骤和所需材料。
那是一项^0000cd强化拉菲尼族体格、让他们更强壮也更美丽^000000的研究。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I immediately said yes. For me, it was clearly a way of being recognized. There was no reason for hesitation.
And also, if I were to find the means to make myself bigger...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我立刻答应了。那显然是个让我获得认可的机会，根本没有理由犹豫。
而且，要是能找到让自己长高的方法...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He requested that I wouldn't share any of this information. So I complied with all of his requests.
I didn't even share it with my brother who I trust so much.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他要求我对这件事保密，我便照他说的做了。
连最信任的弟弟，我都没有告诉。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I don't know if that was good or bad...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我也不知道这样做究竟是对是错...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
In any case, through much research, I finally had the results right before me.
But we had no experimental subjects at hand.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
总之，经过大量研究，我终于得到了结果。
可当时没有合适的实验对象。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
So I let myself become one.
And as you can see, the consequence was...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
于是我就拿自己做实验。
结果你也看到了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
As soon as the experiment failed, that Laphine just withdrew himself right away.
I tried to take care of things on my own, but I ultimately ended up here.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
实验一失败，那位拉菲尼族人就立刻抽身离开了。
我试着独自收拾残局，最后却落得被关在这里。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
After obtaining this body, I realize that I'd rather have my small body back.
As it is now, I am a monster.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
变成这副模样后，我才发现自己宁愿要回原来瘦小的身体。
现在的我简直就是个魔物。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I didn't want this for myself... My greed was excessive.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我并不想变成这样...是我太贪心了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Only if I had known earlier...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
要是我早点明白就好了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I'm sorry, I talked too much.
Regardless, I think it's over for me to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
抱歉，说了这么多。
不管怎样，我想自己这辈子都出不去了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
If you can make it out of here, could you please let my brother know to figure out a way for me to return to my original self.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
如果你能离开这里，能不能告诉我弟弟，请他想办法让我恢复原来的样子？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
My brother, he is smaller than I, but has always been the smarter one.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
弟弟比我还瘦小，却一直比我聪明。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Please, I ask you.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
This jail cell feels particularly warm today.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
今天这间牢房格外暖和。

scripts.text: I saw a dead corpse of a Laphine in the field.
scripts.translation: 我在野外发现了一具拉菲尼族人的尸体

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
...A dead Laphine corpse?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
...一具拉菲尼族人的尸体？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^0000cdIt was a dead corpse of a high-level Laphine.^000000 The way he seemed was suggestive of the Laphine who requested the research from you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^0000cd那是一具高阶拉菲尼族人的尸体。^000000从他的情况来看，他似乎就是那个找你做研究的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And I also met someone who witnessed another bigger Laphine chasing after that Laphine before you were imprisoned here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我还遇到一个目击者。他说，在你被关进这里之前，曾有另一位体型更大的拉菲尼族人追赶那位高阶拉菲尼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And then he was murdered.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
后来，那位高阶拉菲尼被杀了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What are you trying to say?
Are you telling me that I am a murderer?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
你这话是什么意思？
是在说我是杀人犯吗？

scripts.text: Did you murder him out of anger?
scripts.translation: 你是因为气愤才杀了他吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What does it matter even if I were to... Reveal that I am a murderer...?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
就算我承认...承认自己是杀人犯，又能怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I am trapped in this body no matter what...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
反正我都被困在这副身体里了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He tricked me, you see!
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
是他骗了我！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He convinced me that the goal of the research was to beautify and strengthen the Laphines and even set me up as the experimental subject!
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他骗我说，这项研究是为了让拉菲尼族变得更美、更强，还让我亲自当实验对象！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And as soon as the experiment failed, he ran away!
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
实验一失败，他就逃走了！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He told me the truth only right before his death.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
直到临死前，他才把真相告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
His true goal was to prove to his authorities that ^0000cdhis skills as a researcher was for real^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他的真正目的，是向上级证明^0000cd自己确实有研究员的本事^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He said that he didn't even examine the content of the experment or the ingredients themselves.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他说自己连实验内容和所用材料都没仔细看过。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And he also used dirty means to obtain the hair of a Sapha!
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他还用卑劣的手段弄到了萨法的毛发！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
The palace then discovered the means of this research, chased us down, and captured me for participating in the project.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
后来宫里发现了这项研究的内幕，便派人追捕我们。我因为参与研究，也被抓了起来。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What exactly did I do wrong?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我到底做错了什么？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I was only a pawn in his ambitious schemes.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我不过是他野心计划中的一枚棋子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It looks like his goals to engage in the study were similar to your own goals to participate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来你参与研究的目的，和他找你合作的目的差不多。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While you are a victim of his schemes, it is hard to justify what you have done... But
the way you are imprisoned here seems like you are paying for your actions.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你确实是他阴谋的受害者，但你做过的事也很难让人原谅...
不过，你被关在这里，也算是在为自己的行为付出代价。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
......

[Wuhuru]
Please... don't share this story with Wuhari.
I implore you.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
求你...别把这些事告诉乌哈里。
我求你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, I will act as though I have never made it here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我会当作从没来过这里。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Thank you... I am indebted to you...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
谢谢你...我欠你一个人情...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Whoa! Hey!
Would you please stop appearing out of nowhere?
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
哇！喂！
能不能别突然冒出来？

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Whoa! Hey!
What's going on! You shocked me!
What are you trying to do to me?
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
哇！喂！
怎么回事？吓我一跳！
你想干什么？

scripts.text:
[Masione]
I'm a fragile, sensitive being!
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
我可是很脆弱、很敏感的！

scripts.text: Um, about Wuhuru...
scripts.translation: 嗯，关于乌胡鲁的事...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Oh, I was shocked for no reason.
About Wuhuru... Well, I don't really know the messy details...
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
哦，原来没什么事。
说到乌胡鲁...具体情况我也不太清楚...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
I don't know how a guy who lived so peacefully all his life became like that.
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
他一向过得平静，真想不通怎么会变成那样。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Come to think of it, on the day that it happened, I heard a ^0000cdreally loud scream^000000...
Many in the village were too scared to go out for awhile after hearing that.
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
说起来，事发那天我听见一声^0000cd特别响的尖叫^000000...
村里好多人吓得有一阵子都不敢出门。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
And not too long after, many people from the palace came over and took Wuhuru away.
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
没过多久，宫里就来了很多人，把乌胡鲁带走了。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
For me, it was the first time I got out of the house in a while so all I saw was Wuhuru being captured.
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
那阵子我难得出一次门，所以只看见乌胡鲁被抓走。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
But Wuhuru's appearance at the time... his appearance...
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
不过乌胡鲁当时的样子...他的样子...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Anyways, ^0000cdGoatie^000000 was also there with me, so ask him too.
He's really sharp with these kind of things so he might remember more.
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
总之，山羊仔当时也和我在一起，你去问问他吧。^0000cd他对这类事很敏锐^000000，应该还记得更多。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
找我有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Did you want to know about something else?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
还有别的事想问吗？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Have you ever been to the palace?
They say that it is so much more beautiful than our Yai's could ever be.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
你去过皇宫吗？
听说那里比我们的雅伊漂亮得多。

scripts.text: I came after talking with Masione...
scripts.translation: 我和马西奥内谈过了...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Masione sent you? What's the problem?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
马西奥内叫你来的？怎么了？

scripts.text: I wanted to ask you about Wuhuru.
scripts.translation: 我想问问乌胡鲁的事

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Oh, you came for Wuhuru. But I don't know much either...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
哦，你是来打听乌胡鲁的。不过我也不太清楚...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Ah! I just remembered seeing Wuhuru right before that happened!
He came by with some ^0000cdstranger^000000...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
啊！我想起来了，出事前我见过乌胡鲁！
他和一个^0000cd陌生人^000000一起来的...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
At any rate, in all my days knowing Wuhuru, it's the first time I've seen him so happy.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
我认识乌胡鲁这么久，还是头一回见他那么开心。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
When I asked him why he was so happy, he showed me some ^0000cdpieces of paper^000000 and told me that he was going to look great soon...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
我问他为什么这么高兴，他给我看了几张^0000cd纸^000000，说自己很快就会变得很帅...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
And the guy next to him would hint at him to keep quiet...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
他身旁那人还示意他别声张...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Well, I was a bit concerned, but seeing him so happy, I couldn't say anything.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
我当时有些担心，可看他那么高兴，也就没多说什么。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
And it was after that when the big accident occurred.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
那之后不久，就出了那场大事故。

scripts.text: What was the piece of paper?
scripts.translation: 那张纸是什么？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
That thing? Hmm, I don't know. I was too far to tell...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
那东西吗？我也不知道，离得太远，看不清...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
That's right, why don't you go see my ^0000cdhusband^000000. He was pretty close to Wuhuru so he might know more.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
对了，你去问问我^0000cd丈夫^000000吧。他和乌胡鲁走得很近，可能知道得更多。

scripts.text: I want to hear about the high-level Laphine who Wuhuru was working with.
scripts.translation: 我想了解乌胡鲁合作的那位高阶拉菲尼

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Oh the high-level Laphine...? Yes~ I remember!
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
哦，那位高阶拉菲尼？对~我想起来了！

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
The stranger who came by with Wuhuru was a high-level Laphine. Are you talking about him?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
和乌胡鲁一起来的陌生人就是高阶拉菲尼。你说的是他吧？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
If you are talking about him, he quietly left the place after staying with Wuhuru for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
要是说那个人，他和乌胡鲁待了一阵子后，就悄悄离开了。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
After that, Wuhuru would just spend his days in his Yai.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
从那以后，乌胡鲁就一直待在自己的雅伊里。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
But that Laphine, ^0000cdhe did have impressive, beautiful wings that made him seem very elegant, but his gaze and something about him made him very suspicious^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
不过，那位拉菲尼^0000cd确实有一双漂亮又惹眼的翅膀，显得十分优雅；可他的眼神和举止都透着可疑^000000。

scripts.text: Do you remember anything else?
scripts.translation: 你还记得别的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Hmm, come to think of it, ^0000cdPompe told me one day that he saw a terrible thing happening to a high-level Laphine in the land of blooming flowers^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
嗯...我想起来了，^0000cd有一天蓬佩告诉我，他在花海之地看见一位高阶拉菲尼遭遇了可怕的事^000000。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
He did say that the Laphine that he saw at the time also had ^0000cdparticularly large and beautiful wings...^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
他说，当时那位拉菲尼也有^0000cd特别巨大又漂亮的翅膀...^000000

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Go see Pompe and check with him.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
你去找蓬佩问问吧。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
I guess people who have nothing can only dream.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
一无所有的人，大概只能靠做梦了。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Do you need something from me?
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
找我有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
It's my wife's big wish to visit the palace.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我妻子最大的心愿就是去皇宫看看。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I know why you are here!
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我知道你为什么来！

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Do you need something else from me?
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
还有别的事要问我吗？

scripts.text: I was wondering about the paper that Wuhuru was holding.
scripts.translation: 我想问问乌胡鲁手里那张纸的事

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Yeah, that's right. My wife told me that he was holding something like that, but I have no idea what that was.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
没错。我妻子说他当时拿着类似的东西，但我也不知道那到底是什么。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
But who would you be to look for such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
不过，你为什么要找那种东西？

scripts.text: Wuhari asked me a favor.
scripts.translation: 乌哈里拜托我帮忙

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Oh really? Come to think of it, I forgot to tell this to Wuhari.
Before Wuhuru was caputured away, Wuhuru's ^0000cdletter^000000 was placed on our window.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
哦，是吗？说起来，我忘了告诉乌哈里。
乌胡鲁被抓走前，把一封^0000cd信^000000放在我家窗台上。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
He must have written it in preparation for his fate.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
他大概是预感到自己的处境，才提前写了这封信。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
He asked me to deliver a sealed ^0000cddocument^000000 to his brother.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
他托我把一份密封的^0000cd文件^000000交给弟弟。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
However!
We were so busy that we couldn't meet up with Wuhari even when we heard that he came back around here.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
不过！
我们实在太忙了。即使听说乌哈里回到附近，也没能见到他。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Hmm, I wonder if that sealed document is the paper that my wife was talking about?
Whatever is it, give this to Wuhari.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
嗯...妻子说的那张纸，会不会就是这份密封文件？
不管怎样，你把这个交给乌哈里吧。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Let me see... Where did I put it...
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我找找...放在哪儿了...

scripts.text: - Shuffle -
scripts.translation: - 窸窸窣窣 -

scripts.text:
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
scripts.translation:
- 窸窸窣窣 -
- 窸窸窣窣 -

scripts.text:
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
scripts.translation:
- 窸窸窣窣 -
- 窸窸窣窣 -
- 窸窸窣窣 -

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Yes, here it is.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
找到了。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I told myself that I'll keep it really safe, and that's why it's like this.
It's a bit wrinkled and stained, but it should be just fine to read.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我一直提醒自己要把它收好，结果反倒弄成这样。
虽然又皱又脏，应该还是看得清。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Please help those poor kids.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
请帮帮那两个可怜的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I don't know how nice kids like them became like that...
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
真不明白，那么好的孩子怎么会变成那样...

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
Especially given our situation...
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我也想帮她实现心愿，可这怎么可能呢？
尤其是我们现在这种处境...

scripts.text:
[Svery]
You dropped this, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
你掉了东西吧？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Tsk tsk. How could a young one like you be so forgetful.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
啧啧，年纪轻轻怎么就这么健忘？

scripts.text: Who's the high-level Laphine?
scripts.translation: 那位高阶拉菲尼是谁？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
A high-level laphine? Hmm? I'm not sure who that was.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
高阶拉菲尼？嗯...我不太清楚是谁。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I never saw him before. And that was also the last time I saw him.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我以前从没见过他，那也是我最后一次见到他。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Why don't you go see my wife? She was with me.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
你去问我妻子吧，她当时也在场。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
My wife is much sharper than me with these kind of things, so she'll probably be more helpful.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我妻子比我机灵多了，这种事问她应该更有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
Especially given our situation...
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我想帮她实现那个愿望，但怎么可能呢？
尤其是考虑到我们现在的处境...

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I saw it!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我看见了！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Ouch! Whoa! Who is this? Is it a ghost?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哎哟！哇！你是谁？幽灵吗？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I really saw it!!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我真的看见了！！

scripts.text: I was sent by Goatie...
scripts.translation: 我是山羊仔派来的...

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Goatie sent you? What's the problem?
Is it because of what they gave me last time? Tell them they have to wait a bit longer.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
山羊仔派你来的？怎么了？
是上次给我的东西吗？告诉他们再等一会儿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's not it. I was just curious about the Laphine you saw in the field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，我只是想问问你在野外看到的那位拉菲尼。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Oy! That Laphine?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哦！那位拉菲尼？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Whoa! Don't even start with me!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哇，别让我再提那件事！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I was doing my business in the field in the middle of a night, but there suddenly appeared two dark shadows!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
有天半夜我在野外干活，突然出现了两道黑影！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
At first, a ^0000cdhigh-level Laphine^000000 disappeared into distance so fast, and it was such a beautiful sight that I looked on for a while.
^0000cdThe wings were really big and pretty.^000000
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
先是一位^0000cd高阶拉菲尼^000000飞快地消失在远方。那景象实在太美，我忍不住看了好一会儿。
^0000cd他的翅膀又大又漂亮。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And then! Not too long after, suddenly!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
然后！没过多久，突然！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
So suddenly!!!
^0000cdA huge Laphine^000000 was chasing after that high-level Laphine!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
就在那一瞬间！！！
^0000cd一只巨大的拉菲尼^000000追了上去！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I'm not sure if it was because it was so dark at the time, but ^0000cdhis body was so dark^000000 that I couldn't tell who it was.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
也许是当时太黑了，^0000cd那家伙全身漆黑^000000，根本看不清是什么。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I didn't think much into it and returned home. But some time later a scream, so loud that could shake the entire field, ripped through the air.
It was such a scary scream.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我没多想，就回了家。过了一会儿，突然传来一声震彻整片野地的尖叫。
那叫声吓死人了。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And I was too afraid to go out for a while after that.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
从那以后，我吓得好一阵子都不敢出门。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And a few days ago, when I went out to the field, I saw in the corner ^0000cda big corpse^000000!
I also saw many ^0000cdsuspicious tree branches^000000 scattered in the area.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
几天前我又去野外，在角落里发现了^0000cd一具巨大的尸体^000000！
附近还散落着许多^0000cd可疑的树枝^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
It was so disquieting that I didn't get near it...
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
那景象太吓人了，我没敢靠近...

scripts.text: A corpse?
scripts.translation: 一具尸体？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Yeah! I don't know what kind of terrible thing happened, but ^0000cda big wing was ripped, and the more I think about it, it looks like the corpse of the Laphine that I saw^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
是啊！我不知道发生了什么可怕的事，但^0000cd有一只巨大的翅膀被撕裂了。仔细一想，那应该就是我见过的那位拉菲尼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Oh dear~~ I don't know why this kind of thing happened so suddenly.
A high-level Laphine should have great magic powers, but to see him dead so easily, the other huge Laphine must be something else.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
天哪~~真不知道怎么会突然发生这种事。
高阶拉菲尼应该有强大的魔力，却这么轻易就死了。那只巨型拉菲尼一定非常可怕。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
That's why I'm afraid to go out to the field.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
所以我才不敢去野外。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
What if that huge Laphine attacks me when I'm out and about in the field?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
万一我在野外时，那只巨型拉菲尼袭击我怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
My kids are too young, and I need to take care of them! I need to stay safe, you see!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我的孩子还小，我得照顾他们！我可得保护好自己！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
You should stay away, too, if you can.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
你也尽量别靠近那里。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Excuse me, if it's not too much trouble, could I talk to you for a second?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
打扰一下，方便的话能占用您一点时间吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you find something?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
您找到什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you need something from me?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I went to go see my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我去找父亲了。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I wonder where he went. It should be around here...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
不知道他去哪儿了...应该就在这附近。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you find something?
Oh... I see you haven't yet...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
您找到什么了吗？
哦...看来还没有...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Father... Sob sob...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
父亲...呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Where did he go...?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
他到底去哪儿了...？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
You really seem like you have an impressive aura.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
您身上有种不凡的气质。

scripts.text: Do you know the way?
scripts.translation: 您知道该怎么走吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'm sorry? Do I know the way...?
No, no, I'm not someone like that.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
什么？我知道怎么走？
不不，我可不是向导。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I noticed from earlier that you are looking for something. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我刚才注意到您在找东西。没错吧？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'd like to make a ^0000cdsuggestion^000000.
Would you like to hear it?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我有个^0000cd提议^000000。
您想听听吗？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll hear you out.
scripts.translation: 好，我听听

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
It won't be a waste of your time. To be honest, I'm actually ^0000cdlooking for someone^000000 here too.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
不会耽误您太久。说实话，我也^0000cd在这里找一个人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father hasn't returned home for some time now, and when I visited his work, they said that he hasn't shown up there for a while either.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我父亲已经有一阵子没回家了。我去他的工作地点找过，他们说他也好久没去上班。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
He's not one to vanish like that, so I asked around.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
他不是会这样不告而别的人，所以我到处打听。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I heard that people saw him around here, but I can't find a trace of him anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
听说有人在这附近见过他，可我怎么也找不到他。

scripts.text: Did you try asking the authorities?
scripts.translation: 您问过当局了吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I already did. In fact, they were already searching for him.
I'm guessing they didn't make much progress.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
问过了。他们其实也在找我父亲。
我猜他们还没什么进展。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'm worried something might have happened to him, so I came out searching for him myself.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我担心他出了什么事，所以亲自出来找他。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
So, my suggestion is why don't we help each other find what each other needs throughout this search?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
不如我们结伴寻找，途中也互相帮忙找各自要找的东西？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
What do you think? I'm sure doing this together would be better than doing it alone.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
你觉得怎么样？一起行动总比各自寻找强。

scripts.text: What's he look like?
scripts.translation: 他长什么样？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh great, that means you'll take my suggestion, right?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
太好了，那你是愿意和我合作了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father is similar to me. ^0000cdHe has particularly large wings and has a generally red aura around him.^000000
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我父亲和我很像。^0000cd他的翅膀特别大，周身常泛着红色光晕。^000000

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
His name is ^0000cdMwadirica^000000.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
他叫^0000cd姆瓦迪里卡^000000。

scripts.text: I'm looking for him too!
scripts.translation: 我也在找他！

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh, really? Why are you looking for my father?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
真的吗？你为什么要找我父亲？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Actually, let's talk about this later and search for my father now.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
这件事我们之后再谈，现在先去找我父亲吧。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
If we find something, let's meet back here.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
有线索的话，我们就在这里碰头。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I brought this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把这个带来了。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
What... Did you say you found something?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
什么...你说找到线索了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm? Where did it go? Did I drop it on the way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？东西去哪儿了？我是在路上弄丢了吗？

scripts.text: - You describe the corpse that you found in the field and show the piece of wing -
scripts.translation: - 你描述了在野外发现尸体的情形，并拿出那片翅膀。 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh, oh....! This is.... Definitely my father's...
Sob... NOoo!
How could this be...?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
哦...！这是...肯定是我父亲的...
呜...不要！！！
怎么会这样...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He's in the eastern part of the field among the tall grasses. Should I accompany you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他在野地东边的高草丛里。要我陪你去吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
No, no. I'll go alone.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
不用，不用，我自己去。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Before that, I would like to hear about why you were looking for my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
在那之前，我想先听你说说为什么在找我父亲。

scripts.text: - You share Wuhuru's research story -
scripts.translation: - 你讲述了乌胡鲁的研究经过。 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father? He was certainly working on something very hard recently...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我父亲？他最近确实一直在埋头研究什么...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Ah, who in the world... did such a thing...
A kind person like him...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
啊...到底是谁做了这种事...
他那么善良...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
In any case, thanks a lot. You found my father...
This couldn't possibly be enough compensation, but please take it.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
总之，谢谢你找到我父亲...
这点报酬远不足以表达谢意，请收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
And please tell Wuhuru about my father.
They worked together, so he should hear about my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
还有，请把我父亲的事告诉乌胡鲁。
他们曾一起工作，他有权知道。

scripts.text: I need a piece of your father's wing.
scripts.translation: 我需要你父亲的一片翅膀

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Isn't that what you already have in your hand right now?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
你手里拿着的不就是吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Why would you need a piece of my father's wing...?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
你为什么需要我父亲的翅膀碎片...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What! When did it get here?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么！它什么时候跑到我这里来的？！

scripts.text: - You briefly share Wuhuru's story -
scripts.translation: - 你简单讲述了乌胡鲁的事。 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I see... It resulted from their research together...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我明白了...这是他们一起研究造成的结果...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Ok, sure. I will give it to you. I'm sure that's what my father would have liked you to have it.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
好吧，可以给你。我想父亲也会愿意把它交给你。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Please tell him I wish him the best.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
请替我祝他一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I would like to reminisce a bit more about my father here.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我想在这里再回忆一会儿父亲。

scripts.text: - An unidentifiable figure that looks like a huge flower bud -
scripts.translation: - 一个无法辨认的身影，看起来像巨大的花苞。 -

scripts.text: This looks like the Laphine corpse that Pompe talked about.
scripts.translation: 这应该就是蓬佩提到的那具拉菲尼尸体。

scripts.text: Looking at the shape of the wing, ^0000cdit is Mwaridica's high-level Laphine wing as described by Wuhuru and Giranni^000000.
scripts.translation: 观察翅膀的形状，^0000cd这应该是乌胡鲁和吉兰尼所说的姆瓦迪里卡的高阶拉菲尼翅膀。^000000

scripts.text: Seeing various scars on the body, he seems to have been ^0000cdmurdered^000000 after a fight.
scripts.translation: 尸体上有多处伤痕，看来他是在战斗后^0000cd遭人杀害^000000的。

scripts.text: If he were to be overpowered, it must have been ^0000cda creature of large physique^000000 that surpasses a high-level Laphine.
scripts.translation: 如果他是被击败的，对手必定是^0000cd体型远超高阶拉菲尼的生物^000000。

scripts.text: Let's pick up these scattered wing pieces and go tell Giranni about this.
scripts.translation: 把散落的翅膀碎片收集起来，再去告诉吉兰尼吧。

scripts.text: The scattered wing pieces are collected.
scripts.translation: 散落的翅膀碎片已经收集完毕。

scripts.text: - Around the corpse are some hair strands of a Sapha that look like tree branches -
scripts.translation: - 尸体周围散落着一些萨法毛发，看起来像树枝。 -

scripts.text: - Since this is a research ingredient, let's take some -
scripts.translation: - 这是研究所需的材料，收集一些吧。 -

scripts.text: - A high-level Laphine corpse -
scripts.translation: - 一具高阶拉菲尼的尸体。 -

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
Take a look at me! How's this? Am I not so fabulous?
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
看看我！怎么样？是不是风度翩翩？

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
A Laphine can freely change in between different clothes, but not any Laphine looks this great!
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
拉菲尼族可以随心更换衣服，不过不是每个族人都能穿出我这样的风采！

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
What nonsensical nonsense are you saying? No matter who looks at it, this region's best looker is me!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
你在胡说八道什么？谁看都知道，这一带最帅的就是我！

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
My fashion sense today is excellent as usual. Heh-
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
我今天的穿搭品味还是一如既往地出众。哼哼。

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
Hello~ My beautiful body~
Every strand of hair is so beautiful!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
你好~我这迷人的身姿~
连每一根头发都漂亮极了！

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
Yes, it's definitely your garbage fashion sense that wreaks of trash as usual.
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
没错，你那品味果然还是一如既往地糟糕，简直俗不可耐。

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
I recently moved out of my parent's place!
I am so glad I finally have my own Yai!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
我最近搬出父母家了！
终于有了自己的雅伊，真开心！

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
I'm going to make it the most decorative, beautiful Yai in Eclage!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
我要把它装饰成埃克拉珠最华丽、最漂亮的雅伊！

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
Yay, woohoo!!!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
耶，太棒了！！！

scripts.text:
[Mijani]
You are not from around here?
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[米贾尼]
你不是本地人吧？
欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Mijani]
Of course, as long as you don't disrupt Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[米贾尼]
当然可以，只要别在埃克拉珠惹事。

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
I also want to visit foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[马尔科扎]
我也想去外面的世界看看。

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
But would foreigners leave me be when I am this adorable?
scripts.translation:
[马尔科扎]
不过我这么可爱，外地人会放过我吗？

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
Man, wherever I go, my cuteness just complicates everything...
scripts.translation:
[马尔科扎]
唉，不管去哪儿，我的可爱总会给我添麻烦...

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Do you like things that twinkle?
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
你喜欢闪闪发亮的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
I love them so much!
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
我最喜欢了！

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
闪闪发亮~闪闪发亮~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
Sparkle sparkle~ Sparkle sparkle~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
闪闪发亮~闪闪发亮~
亮晶晶~亮晶晶~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
Sparkle sparkle~ Sparkle sparkle~
Mmhahah~ Hahaha~ Hehehe~
Heh heh heh~ Huhuhe~ Hoho~
Kehehe~ Halala~ Fufu~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
闪闪发亮~闪闪发亮~
亮晶晶~亮晶晶~
嗯哈哈~哈哈哈~嘿嘿嘿~
嘿嘿嘿~呼呼嘿~呵呵~
嘻嘻~啦啦~呼呼~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
But there's nothing twinkling here...
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
可是这里没有闪闪发亮的东西...

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Ah~ I'm so hungry. What should I eat today?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奥]
啊~肚子好饿。今天吃什么好呢？

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Come to think of it, I wonder how this foreigner will taste?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奥]
说起来，不知道外地人吃起来是什么味道？

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Hey hey, you know I'm kidding, right?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奥]
喂喂，我是在开玩笑，你知道吧？

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
Why am I kneeling like this?
scripts.translation:
[跪着的男孩]
我为什么一直跪着？

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
At first, it was because it was comfortable. Now it's because I can't stretch my legs out anymore.
scripts.translation:
[跪着的男孩]
一开始是觉得这样舒服。现在嘛，是腿已经伸不直了。

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
I try to stretch them out, and my legs are all asleep!!
Does that mean I have to fly around with my legs flexed like this?
scripts.translation:
[跪着的男孩]
我试着伸直腿，结果整条腿都麻了！！
难道以后只能一直蜷着腿飞吗？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Wahahaha! How do you do!
It's perfect weather for a picnic, no?
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办人]
哇哈哈！你好啊！
今天天气这么好，正适合野餐，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
You say it's hard to pack for a picnic?
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办人]
你说野餐的准备很麻烦？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Don't you worry!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办人]
别担心！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
This is a specialty combining acorns with 7 different kinds and 7 different levels of flavor collected by squirrels of Eclage!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办人]
这是埃克拉珠的松鼠采集七种不同种类、七种不同口味的橡果，精心制成的特色美食！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
This specialty to-go box is only 2,999 coins!!!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办人]
这款特色外带套餐只要2,999枚金币！！！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Such a remarkable price!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办人]
价格超划算！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
If you order now, we also give you a disposable fork that feels like new even with a hundred uses!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办人]
现在下单还送一把一次性叉子，用一百次都跟新的一样！

scripts.text:
[A blushing girl]
Do you see this balcony up top?
Mayor Jun appears there everytime there is an important occasion!
scripts.translation:
[脸红的女孩]
看到上面的阳台了吗？
每逢重要场合，君市长都会在那里露面！

scripts.text:
[A blushing girl]
He's so handome!! Ahhh~
scripts.translation:
[脸红的女孩]
他好帅！！啊～

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
We are Eclage's Tree Wing Choir~
We bring you heavenly harmonies~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班指挥]
我们是埃克拉珠的树翼唱诗班～
为大家献上天籁般的和声～

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
Hello foreigner, we'll give you a taste of our harmony~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班指挥]
你好，外地人。让我们为你唱一曲吧～

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班]
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班]
啊~~
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班]
啊~~~
啊~~
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Aaa~~~~~
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Aaa~~~~~~
Aaa~~~~~
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Uhhurukukuruhuuhhurukukuruhuuh
Try to feel this~ The melody that flows~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班]
呜呼噜咕噜呼呜呼噜咕噜呼
感受一下这流淌的旋律～

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
How is it!! Our harmony!!
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班指挥]
怎么样！！我们的和声！

scripts.text:
[Choir member]
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班成员]
啊~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shuffle... Shuffle...
Tap... Tap... Creak... Creak...
Thud thud thud...
Thud Thud!!! Creak~ Thud!
What are these sounds?
scripts.translation: 这些是什么声音？

scripts.text: Ignore them and move on.
scripts.translation: 别管它们，继续赶路

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are weird sounds of some kind...
I should go in and check it out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
里面好像传来奇怪的声音...
我该进去看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's probably nothing.
I should just go on my way~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大概没什么事。
我还是继续赶路吧~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello~
Is there something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好~
出什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
- Something hits you
over the head really hard.
Your body loses its strength and your vision goes blurry -
scripts.translation:
- 有什么东西狠狠砸中了你的脑袋。
你浑身脱力，视线也逐渐模糊。 -

scripts.text: - Oh, I can't lose my consciousness like this -
scripts.translation: - 不行...不能就这样昏过去... -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
What just happened?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
刚才发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
There's no way the house is
in this much disarray without
a thief breaking and entering...
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
家里乱成这样，肯定是有小偷闯进来了...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Just earlier, my necklace
was stolen!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
刚才我的项链被偷了！

scripts.text:
[Poppy]
Bow wow! Bow wow!
Grrrrr Bow Wow!
scripts.translation:
[波比]
汪汪！汪汪！
呜——汪汪！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
This darn dog always
bites random strangers
that other Laphines hate it!
How many times did I say
that we should kick
this dog out for good?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
这只臭狗总是乱咬陌生人，其他拉菲尼族人都讨厌它！
我说过多少次了，干脆把这只狗赶走算了！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Poppy~ Be nice~
This person is not
someone to be afraid of,
Shh~ Shh~~
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
波比～乖一点～
这位不是坏人，不用怕。
嘘～嘘～

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
And how many times 
did I tell you to lock the doors
properly, my dear!!
This is all because of you
not caring for our house enough!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
亲爱的，我跟你说过多少次，一定要把门锁好！！
你就是不够上心，才让家里变成这样的！

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Hey, hey, you keep
blaming me too much!
Aren't we lucky enough 
that we are not
hurt anywhere?
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
喂喂，你也太爱责怪我了吧！
至少我们都没受伤，这不是已经很幸运了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
What did you say?
My goodness!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你说什么？
真是的！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm?
I think that person's awake!
Hey, are you okay?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯？
那个人好像醒了！
喂，你还好吗？

scripts.text: My head hurts so much...
scripts.translation: 我的头好痛...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
If the human's awake, get rid of it!
Our house just got robbed
and we don't have the 
luxury of taking care of someone!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
既然那个人醒了，就把他赶出去！
我们家才刚被抢，哪有闲工夫照顾别人！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Still, you shouldn't say that to someone who's been knocked out...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
可是，也不能对刚昏过去的人这么说啊...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
How do you feel?
You were in front of our house, unconscious so we brought you inside.
What happened to you?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
你感觉怎么样？
你昏倒在我们家门口，所以我们把你带进来了。
你怎么会倒在那里？

scripts.text: Someone came out... and...
scripts.translation: 有人冲出来...然后...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Wow... I can't believe something like that happened.
I think the person who knocked
you unconscious is the one 
who robbed our house.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
哇...竟然发生了这种事。
把你打昏的人，应该就是抢我们家的人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
How can you believe what {0} saying?
How do you know {1} not lying
after robbing our stuff {2}?
Search {3} possessions immediately!!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你怎么能相信{0}说的话？
{1}抢了我们的东西{2}，你怎么知道对方没有说谎？
立刻搜查{3}的随身物品！！

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
No, how could you say such things?
In common sense, why would the robber be lying down in front of the house?
I think what this person is
saying is probably true...
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
不，你怎么能这么说？
按常理，小偷怎么会躺在自家门口？
我觉得这位说的应该是真的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
In any case. What do you plan to do?
Because our house just got robbed,
we don't have the means to take care of you.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
总之，你打算怎么办？
我们家刚被抢，实在没办法照顾你。

scripts.text: I'm not the type to be bullied around.
scripts.translation: 我可不是任人欺负的

scripts.text: I'll help you catch the thief.
scripts.translation: 我会帮你们抓住小偷

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm... The way you look
seems like you would have 
been bullied around in the past..
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯...看你的样子，以前好像没少受欺负...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm, I guess
we'll need
your help
with this.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯，那这件事就拜托你帮忙了。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm, since you say that,
I can't trust you 100%, but
I'll trust you as best as I can.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
既然你这么说，我就尽量相信你吧，虽然还不能完全信任你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'll definitely
find the jerk who hit
me over my head.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错。我一定要找到那个从背后敲我脑袋的混蛋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before anything, I'll first listen to your
observations on what may have happened.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在开始之前，我先听听你们观察到的情况。
请尽量配合我。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Sure, you got it.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
好，交给我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't know about this...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
这事我可不太放心...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Alright, let's go for it.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
好，那就查查看吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm... The stories you told me...
Now I've processed through them..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...你们刚才讲的那些事...我已经整理过了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are some points of interest
that I am considering right now...
First of all..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有几个关键点值得注意...
首先...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The likely suspect is...
A person with short, red hair.
We aren't sure whether the
person is male or female, but
has a familiar face...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嫌疑人很可能是个留着红色短发的人。
还不确定是男是女，但看起来很面熟...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Dames came back from meeting with a friend..
The friend is nice.
He's a bit immature, but doesn't
seem to be of a particular problem.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
达姆斯是去见朋友后回来的。
那位朋友人不错，虽然有点不成熟，但不像会惹出什么大麻烦。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rosa was coming back from shopping.
Since I was lying unconscious
and the house was a mess,
she was afraid of me and left me 
there and stayed inside the house.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
罗莎买东西回来时，看见我昏倒在地，屋里也乱成一团。
她吓坏了，把我留在门外，自己进了屋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I thought the daughter discovered
me first but Rosa was already
in the house by then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我原以为是女儿先发现我的，可那时罗莎已经在屋里了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The daughter told me that 
she saw Balumin passing
by the house...
He seemed to be preoccupied
with something...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
女儿说，她看到巴卢明从屋旁经过...
他看起来心事重重...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
In other words... the person who
discovered me first was Rosa
and I was lying in front of
the house.
The house was in much disarray
And...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也就是说...罗莎最先发现了我，而我当时倒在门外。
屋里乱成一团，而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But why was I just passed
by when I was unconcious?
Something's not right.
And...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可是我昏倒在门外，为什么有人经过时没有理会？
这不太对劲...而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, Dames actually
suspects Rosa the most.
Their marriage has been becoming
more difficult. She's been asking him for
more things. Their relationship doesn't seem healthy.
And..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过，达姆斯最怀疑罗莎。
他们的婚姻最近越来越紧张。她不断向他要东西，两人的关系似乎不太好。而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The stolen necklace was
what the husband bought for his wife..
Recently, the wife asked him to 
buy her a necklace, but he refused.
That's why he suspects her.
And..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
被偷的项链是丈夫送给妻子的。
最近妻子要他再买一条，他拒绝了，所以他才怀疑她...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She said she doesn't suspect anyone.
She trusts her family entirely.
The stolen necklace was
something that she
really cared for.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她说自己不怀疑任何人，完全信任家人。
那条被偷的项链对她来说非常珍贵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are no particularly expensive
items in the house and neither was the necklace.
It was just a meaningful item.
It is weird that it was stolen
when it didn't seem very expensive.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
屋里没有什么贵重物品，项链本身也不值钱，只是很有纪念意义。
偏偏小偷拿走了它，这点很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The analysis is enough for now and
the second thing I have to do is...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前分析到这里。接下来要做的是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Field examination!
The robber must have left
some evidence!
Shall I start?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
勘查现场！
小偷一定留下了什么线索！
现在开始吗？

scripts.text: - Let's examine Poppy first -
scripts.translation: - 先检查波比。 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the messy
bookshelves first -
scripts.translation: - 先检查乱糟糟的书架。 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the damaged
book first -
scripts.translation: - 先检查被弄坏的书。 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the
container first -
scripts.translation: - 先检查容器。 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the
messed up table first -
scripts.translation: - 先检查乱成一团的桌子。 -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh......
What should I do...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
啊...
我该怎么办...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh... What happened here?
I can't believe that the house was robbed...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
啊...这里发生什么事了？
真不敢相信家里被偷了...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope the robber
is caught soon..
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
希望能快点抓到小偷...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok then,
I will begin interviewing
the victims.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，我先询问几位当事人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice
so please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只问一次，请认真回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你刚才从哪里回来？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I was taking a walk
in the land of blooming flowers.
I was reading a book and enjoying the breeze.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我刚才在花海之地散步。
一边看书，一边吹着风。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
If I go to a place where there are soft breezes,
I feel much better and
forget everything about the house.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
去有微风的地方走走，心情就会好很多，也能暂时忘掉家里的烦心事。

scripts.text: Was there anyone suspicious?
scripts.translation: 你有看到什么可疑的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm... I'm not sure.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯...我不太确定。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh! Come to think of it, there was!
There was a person with short, red hair hurriedly going somewhere.
I wondered to myself
what's the big hurry?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
啊！想起来了！
有个红色短发的人急匆匆地往某处赶。
我还纳闷他为什么这么着急。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
It was an uncommon hair color
so it made me stare at the person 
for a bit, wondering who it was.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
那种发色很少见，所以我多看了那人几眼，想知道他是谁。

scripts.text: Was the person male or female?
scripts.translation: 那人是男是女？

scripts.text: Do you know anyone with short, red hair?
scripts.translation: 你认识留红色短发的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
That I'm not sure...
Hmm, now that you ask.
I wonder what the gender is.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
这个我不太清楚...
嗯，你这么一问，我也好奇那人到底是男是女。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm...
No matter how much I think about it...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯...
我怎么想都想不起来...

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女儿 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
The physique seems
more masculine, but
the hair seemed more
feminine...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
体格看着比较像男性，可头发又显得比较女性化...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
And... Something about
the person was familiar
to me..
I'm not exactly sure though.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
还有...那人让我觉得有些面熟...
不过我也不确定。

scripts.text: Who's the first person to find me?
scripts.translation: 谁第一个发现我的？

scripts.text: Have you seen short, red hair elsewhere?
scripts.translation: 你还在别处见过红短发的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I think... I was the 
first one to discover you...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我想...应该是我第一个发现你的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I didn't see the person again
but on my way back home,
I saw my dad's friend
Balumin passing by
the house.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
没有，我后来没再见过那人。
不过回家的路上，我看到爸爸的朋友巴卢明从家门前经过。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女儿 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
When I first found you,
you were lying in
front of the house unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我第一次发现你时，你正昏倒在家门口。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I was shocked thinking
that it was a dead corpse,
but thankfully you were breathing.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我吓了一跳，还以为你已经死了，幸好你还有呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I was hastily trying
to bring you inside the house,
but I was shocked again seeing
the house in so much disarray.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我正想赶紧把你搬进屋，没想到屋里乱成这样，又吓了一跳。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
But inside the house, my mom
was already there.
I mean, if a person is lying in front of the house
unconscious, how could she just
go inside the house without doing anything?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
可是妈妈已经在屋里了。
有人昏倒在门外，她怎么能什么都不做，就直接进屋呢？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I guess if I were to answer
that again, the first person to see you
was probably my mom.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
这么说来，第一个看到你的大概是妈妈。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I saw him far away
so I didn't see in much detail
but he was sweating
a whole lot at the time.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我离他很远，看不清楚，不过他当时满头大汗。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I couldn't talk to him,
but he seemed very
preoccupied with something.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我没和他说话，但他看起来心事重重。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Come to think of it,
if he passed by our house,
he must have seen you unconscious body but I wonder why he didn't do anything?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
仔细想想，巴卢明经过我家时肯定也看见你昏倒在地。他为什么什么都没做呢？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Anyways, I think that's pretty much all I know.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
总之，我知道的就这些了。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你如实回答

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No problem.
I hope that was helpful 
at least somewhat.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
没关系。
希望多少能帮上忙。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope we can catch the robber.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
希望能抓到小偷。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I have never seen anyone else with that hairstyle.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
不，我没见过其他留这种发型的人。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
At least from the people that I know,
I don't think there was ever a person like that.
Yeah... Not at all!
This I know for sure!
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
至少在我认识的人里，没有这样的人。
对，绝对没有！这一点我很确定！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
If it was a color as 
obvious as that,
there is no way I wouldn't remember!
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
发色那么显眼，我不可能不记得！

scripts.text: Who's the first person to find me?
scripts.translation: 谁第一个发现我的？

scripts.text: Have you seen short, red hair before?
scripts.translation: 你以前见过红色短发的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I think... I was the 
first one to discover you...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我想...应该是我第一个发现你的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I didn't see the person again
but on my way back home,
I saw my dad's friend
Balumin passing by
the house.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
不，我没有再见到那个人。
不过在我回家的路上，我看到爸爸的朋友巴卢明
从我家门前经过。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女儿 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
When I first found you,
you were lying in
front of the house unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我第一次发现你的时候，你正躺在屋前，已经失去了意识。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I was shocked thinking
that it was a dead corpse,
but thankfully you were breathing.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我当时吓了一跳，还以为是一具尸体，但幸好你还有呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I was hastily trying
to bring you inside the house,
but I was shocked again seeing
the house in so much disarray.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
所以我急忙想把你抱进屋里，但看到屋里一片狼藉，又吓了一跳。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
But inside the house, my mom
was already there.
I mean, if a person is lying in front of the house
unconscious, how could she just
go inside the house without doing anything?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
不过，妈妈已经在屋里了。
有人昏倒在门外，她怎么能什么都不做，就直接进屋呢？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I guess if I were to answer
that again, the first person to see you was probably my mom.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
所以真要说的话，第一个看到你的应该是妈妈。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I saw him far away
so I didn't see in much detail
but he was sweating
a whole lot at the time.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我离他比较远，所以没看清细节，但他当时满头大汗。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I couldn't talk to him,
but he seemed very
preoccupied with something.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我没有和他说话，但他看起来
心事重重。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Come to think of it,
if Balumin passed by our house, too,
he must have seen you unconscious
but I wonder why he didn't do anything?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
仔细想想，巴卢明经过我家时肯定也看见你昏倒在地。他为什么什么都没做呢？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Anyways, I think that's 
pretty much all I know.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
总之，我知道的就这些了。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的坦诚回答

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No problem.
I hope that was helpful 
at least somewhat.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
没关系。
希望多少能帮上忙。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope we can catch the robber.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
希望能抓到小偷。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Did you say you are going to do a field examination?
Is there anything
I can help with?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
你是说要勘查现场？
有什么我能帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
You were working on the field examination, right?
But I guess you aren't done.
Please let me know what you find
when you are done.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
你还在勘查现场，对吧？看来还没结束。
结束后告诉我你发现了什么。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
You finished with all of the
field examination!
Did you find anything?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
现场都勘查完了吗？
有什么发现？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Maybe...
The necklace wasn't stolen, but
was just lost somewhere in the house...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
会不会...项链根本没被偷，只是不小心掉在屋里了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Unfortunately, that wasn't the case,
and I should do a 
survey investigation of
various people.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可惜不是这样。接下来我得向其他人逐一打听。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh, I see...
But aren't you doing
too much for us?
Honestly, we are very
thankful for what
you've already done...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
哦...我明白了。
不过，你为我们做的已经够多了。
说真的，我们非常感谢你...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
What are you saying?
No matter what! My necklace!
And the thief who took it!
We have to find them!
No matter what!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你在说什么？不管怎样，我的项链和小偷都一定要找到！
无论如何都要找到！

scripts.text:
- Footstep sounds -
- It sounds like someone is walking toward the house -
scripts.translation:
- 脚步声 -
- 好像有人正朝屋子走来 -

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Mother~ Father~
I'm back~!
What the...?!
What happened to the house?
Was it robbed?!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
妈妈～爸爸～
我回来啦～！
咦...？！
家里怎么了？被抢了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
How am I possibly
your mother??
You take that back right away!!
How many times did I tell you to
stay away from my daughter, huh?!
Get out of the house right now!!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我怎么会是你妈妈？
马上把那句话收回去！！
我说过多少次了，离我女儿远点！
现在立刻滚出我家！！

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Mother!! If something
has been robbed, I will
definitely find it for you!
You can trust me, mother!!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
妈妈！！要是东西被偷了，我一定帮你找回来！
相信我，妈妈！！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You are just a nuisance.
Get out of the house right now!!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你真是个麻烦精。
马上给我滚出去！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That guy must be Luen's
boyfriend... Before it
gets messier here, I should
get on with my
survey investigation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那家伙肯定是露恩的男朋友...
趁这里闹得更乱之前，我还是继续调查吧。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Did you say you are going to do a field examination?
Is there anything
I can help with?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
你是说要勘查现场？
有什么我能帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: I found out who the robber was.
scripts.translation: 查出小偷是谁了

scripts.text: I haven't figured things out yet.
scripts.translation: 我还没查清楚

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I... I see...
Finding the robber is important, but...
The necklace is even more important...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我...我知道了...
抓到小偷固然重要，可是...项链更重要...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh my.. Really?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
天哪...真的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes.
Of course, I also found out
where the robbed necklace was..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。
当然，我也查到了被偷项链的下落...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now..
I'll let you know the 
results of my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么...
我来告诉你调查结果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then why don't I gather all of the victims and suspects and go through the thought process with you.
This place is not appropriate so let us go to another location.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不如把受害者和嫌疑人都叫来，一起梳理案情。
这里不方便，我们换个地方。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's get going.

- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 继续交谈前得先减轻负重。 -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I told my parents and
all the others.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我已经把事情告诉父母和其他人了。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
That my boyfriend was the one.
I knew about it already.
But, I couldn't tell my parents because if they were to find out the truth,
they would oppose him even more...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
小偷就是我男朋友...我早就知道了。
可我没法告诉父母，若让他们知道真相，只会更加反对我们...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
But thank you so much for helping us both physically and emotionally.
This is just a small token of my appreciation.
Thanks again.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
真的很谢谢你，不只帮了我们的忙，也给了我们安慰。
这是一点小小心意。再次谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Thank you so much for helping us
both physically and emotionally.
Thanks again.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
非常感谢你这段时间帮我们解围，也给了我们安慰。
再次谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Heh, this kind of thing.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
呵，这种事啊。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
It's the first time this kind of
thing ever happened to us.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
我们家还是头一回遇上这种事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you may have heard, to figure out the thief responsible for this, I will begin my interview with you.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想必你已经听说了。为了查明这起盗窃案，我要向你询问一些情况，请配合调查。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice so
please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只问一次，请仔细回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你刚才从哪里回来？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I was coming back from
meeting with a friend.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
我刚和朋友见面回来。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I talked to him about my daughter.
I talked to him about my wife.
I talked to him about life.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
我们聊了女儿、妻子，还有生活上的事。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Then I came back home
and it was a mess.
My wife and daughter were devastated.
And you were lying unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
回到家时，屋里一片狼藉。
妻子和女儿都很难过，而你则昏倒在地。

scripts.text: What kind of friend is he?
scripts.translation: 他是个什么样的人？

scripts.text: Did you talk about anything else?
scripts.translation: 你们还聊了别的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
He's not anyone particularly mean or bad.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
他不算什么坏人，也不刻薄。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Although he's a bit immature
no matter how much he ages...
To put it positively, he lives young, but to put it negatively, he's just an immature kind of a guy.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
他都这么大岁数了，还是有点不成熟...
往好处说是童心未泯，往坏处说就是不够稳重。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Aside from that,
he is no trouble at all.
He's that kind of a friend.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
除此之外，他从不给人添麻烦。
他就是这样的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Actually..
Not too long ago,
the guy asked
me a favor..
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
其实...
不久前，那家伙...
拜托我一件事...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
He said he has an urgent need
for some money..
And asked me to help him out..
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
他说自己急需一笔钱...
问我能不能帮帮他...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
So since I didn't have money myself
and it's not the best to exchange money
between friends,
I told him that I was sorry
and sent him off after
treating him to a meal.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
我自己手头也不宽裕，而且朋友之间借钱也不太好。
所以我向他道歉，请他吃了顿饭，就送他离开了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Aside from that,
I don't see anything
suspicious about him..
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
除此之外，我看不出他有什么可疑之处...

scripts.text: Has he been suspicious before?
