scripts.translation: 他以前做过什么可疑的事吗？

scripts.text: Do you suspect him after the incident?
scripts.translation: 事发后你怀疑过他吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
To be honest,
I suspect my wife.
She has been complaining about
every little thing recently.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
老实说，我怀疑的是妻子。
她最近总为鸡毛蒜皮的小事抱怨。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
No matter what I say, she either says 'no' or 'I don't like it.'
It's not for any specific reason but she just opposes me for
the sake of opposing me.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
不管我说什么，她不是反对，就是说不喜欢。
也没什么特别理由，简直是为了反对而反对。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Recently, she's been asking for this and that, and getting mad about this and that.
It's really been tough.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
她最近总是要这要那，还动不动就生气。
真让人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
The item that was stolen is my wife's necklace...
It's a necklace that I got for her.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
被偷的是妻子的项链...
那是我送给她的。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
When the house was robbed I was really worried.
But when I found out that it was the necklace...
I recalled what my wife had told me not too long ago.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
家里被偷时我非常担心。
可得知丢的是项链后，我想起妻子前些日子说过的话。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
She said that she wants a new necklace.
I told her that I will buy her one for her next birthday...
She was mad still.
I wonder if this kind of thing happened because of that in the end.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
她说想要一条新项链。我答应下个生日买给她...
她还是不高兴。
这次的事会不会就是因此而起呢？

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你坦诚回答

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Not a problem.
I hope my responses 
will help you.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
不客气。
希望我的回答能帮上忙。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Only if we can
catch that robber soon,
how wonderful that would be.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
要是能尽快抓到小偷，那就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I see you are getting through your field examination.
I ask that you would
give your all.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
看来你正在勘查现场。
请尽力调查。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I see you are continuing your investigation.
Are you thinking of 
talking to my friend as well?
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
看来你还在调查。
也打算问问我的朋友吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
How is the
investigation going?
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
调查得怎么样了？

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 继续交谈前得先减轻负重。 -

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I heard most of the story
from Cruyan.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
克鲁扬把事情经过大致告诉我了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
It was pretty shocking...
but in some ways, I could
see why he did it.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
这确实很令人震惊...
不过某种程度上，我也明白他为什么那么做。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Thank you for helping us
throughout this time.
You went through a lot for us.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
谢谢你这段时间帮忙。
你为我们费了不少心。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I know that it's up to us
from now to figure
things out...
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
接下来得由我们自己把事情处理好...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Here's something for you.
Thanks again and
I hope that all your work
in the future will go well.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
这个送给你。再次感谢，祝你今后一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Thanks again and
I hope that all your work
in the future will go well.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
再次感谢，祝你今后一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you may have heard, to figure out the thief responsible for this,
I will begin my interview with you.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想必你已经听说了。为了查明这起盗窃案，我要向你询问一些情况，请配合调查。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice so please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只问一次，请仔细回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你刚才从哪里回来？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't really trust you
but I'll talk to you for
the sake of my necklace.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我不太信任你，不过为了找回项链，我还是愿意回答。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I was shopping around
in the store nearby
to see if there's anything
I should get.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我刚才在附近的商店逛，看看有没有什么需要买的。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I didn't really have anything 
I liked, so I just came back home.
That's all.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
没看到喜欢的东西，就回家了。就这样。

scripts.text: Why did you just go into the house?
scripts.translation: 你为什么直接进屋了？

scripts.text: Was there anything suspicious?
scripts.translation: 你有发现什么可疑之处吗？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
When I first saw you
lying down, I was shocked
out of my mind, and actually
thought that if you were alive,
I need to do something about it!
I'm not that bad, you know!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
一开始看到你倒在地上，我吓坏了，还想过你要是没死，我就得想办法救你！
我可不是坏人！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
But the world today, is it all that simple?
There are so many kinds of accidents these days!
A feeble housewife like me really can't do much!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
可如今世道哪有那么简单？意外多得很！
我一个弱女子，能做什么？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
So I first went into the house,
and planned to pick you up
with the rest of my family!
But when I went into the house,
the house was in chaos
as if it was robbed!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
所以我先回屋，打算叫家人一起把你抬进来！
没想到屋里也乱成一团，像是被洗劫过一样！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
A person lying at the door!
A robbed house!
I was so scared that
I couldn't go out to get you!
Do you understand me?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
门口躺着个人，家里又被抢了！
我吓得不敢出去救你！你明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
When I came into the house,
aside from it being so messy,
there wasn't anything else!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
进屋后，除了满地狼藉，没发现别的异常！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Of all things, why was my
necklace stolen...?
Why couldn't the robber
just take that useless
dog instead!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
偏偏被偷的是我的项链...
那个没用的狗怎么没被偷走呢！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
The more I think about, the more annoying it gets!
......
............
I'm sorry... I was venting
on you for no reason...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
越想越气！
...
...
抱歉...我不该无缘无故冲你发火...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Anyways, I don't think there was
anything peculiar about it.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
总之，我没发现什么特别可疑的地方。

scripts.text: Do you suspect anyone?
scripts.translation: 你怀疑谁？

scripts.text: Is there anything else missing?
scripts.translation: 还有别的东西丢了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Not sure.
Even though my husband is apathetic to me, he's not a bad person.
My no-good daugther doesn't listen to me when I tell her to break up with her boyfriend.
But she's still a nice girl...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
不知道。丈夫虽然对我冷淡，但人不坏。
女儿也不争气，叫她和男朋友分手她偏不听...不过她本性不坏。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
And it's not that our house is 
filled with expensive items,
and the necklace is one
precious item that I
truly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我们家也没什么贵重物品，那条项链是我真正珍惜的东西之一...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
That's what got robbed!
It's not my family for sure!
There's no way I'd suspect them!
Not at all!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
被偷的就是那条项链！
肯定不是家里人干的！
我绝不会怀疑他们！绝对不会！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
We don't have anything in our house that's particularly expensive.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我们家没有什么特别贵重的东西。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
In fact, the necklace is also not
all that expensive. But it's just 
that it's an object of multiple
significance...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
其实那条项链也不算贵，只是对我有多重意义...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
It's obvious that the necklace 
is not that pricey.
Even if you sell it..
I don't think it would be all that much.
I have no idea why it was stolen.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
那条项链明显不值多少钱。
就算卖掉，也换不了多少。我也不知道为什么小偷会拿走它。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你坦诚回答

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I really wish...
that you would find my necklace.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我只希望...你能帮我找回项链。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
That necklace. It's what
my husband got me.. So it's
very important to me.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
那条项链是丈夫送我的...对我来说非常重要。

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 继续交谈前得先减轻负重。 -

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
......
I heard the whole story.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
...
我都听说了。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I never really liked Cruyan in the first place but I feel more disappointed in my daughter.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我本来就不太喜欢克鲁扬，不过我更失望的是女儿。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]

With all that, I sincerely appreciate you for being so helpful.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
其实我一直很怀疑你...
但你帮了我们这么多，我还是由衷感谢。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
But...
It turns out that 
Cruyan or my daughter
don't have the necklace.
For that I'm still pretty upset.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
可是...克鲁扬和女儿都没有项链。
想到这点，我还是很生气。

scripts.text:
- While carefully handing -
- Rosa her necklace -
- I tell her where it was found -
scripts.translation: - 你小心地把项链递给罗莎，并告诉她发现项链的地点。 -

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I see... I didn't know it
was in such a place.
You had already found it but to figure out the truth behind everything.
You kept it all to yourself until now.
I didn't know you put such deep consideration for this...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
原来如此...我不知道它会在那么远的地方。
你早就找到了，但为了查明真相，一直把它藏在身边。
没想到你考虑得这么周到...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I am just
speechless.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我真是
无话可说。
非常感谢，非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't have much...
If this is alright with you,
this is just my gratitude.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我没有多少钱...
如果你不介意，这只是我的一点心意。
真的非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Oh my. How could this be...?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
天哪，怎么会这样...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I would have never imagined
that our house would be robbed!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我从来没想过
我们家会被入室盗窃！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You are going to do a field examination?
Great, do what you need to do!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你要进行现场勘查吗？
太好了，请随意调查！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You'll be carrying out your
investigation carefully, right?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你会仔细
进行调查的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Is the investigation going
alright...?
Somehow I can't really... trust...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
调查进展顺利吗...？
我总觉得...不太放心...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I am just
speechless.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我都不知道该说什么了。
真的非常感谢你。

你带的东西太多，我没法确认不在场证明。请先减轻负重再来。

项链不是我偷的！

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

[Cruyan]
Since you seem to be working hard, I'll give you this Concentration Potion that I got from hunting~
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
看你这么认真，我把打怪得到的集中药水送给你吧~

[Cruyan]

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]

scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]

you found the

scripts.translation:

谢谢你...

今后我不会再耍这种小聪明了。

scripts.translation:

pretty bad about myself

burden than help.
scripts.translation:

身为朋友，我觉得自己没帮上忙，反倒成了累赘，心里很过意不去。

a big part in resolving

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
这点东西不成敬意，是我打魔物时得到的战利品，请收下。

scripts.text:

I hope that your
future will be full

scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
愿你今后诸事顺遂。

scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在有点忙，正在打魔物...看起来你也在打怪...等你忙完再来找我吧。

by hunting some monsters.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我一整天都待在这里打魔物赚钱。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
And earlier today, I met
with my buddy and talked
about many things.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
今天早些时候，我和朋友见面聊了些事情。

scripts.text: Have you seen a guy named Cruyan?
scripts.translation: 你见过一个叫克鲁扬的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
Hmm, I was
here all day, but
aside from my friend Dames
I didn't see anybody.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
嗯，我一整天都在这里。除了朋友达姆斯，没见过别人。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
All I saw were the land of blooming flowers and monsters.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我看到的只有花海之地和魔物。

scripts.text: Do monsters drop Concentration...
scripts.translation: 魔物会掉集中药水吗...

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I don't think it's something
you can obtain from the
monsters around here.

scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我不觉得附近的魔物会掉这种东西，这点我很确定。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]

scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
那种东西应该是商店里买的...而且不是一般商店会卖的。

scripts.translation:

总之，朋友家出了这么糟糕的事，拜托你一定要抓到小偷。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[流浪商人]
喂！！刚才...嗝...你说我是骗子，现在又说我是小偷？
我也许会骗骗顾客，可从来没偷过东西！

scripts.text:
{0}
The Wandering Merchant
is definitely the robber!!
The reason being~!!
Your hair color!!
scripts.translation: 你的发色！！

scripts.text:
{0}
According to Luen's statements, an unfamiliar person with short, red hair was hurriedly running somewhere.
scripts.translation:
{0}
露恩说，她看到一个陌生的红短发的人匆忙跑向某处。

{0}
这附近很少发生盗窃案，犯人很可能是外地人。

scripts.text:
{0}
Taking all of this together!
Wandering Merchant!
Since your business was suffering, you broke into the house and stole things.

{0}
All the while, you took
2 bottles of alcohol and
drank them!!
Now~ would you show everyone the necklace and confess?

[Wandering Merchant]
This is unfair!!
It's definitely not me!!
I'll tell you the money I make every day.
My business is going really well!!
I have no reason to rob houses!
scripts.translation:
[流浪商人]
太不公平了！！绝对不是我！！
我每天赚多少钱都可以告诉你，我生意好得很！！
根本没必要去偷东西！

scripts.text: But, the alcohol stench...
scripts.translation: 可是你身上有酒味...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是弄错了

scripts.text:
[Wandering Merchant]
I didn't steal any alcohol.
I just drank the ones I bought
with my own money!!
scripts.translation:
[流浪商人]
酒不是我偷的，是我自己花钱买来喝的！！

scripts.text: Hmm, But...
scripts.translation: 嗯，可是...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是弄错了

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Just because I am a stranger you think you can accuse me without reason?
How could you treat someone like this solely based on the fact that he's a stranger?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
就因为我是外地人，你就能毫无理由地指控我吗？
只因为我不是本地人，就这样对我，像话吗？

scripts.text: I'm... I'm sorry...
scripts.translation: 我...对不起...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Me?
It's definitely not me!!
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
我？
绝对不是我！！

scripts.text: Because his wife nags all the time.
scripts.translation: 因为他的妻子总是唠叨

scripts.text:
{0}
During interrogation, Dames said he was getting tired of the constant fighting and was getting exhuasted from his wife asking him to buy him this and that all the time.
scripts.translation:
{0}
询问时，达姆斯说他受够了不断争吵，也厌烦了妻子总让他买这买那。

scripts.text:
{0}
Dames said he was fighting more often and that their marriage was suffering.
scripts.translation:
{0}
达姆斯说他们夫妻最近争吵频繁，婚姻关系也不太好。

scripts.text:
{0}
Dames! I could sense that
you wanted to release
the stress you got from
your wife.
scripts.translation:
{0}
达姆斯！我看得出来，你想发泄妻子带给你的压力。

scripts.text:
{0}
That's why
you wanted to take revenge on
your wife, hid the necklace,
and acted like the house
was robbed.
scripts.translation:
{0}
所以你想报复妻子，便藏起项链，假装家里被盗。

{0}
好了~把项链拿出来，承认吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
This is totally unfair!!
Even if I was
stressed out,
what is the point of
hiding the necklace that
I bought for her?
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
这太荒唐了！！
就算我压力很大，藏起我买给她的项链又有什么意义？

scripts.text: That's... probably for revenge...
scripts.translation: 那...大概是为了报复吧...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是弄错了

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
For revenge?!
Don't even say such a word!
We lived as husband and wife
for decades and you think
a little bit of stress will
ruin everything?
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
报复？！别说这种话！
我们做了几十年夫妻，你觉得一点压力就能毁掉一切吗？

scripts.text: Hmm... I don't think so, but...
scripts.translation: 嗯...我不这么觉得，不过...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是弄错了

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
That's such ludicrous logic!!
Why are you blaming my husband?
Why don't you think straight?!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
这推理简直荒谬！！
为什么怪我丈夫？
你能不能动动脑子？！

scripts.text: I... I see...
scripts.translation: 我...我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I'm the robber??
No way!!
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我？小偷？
怎么可能！！

scripts.text:
{0}
Balumin is
definitely the robber!!
The reason being~!!
Because Dames wouldn't lend him money...
scripts.translation: 因为达姆斯不肯借给他钱...

scripts.text:
{0}
He said that he met with Dames
and that his financial state 
is unstable recently.
And I heard that you secretly
asked to borrow some money.

{0}
But I know that Dames didn't
lend you money.
And I'm sure that made you
feel disappointed and upset.

{0}
With the financial need,
you ultimately decided
to rob the house!!!!
scripts.translation:
{0}
因为缺钱，你最后决定入室行窃！！！！

{0}
现在~请把项链拿出来，当着大家的面认罪吧？

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
This is just unfair!
As you saw earlier,
all I did today was
hunting in the land
of blooming flowers..
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
这太不公平了！
你刚才也看到了，我今天一直在
繁花之地打猎...

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
How could I go and
rob the house, too?
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我怎么可能还跑去别人家里抢劫？

scripts.text: That's because....
scripts.translation: 那是因为...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞错了

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
Besides, Dames and I
are friends of 20 years.
Do you think I'll do
something like that just
for some money?
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
而且，我和达姆斯是二十年的朋友。
你觉得我会为了点钱做这种事吗？

scripts.text: Hmm... I don't think so, but...
scripts.translation: 嗯...我也不觉得你会这么做，可是...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞错了

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
That's right.. There's no way
my friend would do such a thing!!
Even if he did so,
I won't hold him responsible!
It would probably be my fault that
I didn't understand him better.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
没错...我的朋友绝不会做这种事！！
就算他真的做了，我也不会追究他的责任！
大概是我不够了解他，才会变成这样吧。

scripts.text: I... I see...
scripts.translation: 我...我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I'm th... the robber?
That's not fair!!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
我...我就是那个窃贼？
这太不公平了！！

scripts.text: Revenge on Luen's parents
scripts.translation: 为了报复露恩的父母

scripts.text: To prepare for his personal expenses
scripts.translation: 为了填补自己的开销

scripts.text: To gain permission to date Luen
scripts.translation: 为了得到和露恩交往的许可

scripts.text:
{0}
He must have stolen the 
necklace to take revenge on 
the opposition he faced from
Rosa regarding his relationship with Luen!
scripts.translation:
{0}
他一定是为了报复罗莎反对他和露恩交往，才偷走了项链！

scripts.text:
{0}
As you saw earlier, Rosa would
frequently yell at Cruyan, and
anyone who received that kind of 
treatment will begin developing
some kind of vindictiveness.

[Cruyan]
That's not fair!!
I'm... I'm not the robber!!
Prove it!!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
这太不公平了！！
我...我不是窃贼！！
拿出证据来！！

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I love Luen!!
If I committed such a crime,
I might never be able
to meet Luen again.
Why would I do such 
a crazy thing?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
我爱露恩！！
要是犯下这种罪，我可能就再也见不到露恩了。
我为什么要做这种傻事？

scripts.text: Well, that's because...
scripts.translation: 那是因为...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞错了

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Besides, if I did such a thing, Luen probably wouldn't like me anymore.
Who would like a guy
that is vindictive against
her own mother?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
再说，我要是真做了这种事，露恩大概就不会再喜欢我了。
有哪个女孩会喜欢一个
怨恨自己母亲的男人？

scripts.text: But...
scripts.translation: 但是...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞错了

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I want to earn her trust and become a worthy son-in-law.
Why would I do such a reckless thing?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
我想赢得她的信任，成为她值得托付的女婿。
我为什么要做这种鲁莽的事？

scripts.text: I... I see...
scripts.translation: 我...我明白了...

scripts.text:
{0}
Since you ran out of your
personal money, you
decided to rob the necklace
of your girlfriend's mother!!
scripts.translation:
{0}
你花光了自己的钱，于是就决定偷走女朋友母亲的项链！！

scripts.text:
{0}
He didn't end just there.
He also stole two
bottles of alcohol as well.

{0}
The Wandering Merchant was 
drunk and you may think he could
have been the culprit, but 
I'm sure it was Cruyan who traded
the alcohol for more gambling
as he ran out of money.
scripts.translation:
{0}
流浪商人喝醉了，你可能会怀疑是他下的手，但我敢肯定，是克鲁扬没钱后拿酒换了赌资，接着又去赌了。

scripts.text:
{0}
And the main reason for
his relationship with Luen
being opposed is probably that
he likes such things as gambling
and alcohol. He must have
instinctively commited the crime!!

[Cruyan]
It's true that I like alcohol 
and gambling, but since
Luen's mother doesn't like that,
I've been living a clean life
to earn her trust!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
我确实喜欢喝酒和赌博，可露恩的母亲不喜欢这些，所以我一直戒着，想赢得她的信任！

scripts.text: Why would I believe that?
scripts.translation: 我为什么要相信？

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞错了

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
While that wandering merchant
smells of alcohol, I don't have the
slightest hint of alcohol smell do I!?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
那个流浪商人一身酒气，可我身上连一点酒味都没有，不是吗！？

scripts.text: But...
scripts.translation: 但是...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞错了

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
And I have never seen that merchant before!
Should I ask him?
Whether I gambled
with him or not?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
我以前根本没见过那个商人！
要不要问问他，我有没有跟他赌过？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Merchant]
I remember all of my
customers, but
Hmm, I don't think I've
seen Cruyan.
I'm sure of it~ Hiccup~
scripts.translation:
[流浪商人]
我记得每一位客人...
嗯，我不记得见过克鲁扬。
这点我敢肯定~嗝~

scripts.text: I... I see...
scripts.translation: 我...我明白了...

scripts.text:
{0}
He committed such a crime
to earn the approval for
his relationship with Luen!
scripts.translation:
{0}
他犯下这种罪行，是想换取罗莎认可他和露恩交往！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
What... What in the 
world do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎女士]
你...你这话是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Heh... Let's first
hear him out.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
呵...先听他说完吧。

scripts.text:
{0}
From the beginning,
Cruyan who likes gambling and alcohol was never liked by Rosa. 
He tried to change himself in a variety of ways, but...

[Cruyan]
Haha... What on earth are you talking about? Huh?
I was hunting in the land of blooming flowers during the time of crime.
The Concentration Potion is the proof.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
哈哈...你们到底在说什么？嗯？
案发时我明明在繁花之地打猎。
这瓶集中药水就是证据。

scripts.text: I see... Hmm...
scripts.translation: 我明白了... 嗯...

scripts.text: I'm afraid that's not true.
scripts.translation: 恐怕这不是真的

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Of course!
I'm innocent!!
Why don't you find
the real culprit now?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
当然！
我清白得很！！
你们还是赶紧去找真正的窃贼吧？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
What about it is not true?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
哪里不是真的？

scripts.text: According to Luen's statements...
scripts.translation: 根据露恩的证词...

scripts.text: According to Balumin's statements...
scripts.translation: 根据巴卢明的证词...

scripts.text:
{0}
Luen said she definitely
didn't see you before
you came over.
scripts.translation:
{0}
露恩说，在你过来之前，她根本没见过你。

scripts.text:
{0}
However, if you were really
hunting in the land
of blooming flowers,
would it have been possible
for you to get from there
to the house in such a short time?
scripts.translation:
{0}
可是，如果你当时真的在繁花之地打猎，又怎么可能这么快赶到这栋房子？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I'm a Laphine!!
Maybe you aren't familiar,
but I have wings and
can fly that kind of distance
in no time!!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
我是拉菲尼族！！
你可能不清楚，我们有翅膀，转眼就能飞这么远！！

scripts.text: Oh, I didn't know you could.
scripts.translation: 哦，我不知道你能飞

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I'm innocent!!
Why don't you find
the real culprit now?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
我清白得很！！
你们还是赶紧去找真正的窃贼吧？

scripts.text:
{0}
Balumin said
that even though he hunted 
in the land of blooming flowers
where you presumably were
hunting also, he never caught
a sight of you.
scripts.translation:
{0}
巴卢明说，他也在你声称打猎的繁花之地，却从来没见过你。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Even... Even if that were true,
I don't have the necklace!!
It's true!!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
就...就算你说的是真的，我也没有项链！！
我没撒谎！！

scripts.text: Look through his possessions.
scripts.translation: 搜查他的随身物品

scripts.text: Explain it without looking.
scripts.translation: 不搜查，直接解释

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Ok, look through it all you want.
I really don't have the necklace!!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
好啊，尽管搜吧。
我真的没有项链！！

scripts.text: - You search through Cruyan's possessions -
scripts.translation: - 你搜查了克鲁扬的随身物品 -

scripts.text: - You find nothing -
scripts.translation: - 一无所获 -

scripts.text:
{0}
That's because when you
were about to steal the
necklace, you were caught
by Luen.
scripts.translation:
{0}
因为你正要偷项链时，被露恩撞见了。

scripts.text:
{0}
Although Luen 
was shocked to see her
boyfriend trying to rob and 
going through the house,
she got to hear his side of
the story.
scripts.translation:
{0}
露恩看到男友入室偷窃，自然大受打击，但她还是听了你的解释。

scripts.text:
{0}
She must have sympathized
with how you felt, but probably
disagreed with you. She must 
have physically resisted you 
trying to steal the necklace, and
in the process, the necklace was lost...

{0}
And that's when I was coming in
from outside. And since you
didn't want to be caught,
you knocked me out...

{0}
You were both afraid of
what might have happened to me..
The necklace was lost in the process..
And since your parents were about
to return home, you hurriedly
left the house.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你们都担心我会出事...
项链也在混乱中丢了...
眼看露恩的父母就要回家，你们便匆匆离开了房子。

scripts.text:
{0}
You tried to do something
with me, but Rosa was
already on her way back at
the time, so you couldn't do anything.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你本想对我做些什么，但罗莎当时已经在回家的路上，所以你没能下手。

scripts.text:
{0}
And Cruyan, as soon as you
got to the house, you said
that the necklace was stolen.
How did you know that when
nobody had told you
about it?

scripts.translation:
{0}
家具被翻得乱七八糟，波比却没有对窃贼吠叫；
露恩和克鲁扬又因惊慌编出了漏洞百出的说辞。
顺着这些线索查下去...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Stop... Please stop...
I don't want to be even more miserable
than I already am...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
够了...求你别说了...
我已经够难受了...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Yes... I am the thief...
I won't try to 
justify that.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
是的...我就是窃贼...
我不想为自己辩解。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
As for Luen... my girlfriend
did nothing wrong..
It's all my fault..
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
露恩...我的女朋友没有做错任何事...
全都是我的错...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
The rest of this,
I'll confess and explain everything..
And I'll make my apologies...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
接下来我会坦白一切，把事情解释清楚...
我也会向大家道歉...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I ask you...
Please don't involve yourself any further...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
求求你...
别再插手这件事了...

scripts.text:
{0}
I... I guess
I must have gotten something wrong.
I'll think about it more and figure out who the robber is...

[Daughter Luen]
Thank you for lightening 
our burdens...
Cruyan and I will resolve
the rest of this issue.
Would you please go outside now?
scripts.translation:
[露恩]
谢谢你替我们减轻了负担...
剩下的事，我和克鲁扬会处理。
请你先到外面去，好吗？

scripts.text: Leave the house.
scripts.translation: 离开房子

scripts.text: Leave after a bit.
scripts.translation: 稍后离开

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Thank you for everything...
scripts.translation:
[露恩]
谢谢你帮了我们这么多...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Please let us know
when you're leaving.
scripts.translation:
[露恩]
你准备离开时告诉我们一声。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女儿 露恩]

scripts.text:
- It's floating in mid-air
but it feels like I could
enter it -
scripts.translation:
- 它浮在半空中，
但感觉可以走进去 -

scripts.text: Don't enter the residence.
scripts.translation: 不进入住宅

scripts.text: Enter the residence.
scripts.translation: 进入住宅

scripts.text: - Let's check it out later -
scripts.translation: - 过会儿再来看看 -

scripts.text: Don't exit the residence.
scripts.translation: 不离开住宅

scripts.text: Exit the residence.
scripts.translation: 离开住宅

scripts.text: - Let's leave a bit later -
scripts.translation: - 过会儿再离开 -

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Oww, my stomach hurts!!
What are you looking at?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎哟，肚子好痛！！
你看什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Oww, my stomach hurts!!
Aren't Green Herbs so common?
I can't believe they're not in stock!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎哟，肚子好痛！！
绿色药草不是很常见吗？
居然还会缺货！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Hmm...I'm sure I took the right medicine...
but why isn't it getting better?
Maybe it's not just a stomachache?
Could it be that I have...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯...我明明吃了对症的药...
怎么还是不见好？
难道不只是胃痛？
该不会是...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Cecilia is so random
She already knows that I like books...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亚真是想到一出是一出。
她明明知道我喜欢看书...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Did I read any books recently?
Umm...yea, I read a lot usually.
I don't have anything else to do at the clinic.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近看过什么书吗？
嗯...平时我确实看了不少。
在诊所里也没别的事可做。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Is Cecilia investing something?
Right? Isn't she? Am I right? Right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亚是不是在打什么主意？
对吧？是不是？我猜得没错吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Well, then...
Should I start punishing Dominic for giving a stomachache to this beautiful lady!!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
既然如此...
我要惩罚多米尼克，竟敢害这位美丽女士胃痛！！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Are you done yet?
I'm tired of waiting~
Let's hurry it up a little more.
Pranks are not fun if you think about it too much.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你还没弄好吗？
我都等累了~
再快一点嘛。
恶作剧想太多可就不好玩了。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I'm all ready here.
Now, I mix what you brought like this, and...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我这边准备好了。
现在把你带来的东西这样混在一起，然后...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Hmm? It's weird.
There's something weird about you.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯？真奇怪。
你身上好像有些不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Have we...have we succeeded at last?!
Now, go plant this secretly around Dominic's bookshelves.
If he finds random weeds growing near the bookshelves he'll be so mad, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我们...我们终于成功了吗？！
现在把这个偷偷种在多米尼克的书架附近。
他要是发现书架旁长出不知名的杂草，肯定会气坏的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Kekeke, I could hear Dominic screaming from here.
Is he really upset now?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿嘿，我在这儿都听见多米尼克尖叫了。
他现在真的气坏了吗？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Poor little Dominic he won't dare mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
可怜的多米尼克，这下再也不敢惹我了。

scripts.text: [Eirinn]
scripts.translation: [艾琳]

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I haven't really eaten anything unusual these days but why am I getting stomach aches so often!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近也没吃什么奇怪的东西，怎么老是胃痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I haven't really eaten anything unusual these days but why am I getting stomach aches so often!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近也没吃什么奇怪的东西，怎么老是胃痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Are you still there?
Good, you came at just the right moment.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你还在吗？
很好，你来得正是时候。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I was going to get a perscription for my stomachache but, they don't have herbs for it in the warehouse anymore.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我本来想开点治胃痛的药，可仓库里的药草已经用完了。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Just like an old saying,
'Even green herbs are difficult to find when you need them.'
Could you go out and find herbs and things like that?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
俗话说得好：
“需要的时候，连绿色药草都找不到。”
你能出去帮我找些药草之类的东西吗？

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 为什么我要这么做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Fine, then don't bother me
and go away.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好吧，那就别来烦我了。
走开。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I need
^ff000010 Green Herbs^000000
I hope you hurry before Eclage is filled with the sounds of my groaning.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我需要
^ff000010 份绿色药草^000000
趁埃克拉珠到处都响起我的呻吟声之前，快去快回。

scripts.text: Give Herbs
scripts.translation: 给予药草

scripts.text: Go somewhere else.
scripts.translation: 去别的地方

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Didn't your kindergarten teacher tell you?
'Lying is bad!'
I wonder if she said something about helping those in need, too.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
幼儿园老师没教过你吗？
“说谎是不对的！”
她应该也教过你要帮助有困难的人吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ah, thank you so much!
I'll prepare my medicine then.
I hope it helps...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊，太感谢你了！
我这就去配药。
希望它能管用...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
By the way, I was looking through the warehouse and I found some herbs. They're not for stomachaches so, I'll give you some to repay your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
对了，我在仓库里翻到了一些药草。虽然治不了胃痛，就送给你，感谢你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
You can usually find them around here but it's really effective, so a lot of the adventurers like them.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
这附近通常就能找到这种药草，而且效果很好，很多冒险者都喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Something serious? Like, something untreatable??
Am I going to be like the leading actress who plays a tragic role in a soap opera?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
很严重吗？比如说...治不好？
难道我要像肥皂剧里演悲情戏的女主角一样了吗？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
If you remember any other stories, tell me again.
and if you remember, ask Cecilia why she asked such a question.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你要是还记得别的故事，记得再告诉我。
还有，记得问问塞西莉亚为什么打听这件事。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ah, before I had this stomach ache,
I borrowed a book.
It was about where you came from and it was really interesting. But why?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊，胃痛之前我借过一本书。
书里写的是你来自哪里，特别有意思。
不过，她为什么要问这个？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Cecilia is so random
She already knows that I like books...
Anyway, tell her I said so.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亚真是想到一出是一出。
她明明知道我喜欢看书...
总之，替我把话带给她。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Wing for wing, feeler for feeler, and trick for trick!
This is our law.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
以翅还翅，以触角还触角，以恶作剧还恶作剧！
这就是我们的规矩。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Since Dominic takes good care of the bookshelves, should I make a mess around that area to annoy him?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
多米尼克那么爱护书架，我是不是该在附近弄乱一点，好气气他？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Okay, I've decided.
Let me ask you another favor, please?
Could you bring me a plant stem and Green Herb, one each?
I'm going to do some magic here.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好，我决定了。
能再帮我一个忙吗？
请各带一份植物茎和绿色药草来。
我要在这里施个小魔法。

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 为什么我要这么做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Umm...I guess I can't help it if you don't want to.
I should look for someone else...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯...你不愿意的话，我也不能勉强。
看来只能找别人了...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
It's very simple, so it shouldn't take that long, right?
I'll be preparing here, so hurry and make a quick trip!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
事情很简单，不会花太久，对吧？
我会在这里准备，你快去快回！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
What I need is a stem of the plant and Green Herb, one each.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我需要各一份植物茎和绿色药草。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ta-da~
A simple summoning tool: sprout is finished!
It's available for everyone~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
锵锵~
简易召唤道具“嫩芽”完成了！
人人都能使用哦~

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Scripts written by Eirinn!
Featuring{0}!
The villain's role played by Dominic
We're all here and the props are ready!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
剧本：艾琳！
主演：{0}！
多米尼克出演反派！
人都到齐了，道具也准备好了！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Now if we plant this secretly around the bookshelves that Dominic is taking care of, our mission is completed!
If he finds random weeds growing near the bookshelves he'll be so mad, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
现在只要把它偷偷种在多米尼克照看的书架附近，任务就完成了！
他要是发现书架旁长出不知名的杂草，肯定会气坏的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Come on, it's no fun if you take too much time.
Let's go and do this thing!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
快点，磨蹭太久就不好玩了。
走，我们去干这件事！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Now, take this again and don't forget to plant it secretly around Dominic's bookshelves.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
拿好这个，别忘了偷偷种在多米尼克的书架附近。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Come on, it's no fun if you take too much time.
Let's go and do this thing!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
快点，磨蹭太久就不好玩了。
走，我们去干这件事！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Too bad I couldn't see for myself how he was creating a scene there.
I should try it again later.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
真可惜，没能亲眼看到他在那里大吵大闹。
以后得再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
How strange. I've been losing my stuff recently like things I put in my pocket or even the things I put away properly.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真奇怪。最近我老丢东西，连放进口袋或收好的东西也会不见。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Uh oh, you... didn't you promise
to give a good spanking to the little guys outside?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
哎呀，你...你不是答应要好好教训外面那些小家伙吗？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You'll see them right outside the door so I don't have to tell you the exact location right?
Give the 20 fairies outside what they deserve and come back, please~
scripts.translation:
[波本]
它们就在门外，我就不用特地告诉你位置了吧？
去把外面那20只妖精教训一顿，再回来，拜托啦~

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm? You're done already?
Puhahahah!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯？这么快就办完了？
噗哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
How strange...
I can't find my pen anywhere.
I've been using it pretty often...
Who would have done this to me...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真奇怪...
我的笔不见了，怎么找都找不到。
我最近明明常用它...
是谁干的呢...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
All of a sudden, people from Midgard started to visit Eclage more and more.
So, we're getting information about Midgard as well and I'm interested, too.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
最近来自米德加尔特的人突然越来越常来埃克拉珠。
所以我们也在打听米德加尔特的消息，我也很感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Books? Well, I like books a lot.
There are many books on Midgard that just came out recently so I read them myself.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
书？我很喜欢书。
米德加尔特最近出了不少新书，我自己也读了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm...I smell it...
I smell something fun going on here...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯...我闻到了...
这里好像有什么好玩的事...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
A real gentleman should give what he has received!
I will not tolerate this.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真正的绅士，有恩必报！
我可咽不下这口气。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Wooo, I'm on fire!!
My whole body is filled with the spirit of pranks!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
哇，我浑身都来劲了！！
身体里恶作剧的热情正熊熊燃烧！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good!
I'm ready as well.
Let's see...it's been a while since the last time I used a material conversion spell.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
好！
我也准备好了。
让我想想...我已经很久没用物质转换魔法了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
No, something's weird here.
I feel like there's something wrong.
Ah, whatever! Take this anyway.
I don't want to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
不对，这里好像有点古怪。
总觉得哪里不太对。
啊，算了！先拿着这个吧。
我不想再想了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Throw what you received in front of Dominic.
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
把你拿到的东西扔到多米尼克面前。
它会变成老鼠，在他身边跑来跑去。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Ahah~by the way,
What could Dominic have done about the rat?
It wouldn't come back at me like a boomerang, would it?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
啊哈~对了，多米尼克会拿那只老鼠怎么办？
它不会像回旋镖一样又飞回我这儿吧？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I hope he learned that I'm a step above him when it's comes to pranking, so that he won't try to mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
希望他能明白，论恶作剧我技高一筹，以后就不敢再来捉弄我了。

scripts.text: [Bourbon]
scripts.translation: [波本]

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Right, I'm sure the little pranksters outside are doing this to me.
They must have taken my stuff while I wasn't here.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
没错，肯定是外面那群小捣蛋鬼在搞鬼。
他们一定趁我不在时拿走了我的东西。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I would like to teach them a lesson but I have a work to do and I can't go anywhere.
And if I leave for personal reasons like this I'll get in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我也想教训他们，可我还有工作要做，不能离开。
要是为了这种私事擅离职守，我会挨骂的。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
So, you're here just in time!
Could you teach the little gangsters outside, a lesson on my behalf?
How does that sound, will you?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
你来得正好！
能替我教训一下外面那群小混混吗？
怎么样，肯帮忙吗？

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 为什么我要这么做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm, I guess I can't force you.
I should look for someone else...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯，我也不能强迫你。
看来只好找别人了...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good, you promised.
Go outside and give 20 fairies what they deserve.
Then I'll feel much better.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
很好，你答应了。
去外面教训那20只妖精一顿。
这样我就舒坦多了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You'll see them right outside the door so I don't have to tell you the exact location right?
Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[波本]
它们就在门外，我就不用特地告诉你位置了吧？
祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I think something went wrong here.
Could you talk to me again?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
好像出了点问题。
能再和我谈谈吗？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good luck, then.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
那么，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You need to brush off your clothes.
You have feathers all over.
Would it have been that hard...?
Hmm, it seems like you've suffered badly. Let me give you a reward.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
你得把衣服上的羽毛掸掉。
你身上沾得到处都是。
拍掉有那么难吗...？
嗯，看来你吃了不少苦头。让我给你点报酬吧。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Anyway, thanks.
But I feel like somebody took my pen while you were gone...who could it be...?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
总之，多谢了。
不过你离开的时候，好像有人拿走了我的笔...会是谁呢...？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
It doesn't seem like a perfect place to live but it definitely sounds like a fun place.
I wonder if there's any new book that came out...
I should go check.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
这里好像不算理想的居住地，不过听起来挺有意思。
不知道最近有没有新书出版...
我得去看看。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I was interested seeing how there's a sudden influx of visitors from your village into Eclage.
It doesn't seem like a perfect place to live but it definitely sounds like a fun place.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
最近突然有许多来自你们村子的人涌入埃克拉珠，这让我很感兴趣。
这里好像不算理想的居住地，不过听起来挺有意思。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Let's see what Dominic hates the most...
Ahah~I'm all fired up.
My name is Bourbon a real prankster from birth.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
让我想想多米尼克最讨厌什么...
啊哈~我已经迫不及待了。
我叫波本，天生就是个恶作剧高手。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'm sure he said he hates something small, swift, and with a long tail.
The more I think about doesn't it sound like a...rat?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我记得他说过，讨厌小小的、动作快、尾巴又长的东西。
这么一想...那不就是老鼠吗？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Right, it's a rat. Nothing's going to stop me now.
I shall release some rats then!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
没错，就是老鼠。谁也拦不住我了。
我要放几只老鼠出来！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
...but come to think of it there are no rats here, right?
Let me ask you another favor.
This is a matter of my pride. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
...不过仔细一想，这里没有老鼠吧？
我还想再拜托你一件事。
这关系到我的面子，你肯帮我吗？

scripts.text: I'd rather not...
scripts.translation: 我不想...

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
What? How could you!
Can't you hear my heart beating like a drum?
It's not reasonable if you pretend not to see and turn your back on me.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
什么？你怎么能这样！
你听不见我的心跳得像打鼓一样吗？
你装作没看见就转身走人，也太不够意思了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Now that's the spirit!
You're just like me a cheeky little monkey!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
这才像话！
你跟我一样，都是调皮的小猴子！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'll fill you in on the details once we're done preparing and what we need right now is 2 rat tails
Obviously we don't have rats here so it might take you sometime to find one.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
等我们准备好了，我再告诉你详情。
眼下先帮我找两根鼠尾。
这里当然没有老鼠，你可能得花点时间找找。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Thanks, my friend.
Hahahahaha!
We're already in the same camp.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
谢啦，朋友。
哈哈哈哈！
咱们现在可是同一阵营了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
...umm?
You couldn't find any rat tails yet?
I know it's pretty hard but I'm counting on you, my friend!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
...嗯？
你还没找到鼠尾吗？
我知道这不容易，就拜托你了，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You see, this is just a small tail right now but it'll be a great...
well, it's just a rat and not a 'great' rat after all but still, with a mysterious power
scripts.translation:
[波本]
你看，它现在只是一截小尾巴，不过很快就会变成了不起的...
嗯，说到底它只是只老鼠，算不上什么了不起的老鼠，不过还是有股神秘力量的。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Shazam! The spell is now done.
Throw what you received next to Dominic!
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
This completes our 'mission'!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
沙赞！咒语完成了。
把你拿到的东西扔到多米尼克旁边！
它会变成老鼠，在他身边跑来跑去。
这样我们的“任务”就完成了！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
hehehe...
I'm soooo excited.
What are you doing? Go!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嘿嘿嘿...
我兴奋得不得了。
你还愣着干什么？快去！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Throw this in front of Dominic.
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
把这个扔到多米尼克面前。
它会变成老鼠，在他身边跑来跑去。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
hehehe....
I'm soooo excited.
What are you doing? Go!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嘿嘿嘿...
我兴奋得不得了。
你还愣着干什么？快去！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'm sure Dominic couldn't have movednot even a finger.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我敢肯定，多米尼克连一根手指都动不了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I hope he learned that I'm a step above him when it's comes to pranking, so that he won't try to mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
希望他能明白，论恶作剧我技高一筹，以后就不敢再捉弄我了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mm...mm... what should I do...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
嗯...嗯...我该怎么办...

scripts.text: - She seems too busy to talk to you. -
scripts.translation: - 她看起来忙得没空理你。 -

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mm...mm...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
嗯...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
What should I do?
No matter how many times I check some items are missing...
Is it because of the wanderers randomly showing up in town nowadays?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
怎么办才好？
不管我检查多少遍，总有些东西不见了...
是因为最近镇上常有外来者出没吗？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Hey~ hey~ listen!
Hey you, what are you doing over there?
You heard everything I said just now didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
喂~喂~听我说！
你在那边干什么呢？
刚才我说的话，你都听见了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It can't be that we have thieves in Eclage.
The more I think about it seems like an outsider is responsible for this.
Don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
埃克拉珠怎么可能会有窃贼呢？
越想越觉得是外来者干的。
你说是不是？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
For that reason you, who knows that our supplies are missing and who happens to be an outsider as well.
Must be a thief!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你知道我们的物资失窃，又刚好是个外来者。
所以窃贼肯定就是你！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You have the right to have an attorney present and... no, never mind.
Let's hear what you have to say after putting you in prison first.
Here, you're accused of stealing how do you feel now?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你有权要求律师到场...不，算了。
先把你关起来，再听你怎么说。
喂，被指控偷窃是什么感觉？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You see, we suffer an unforeseen misfortune in life sometimes.
We're all like that.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你看，人生难免会遭遇意外。
谁都一样。

scripts.text: [Cecilia]
scripts.translation: [塞西莉亚]

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, you want to exercise your right and just remain silent?
Let's see how long you can hold your tongue!
I have an idea. Do you want to hear about it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
哦，你要行使沉默权？
我倒要看看你能沉默多久！
我有个主意，想听听吗？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你到底在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Here's your last chance!
It's something that could save both of us.
You want to hear about it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
这是你最后的机会！
这办法能救我们两个。
想听听吗？

scripts.text: I don't want to!
scripts.translation: 我不想听！

scripts.text: Fine.
scripts.translation: 好吧

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, well!
Then I'll have to hand you over to prove my innocence.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
好吧！
那我只好把你交出去，证明自己的清白了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What kind of a fairy is this, so immoral?!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（这是什么妖精啊，怎么这么没道德？！）

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Now, should I start to plant evidence on you?
You just need three fairies to make up anything even if it's the Yggdrasil Tree.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
现在，我该开始在你身上栽赃了吗？
只要三个妖精，哪怕是世界树也能编出来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Maybe I should just run away.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（要不我还是逃跑吧。）

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
There's a simple and ordinary solution for this.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
这事有个简单直接的解决办法。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
That is you finding what's missing and refilling the shelves.
I can't go anywhere because I have to look after the warehouse.
It's better to take some trouble than being accused of stealing, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你去把丢失的东西找回来，补满货架就行。
我得留在仓库看守，哪儿也去不了。
总比被当成窃贼强，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Let me tell you what you need to find.
First of all, ^66000010 Piles of Acorns^000000, ^66000010 Worn Out Pages^000000, and lastly, ^66000010 Mould Powders^000000.
It's strange how 10 of each item are missing exactly...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我告诉你要找什么。
先找^66000010堆橡果^000000、^66000010页破旧书页^000000，最后是^66000010份霉菌粉末^000000。
奇怪的是，每种东西都恰好少了10个...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
We're in the same boatnow.
Technically, we call it 'accomplices'.
Now, good luck!
You'll be able to find them easily around here.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
现在咱们是一条船上的人了。
说得准确些，就是“共犯”。
那就祝你好运！
在这附近应该不难找到。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You didn't get caught, right?
Let's see what you have then...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你没被抓到吧？
让我看看你带回了什么...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's still not enough...
You didn't forget what I asked for, did you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
还不够...
我交代你找的东西，你没忘吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You're more skilled than I thought.
Everything is as written in the books now.
So, we're both safe.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你比我想的能干。
现在货架上的东西都和账本对上了。
这样我们就都没事了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You need to find Piles of Acorns, Worn Out Pages, and Mould Powders, 10 of each.
Don't forget this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
橡果堆、破旧书页和霉菌粉末，各找10份。
这次可别忘了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
When you come back again you'd better be bringing everything we need.
If they find out that some items are missing, then...
No, I don't want to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
下次回来时，最好把要找的东西全带齐。
要是他们发现东西少了...
不，我不敢想下去。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
We're in this together so I don't have to thank you, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
咱们是一伙的，我就不用谢你了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I'll go check if there's anything else missing as well.
It's so strange how these missing items were all very trivial.
Besides, exactly 10 of each item were stolen.
I feel like this is more than just a theft.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我也去检查一下还有没有别的东西不见了。
奇怪的是，丢的都是些不起眼的小东西，而且每种还恰好少了10个。
我觉得这不像单纯的盗窃。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
How strange...
I'm sure I organized everything but why is it so messy here.
Could it be that someone really hates me...?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
真奇怪...
我明明都整理好了，这里怎么又乱成这样？
难道有人真的这么讨厌我吗...？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, by the way,
I heard you met Eirinn and Bourbon.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
哦，对了，我听说你遇到了艾琳和波本。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I heard Eirinn has a stomachache and I also heard that you helped Bourbon find lost items.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我听说艾琳胃痛，还听说你帮波本找到了丢失的物品。

scripts.text: - Cecilia seems to be lost in deep thought -
scripts.translation: - 塞西莉亚似乎陷入了沉思 -

[塞西莉亚]
...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
If things that have never happened before happened, then there's something new going on.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
发生了从前没发生过的事，就说明最近出了新状况。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Now, shall we go find out what it is?
This time, it's not a theft, of course.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我们去查清楚是什么情况吧？
当然，这次不是调查失窃。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Could you go ask Eirinn and Bourbon about reading books?
Ask them if they have borrowed or read any books recently.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你能去问问艾琳和波本最近读书的事吗？
问问他们最近有没有借书或看书。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Could you go ask Eirinn and Bourbon about reading books?
Ask them if they have borrowed or read any books recently.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你能去问问艾琳和波本最近读书的事吗？
问问他们最近有没有借书或看书。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I met both of them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已经见过他们两个了。

scripts.text: ^000088You tellCecilia what Eirinn and Bourbon said.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000088你把艾琳和波本说的话告诉了塞西莉亚。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mmm, I see.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
So, they have recently borrowed and read books, too?
Good, this solves the mystery!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
所以他们最近也借过书、读过书？
好，谜团解开了！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I borrowed some books as well to learn about people from Midgard since there are so many visitors coming from that area lately.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
最近有很多米德加尔特的访客来这里，所以我也借了几本书，想了解一下他们。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Eirinn, Bourbon, and I have one thing in common.
That is, we all read books recently.
But I don't understand why that brought bad luck to all three of us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我、艾琳和波本有个共同点：
我们最近都读过书。
可我不明白，为什么这会给我们三人都带来厄运。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I have a feeling that Dominic might know something.
He might know...or...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我觉得多米尼克可能知道些什么。
他也许知道...或者...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Eirinn, Bourbon, and I have one thing in common.
That is, we all read books recently.
But I don't understand why that brought bad luck to all three of us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我、艾琳和波本有个共同点：
我们最近都读过书。
可我不明白，为什么这会给我们三人都带来厄运。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, did you visit Dominic by any chance?
Dominic takes care of the bookshelves and I feel like he might know something.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
对了，你有没有去找过多米尼克？
他负责管理书架，我觉得他可能知道些什么。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, and as the manager of the warehouse let me give you something in return.
You found lost items and helped here and there...so, think of it as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
作为仓库管理员，我也该给你点回报。
你帮忙找回了失物，还到处帮了不少忙...
就把这个当作谢礼吧。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You'll be able to read as many books as you want from the bookshelves in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
广场书架上的书，你想看哪本都可以。

scripts.text: [Cecilia]
scripts.translation: [塞西莉亚]

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I have a feeling that Dominic might know something.
He might know...or...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我觉得多米尼克可能知道些什么。
他也许知道...或者...

scripts.text: Tell Cecilia about Dominic.
scripts.translation: 告诉塞西莉亚多米尼克的事

[塞西莉亚]
...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
So I was right.
It was somebody's prank.
Dominic has always been like that so petty and strange.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
看来我猜对了。
原来是有人在恶作剧。
多米尼克一直都这么小心眼，又古怪。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I hope you don't misunderstand us.
Most of the residents in Eclage;
No, an absolute majority of the residents here are never against outsiders.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
希望你别误会我们。
埃克拉珠的大多数居民——
不，绝大部分居民都不排斥外来者。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's just Dominic who's acting very weirdly so I hope you don't have a prejudice against us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
只有多米尼克的举止特别古怪，希望你别因此对我们抱有成见。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Anyway, now that I found out about it,
I shouldn't just sit silently!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
总之，既然我已经查清楚了，就不能继续坐视不理！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Let's start planning for revenge, shall we?
I'll give Eirinn and Bourbon notice in advance.
You should go talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我们来计划一下怎么报复他吧？
我会先通知艾琳和波本。
你也去跟他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I'll get permission from above so that you can read any books from the bookshelves that Dominic is in charge of.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我会向上面申请许可，让你可以阅读多米尼克负责的书架上的书。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's about where you came from and I'm sure you'll like it.
If your perspective on something changes, the way you evaluate that object changes as well.
Explore Midgard from our perspective~!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
书里写的是你来自的地方，我相信你会喜欢。
看待事物的角度变了，评价也会随之改变。
从我们的视角探索米德加尔特吧~！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Hope you have a good time in Eclage.
I have to take inventory now,
so I can't talk to you anymore, sorry~
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
祝你在埃克拉珠玩得愉快。
我得去盘点库存了，抱歉，不能再陪你聊天了~

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Mmm...what do you want?
I won't stop you from walking around in Eclage but I hope you don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嗯...你有什么事？
我不拦着你在埃克拉珠四处走动，只要别来烦我就行。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I won't stop you from walking around in Eclage but, don't bother me you outsider!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我不拦着你在埃克拉珠四处走动，但别来烦我，你这个外来者！

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Bah, tell them if you want to!
I'm not scared at all.
They should know how scary I can be.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哼，爱告诉谁就告诉谁！
我才不怕呢。
他们最好知道我有多厉害。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I feel...something's not right.
I feel like something bad is going to happen any minute...
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我觉得...好像有点不对劲。
总觉得马上就要出什么事了...

scripts.text: Cecilia says...
scripts.translation: 塞西莉亚说...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Cecilia told me that someone's fooling around with people who borrowed books recently.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塞西莉亚告诉我，有人最近一直在捉弄借过书的人。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Huh? Kekeke.
In principle, people living here in the capital of Eclage are not supposed to discriminate against outsiders, but not everyone is like that.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哈？呵呵。
原则上，住在埃克拉珠首都的人不该歧视外来者，但也不是人人都这么想。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I hate it so much when people in Eclage are talking about Midgard.
Why are they so fascinated about foreign areas when this place is perfect and peaceful.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我最讨厌埃克拉珠的人谈论米德加尔特。
这里明明完美又和平，他们为什么对外面的地方那么着迷？

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I don't like fairies here writing about Midgard nowadays and I hate how those books are distributed far and wide.
So, I decided to play a little trick on them.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我不喜欢这里的妖精最近写米德加尔特，更讨厌这些书到处流传。
所以我决定给他们一点教训。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Bah, tell them if you want to!
I'm not scared at all.
They should know how scary I can be.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哼，爱告诉谁就告诉谁！
我才不怕呢。
他们最好知道我有多厉害。

scripts.text: - Do you want to throw the rat tail? -
scripts.translation: - 要把鼠尾扔出去吗？ -

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: - The rat tail became a rat even before hitting the ground. -
scripts.translation: - 鼠尾还没落地，就变成了一只老鼠。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
What, where did it come from out of the blue!
I'm sure people from Midgard brought it here!
You little filthy thing, ah!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
什么？这东西怎么突然冒出来了！
肯定是米德加尔特的人带来的！
你这脏东西，啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(His reaction is not that fun.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他的反应没那么有趣。）

scripts.text: - You were told to plant weeds. -
scripts.translation: - 你被要求种些杂草。 -

scripts.text: Don't do it.
scripts.translation: 不种

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 种吧

scripts.text: - Plant weeds secretly . -
scripts.translation: - 悄悄种下杂草。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Hey, what are you doing over there?
You'd better not be doing anything weird.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嘿，你在那边做什么？
最好别搞什么鬼。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Mmm...what the...
Why are weeds growing here?
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嗯...这是什么...
这里怎么长出杂草了？

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Well, I don't care.
I guess there's no such thing as 'weeds.' Every plant is special in its own way.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
算了，我不在乎。
说不定根本没有“杂草”这种东西，每种植物都有自己的特别之处。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What's up with his reaction?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他这反应是怎么回事？）

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看见一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是一本关于米德加尔特的书。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Hey, outsider who said you can touch my books?
Stay away from my bookshelves!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
喂，外来者，谁准你碰我的书了？
离我的书架远点！

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -
scripts.translation: - 我看见一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是一本关于卢恩·米德加兹城市的书。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 离书架远点

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看书架

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我还是别看了。

scripts.text: Prontera, the capital of Rune-Midgarts, is filled with beautiful buildings that were thoroughly designed.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹的首都普隆德拉，到处都是精心设计的美丽建筑。

scripts.text: Here, they have a leader called 'king,' who used to arrange marriages.
scripts.translation: 这里的统治者被称为“国王”，过去还会替人安排婚姻。

scripts.text: There are many arenas, in which warriors race and wrestle to compete with each other.
scripts.translation: 这里有许多竞技场，战士们会在那里赛跑、摔跤，一较高下。

scripts.text: The group of winners are supposedly to get some kind of rewards, but seems like it lost its popularity nowadays.
scripts.translation: 据说胜者能得到某种奖励，不过这些比赛如今似乎已经不流行了。

scripts.text: You need to be careful because there are some people in Prontera with superhuman powers.
scripts.translation: 要小心，普隆德拉有些人拥有超凡的力量。

scripts.text: They're able to destroy any type of weapons or armors with a few punches, and what they use for that is just a small hammer.
scripts.translation: 他们只用几拳就能砸坏任何武器或盔甲，手里拿的却只是一把小锤子。

scripts.text: I don't understand why adventurers keep laying tools at their feet. Could it be that they're priests and people are offering a tribute to them?
scripts.translation:
我不明白冒险者为什么总把工具放在他们脚边。
难道他们是祭司，人们在向他们献祭吗？

scripts.text: There's a village called Payon in the forest. It has a place called 'Palace' as well, although its purpose is unclear.
scripts.translation: 森林里有个叫斐扬的村庄，那里还有一处“宫殿”，用途不明。

scripts.text: Maybe it's a place used before Prontera became the capital of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation: 也许那是普隆德拉成为卢恩·米德加兹首都之前留下的...

scripts.text: Humans, too, establish border towns close to the boundary of their residential area, and the city of Aldebaran is one of them.
scripts.translation: 人类也会在居住区边界附近建立边境城镇，阿尔德巴兰就是其中之一。

scripts.text: In the middle of the village, there are clock-shaped monsters living in a clock tower. Further investigation is needed to find out why monsters appear in the middle of the village.
scripts.translation:
村子中央有座钟楼，里面住着钟形魔物。
为什么村子中央会出现魔物，还得继续调查。

scripts.text: Although it's called a clock tower, there are more monsters inside than clocks. I personally count them my self, I really did!
scripts.translation:
虽然叫钟楼，里面的魔物却比钟还多。
我自己数过，真的！

scripts.text: Geffen, a city built by great wizards, is characterized by Tower of Wizards in the middle of the city.
scripts.translation: 吉芬是伟大魔法师建造的城市，最显眼的就是城中央的魔法师之塔。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, there's a fountain in the center of Prontera, a clock tower in Aldebaran, and a tower in Geffen as well.
scripts.translation: 仔细想想，普隆德拉中央有喷泉，阿尔德巴兰有钟楼，吉芬也有一座塔。

scripts.text: Maybe human's urban planning is based on symmetry or circular placement. I think it's less sophisticated.
scripts.translation:
人类的城市规划或许讲究对称或环形布局。
我觉得这可不怎么高明。

scripts.text: Izlude is a port city and is the gateway to Prontera. Since humans can't fly, they travel in big boxes.
scripts.translation:
依斯鲁得是座港口城市，也是通往普隆德拉的门户。
人类不会飞，所以只能坐大箱子旅行。

scripts.text: I'm sure they think that big boxes made a great contribution to their civilization...but is it true?
scripts.translation:
我敢说，他们觉得大箱子对文明贡献很大...
真有那么神奇吗？

scripts.text: Alberta is a place that people of Rune-Midgarts visit when they need to travel to other countries.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹的人要去别的国家时，常会经过艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: There are many ships--a moving box that floats on water--ready and people travel on them.
scripts.translation:
那里有许多船——也就是能浮在水上的移动箱子——
人们会搭船出行。

scripts.text: Seriously, human capability is...so disappointing. If they're wise enough, they'll use Warp-portal.
scripts.translation:
说真的，人类的本事真让人失望...
聪明的话，直接用空间传送术不就好了。

scripts.text: Morocc Village is known to be a place where Morocc, the king of demons, rests.
scripts.translation: 梦罗克村据说是恶魔之王梦罗克的栖身之处。

scripts.text: Making waterways and lakes in the barren inhospitable desert...what an exceptional piece of work for humans.
scripts.translation:
在荒凉的不毛沙漠里开凿水道和湖泊...
人类还真做了件了不起的事。

scripts.text: I think it's a very peaceful place...at least until monsters appear in the buildings where their leader is burried.
scripts.translation:
我觉得那里很宁静...
至少在魔物出现在首领长眠的建筑里之前是这样。

scripts.text: There is the sea in the east of Rune-Midgarts, a desert in the south, forest and vegetation in the middle, and mountains in the north.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹东临大海，南接沙漠，中部遍布森林与植被，北部则是群山。

scripts.text: If you ask children to draw a world, wouldn't they draw it like this?
scripts.translation: 如果让孩子画出一个世界，他们不也会画成这样吗？

scripts.text: However, it's not an ideal place nor is it a great place to live.
scripts.translation: 不过，那地方既不理想，也不适合居住。

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -
scripts.translation: - 我看见一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是一本关于卢恩·米德加兹城市的书。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 离书架远点

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看书架

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我还是别看了。

scripts.text: Humans often find great joy in venturing their lives in uncertain future.
scripts.translation: 人类常常会为了未知的未来冒险，并从中获得极大的乐趣。

scripts.text: Comodo is a place for people who gamble with their future for something called 'fortune.' It seems irrelevant to ruling the kingdom though.
scripts.translation:
克魔岛的人为了所谓的“运气”赌上自己的未来。
不过，这似乎跟治理王国没什么关系。

scripts.text: Unidentifiable groups such as 'Female and Foot Volleyball' and 'Play Ranking Committee' got rid of games in that city.
scripts.translation: “女子与脚排球”和“游戏排名委员会”这类来历不明的团体，把城里的比赛都取消了。

scripts.text: Comodo was known to be a beach city filled with pleasure, and it used to be a place where you could find all sorts of entertainment. But I can't really say if it's still like that.
scripts.translation:
克魔岛曾是座充满欢乐的海滨城市，过去能在那里找到各种娱乐。
不过现在是否依然如此，我就不清楚了。

scripts.text: There's a female priest, who is admired by the people of the village, and there seems to be good reasons for her existence.
scripts.translation: 村里有位受人敬仰的女祭司，她的存在似乎自有其道理。

scripts.text: People bring her diamonds as a tribute, and she gives them gods' gifts in return. Although it seems like you have to be pretty lucky to receive it...
scripts.translation:
人们献上钻石作为贡品，她则回赠神明的礼物。
不过，想得到礼物似乎还得有相当好的运气...

scripts.text: First of all, I would like to start this book by expressing my respect to the challenging spirit of humans.
scripts.translation: 这本书开篇，我想先向勇于挑战的人类致敬。

scripts.text: In Umbala, where a gigantic tree forms a village, there are people who challenge themselves to jump off from tall trees for various reasons.
scripts.translation: 汶巴拉是一座由巨树构成的村庄，那里的人会因为各种理由挑战从高树上跳下。

scripts.text: It's kind of strange if you think about it. I thought jumping off from a tree was a type of coming-of-age ceremony for human males. I can't believe there's another reason for it.
scripts.translation:
仔细想想，这还真奇怪。
我以为从树上跳下来是人类男性的成年礼，没想到还有别的理由。

scripts.text: Comodo is the only village in the southern part of this continent.
scripts.translation: 克魔岛是这片大陆南部唯一的村庄。

scripts.text: Then, what is Paros Lighthouse for?
scripts.translation: 那么，帕乐斯灯塔又是做什么用的？

scripts.text: Further investigation is delayed because only a sailor is stationed in that area currently and I couldn't find any evidence to suggest that a political or social organization is involved in that area.
scripts.translation: 目前那一带只有一名水手驻守，也没有证据表明那里有政治或社会团体活动，因此调查只好暂时搁置。

scripts.text: You can get to an island called Bahia by boat, and you can find an underground cave there.
scripts.translation: 乘船可以抵达一座名为巴伊亚的岛屿，岛上有个地下洞窟。

scripts.text: The existence of such a deep and long cave in an island is a geographical mystery!
scripts.translation: 岛上竟有如此深邃漫长的洞窟，真是地理学上的谜团！

scripts.text: Moreover, would any scholar be able to explain how humans here can breathe without gills in a place filled with water?
scripts.translation:
而且，谁能解释人类为何能在水下呼吸？
那里明明全是水，他们又没有鳃。

scripts.text: Prontera is a big city, so ensuring the stable supply of resources is very important.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉是座大城市，稳定供应各类资源至关重要。

scripts.text: Especially, the supply of water resources is important for humans are vulnerable and they can't survive even for 30 days without water.
scripts.translation: 尤其是水，人类很脆弱，没有水连30天都活不了。

scripts.text: Therefore, they built a huge building that looks like a water and sewer facility...
scripts.translation: 所以他们建造了一座巨大的建筑，看起来像是供水和排污设施...

scripts.text: But why can't I find the entrance inside the city? Is it a structural problem? Or is it for security?
scripts.translation:
可为什么我在城里找不到入口？
是建筑结构的问题，还是出于安全考虑？

scripts.text: Glast Heim, the ruins of what was once a great castle.
scripts.translation: 格拉斯特海姆——一座宏伟古堡的废墟。

scripts.text: Soon, they're going to reveal what have happened here and the story behind it. So, let's focus on the development of the situation.
scripts.translation:
这里发生过什么、背后又有什么故事，很快就会揭晓。
我们还是关注事态的发展吧。

scripts.text: Anyway, there are a number of monsters living together in more than 10 regions; all in the upper and lower parts of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 格拉斯特海姆的上层和下层分布着十多个区域，许多魔物在其中栖息。

scripts.text: More detailed geographic information on this region is...so limited that I want to just grab any urban engineer by the collar and start asking.
scripts.translation:
这个地区的详细地理资料少得可怜...
真想揪住哪个城市规划师的衣领问个明白。

scripts.text: Although human civilization is advanced enough to establish a country, humans are not accumulating knowledge but merely shifting their focus from one to another,
scripts.translation: 人类文明已经发展到足以建立国家，却没有积累知识，只是不断把注意力从一处转向另一处，

scripts.text: and it seems like they're no longer able to differentiate a certain tree or grass from another.
scripts.translation: 他们似乎连不同种类的树木和草都分辨不出来。

scripts.text: Otherwise, they wouldn't have named this well-organized forest as 'the mysterious forest.' I can't believe they gave such a strange name to this forest just because they can't find their way out.
scripts.translation:
要不然，他们怎么会把这片规划整齐的森林叫作“神秘森林”？
仅仅因为找不到路，就起这么奇怪的名字，真让人想不通。

scripts.text: They might have believed that language is an exclusive possession of human. But I'm sure they changed their mind after meeting us, the fairies.
scripts.translation:
他们或许曾认为语言是人类独有的。
不过遇见我们这些妖精后，我相信他们改变想法了。

scripts.text: However, they're not surprised to see that some cats, much bigger in size than normal ones, are living in a socialized society and are able to communicate with humans.
scripts.translation: 可他们看到有些猫比普通猫大得多，还能组成社会、与人类交流，居然一点也不惊讶。

scripts.text: There's something I don't know. Should I reveal the truth?
scripts.translation:
有件事我还不清楚。
要把真相揭露出来吗？

scripts.text: Breaking News: Thoughts on a secret place.
scripts.translation: 突发消息：关于一处秘密地点的见闻

scripts.text: There is constant exploitation and harassment going on in a monastery, not far from Prontera.
scripts.translation: 离普隆德拉不远的一座修道院里，剥削和骚扰的事一直在发生。

scripts.text: They lure people who attempt to walk in god's way and make them gather mushrooms or run long distances...why is this acceptable!
scripts.translation: 他们诱骗那些想走在神之道上的人，叫他们采蘑菇或长跑...这怎么能被允许！

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about the northern parts of Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看见一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是一本关于米德加尔特北部的书。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 离书架远点

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看书架

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我还是别看了。

scripts.text: Humans continued to float big boxes on water and the sea, and finally, they began to use the sky.
scripts.translation: 人类先让大箱子漂在江河和海上，后来甚至开始征服天空。

scripts.text: Where are they going next? Underground? Or are they going to transcend time and space?
scripts.translation: 他们下一步要去哪里？地下？还是要穿越时空？

scripts.text: At this rate, people will be willing to travel to the past. Human's technological advancements require attention.
scripts.translation: 照这样下去，人类说不定还想回到过去。人类科技的发展可得好好留意。

scripts.text: Einbroch is filled with machines. They don't seem to manufacture a lot of industrial goods, but machines are their weapons definitely.
scripts.translation: 艾音布罗克到处都是机器。这里似乎不怎么生产工业品，不过机器肯定就是他们的武器。

scripts.text: What are those numerous factories producing, and for what are people working?
scripts.translation: 那么多工厂到底在生产什么？人们又是为了什么而工作？

scripts.text: Don't they know that civilization development doesn't necessarily improve the value of life?
scripts.translation: 他们难道不知道，文明进步未必能提升生活的价值吗？

scripts.text: If you take a train in Einbroch, you can get to a village called Einbech.
scripts.translation: 从艾音布罗克搭火车，就能到达一个叫艾音贝赫的村庄。

scripts.text: Of course I hate this form of transportation (smells like iron too much), but it's a useful for humans because of its cheap price and transport capacity.
scripts.translation: 我当然讨厌这种交通工具（铁锈味实在太重），不过它价格便宜、载货量大，对人类来说倒是很实用。

scripts.text: By the way, don't they have enough materials to make railroad tracks? When will they make extensions to the train routes?
scripts.translation: 说起来，他们的材料还不够铺铁轨吗？什么时候才会延长火车路线呢？

scripts.text: Hugel, a small rural village, is like Comodo of southern region.
scripts.translation: 毁葛是座小乡村，就像南方的克魔岛。

scripts.text: There are a variety of mini games and the landscape is very idyllic as well.
scripts.translation: 那里有各种小游戏，风景也很田园。

scripts.text: But aren't those entertainment facilities supposed to be in the center of a country?
scripts.translation: 不过，这些娱乐设施不是应该建在国家中心地带吗？

scripts.text: A city called Juno is even floating in the sky! How incredible is this.
scripts.translation: 竟然有座叫朱诺的城市漂浮在空中！太不可思议了。

scripts.text: And there is a special reward for those who escape the maze: there is a place where rebirth is given.
scripts.translation: 逃出迷宫的人还能获得特别奖励：那里有个能让人转生的地方。

scripts.text: Humans are truly scary. But I feel like I've seen this maze somewhere...
scripts.translation: 人类真可怕。不过，我好像在哪里见过这个迷宫...

scripts.text: In Rahel, the capital of Arunafeltz, there lives a small, cute, and white creature that seems really soft.
scripts.translation: 阿鲁纳佩斯首都拉赫的居民中，有一种小巧可爱、通体雪白，看起来软绵绵的生物。

scripts.text: If you thought of Siroma, you are wrong. It's not marine either.
scripts.translation: 如果你想到小雪兽，那就错了。它也不是海洋生物。

scripts.text: The answer is a girl who is both a priest and a leader. This is because Arunafeltz is a theocratic entity.
scripts.translation: 答案是一位女孩，她既是祭司，也是领袖。毕竟阿鲁纳佩斯是个神权国家。

scripts.text: In the plains of Audhumbla, there lives many monster flowers and herbivore animals.
scripts.translation: 奥丁神殿原野上生活着许多魔物花和食草动物。

scripts.text: Although one would think that they are not herbivores seeing how they attack humans, but
scripts.translation: 看到它们攻击人类，你或许会觉得它们不像食草动物，不过——

scripts.text: if they were really carnivores, what food would they live on? Moreover, there is no record of them eating the adventurers who travel by after attacking them.
scripts.translation: 如果它们真是肉食动物，又靠什么为生呢？而且，它们攻击路过的冒险者后，也没有把人吃掉的记录。

scripts.text: Veins, a village built on a hill, seems like a well-planned city.
scripts.translation: 伯仁斯这座建在山丘上的村庄，看起来规划得井井有条。

scripts.text: While it's confusing to know where you would exit and enter from, but
scripts.translation: 虽然让人摸不着头脑，不知道该从哪里进出，不过——

scripts.text: if you want to see interesting sights such as a stone eating up a coin you dropped, it's a good place to visit.
scripts.translation: 如果你想看看石头吞掉你掉落的硬币之类的奇景，这里倒值得一游。

scripts.text: There was also a place that was extremely hot somewhere in Arunafeltz..
scripts.translation: 阿鲁纳佩斯某处还有个热得惊人的地方...

scripts.text: The heat there felt like it would burn through my wings in their entirety. The residents of that place also did not seem very friendly.
scripts.translation: 那里的热浪像是要把我的翅膀整个烧焦，居民看起来也不太友善。

scripts.text: So I had to stop the expedition. I hope that you, the readers, would also distance yourselves from that place.
scripts.translation: 所以我只好中止探险。读者们也最好离那地方远点。

scripts.text: Well...It's not that I was afraid of the guardian there, you see!
scripts.translation: 我可不是害怕那里的守卫哦！

scripts.text: In Lighthalzen, there is a colossal building constructed by technicians. Although what they exactly do in there is a little suspicious...
scripts.translation: 里希塔乐镇有座由技术人员建造的巨型建筑，他们在里面究竟做什么，实在令人起疑...

scripts.text: I'm not sure if a profit-seeking corporation should be doing something like that.
scripts.translation: 我不确定以营利为目的的企业是否该做这种事。

scripts.text: It's also very strange that clean and dirty areas in the city are divided...
scripts.translation: 而且，城里的干净区和脏乱区竟然分得泾渭分明...

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about various regions in Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是介绍米德加尔特各地的书。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 离书架远点

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看书架

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我还是别看了。

scripts.text: If you ride the boats in Alberta, you can get to various destinations.
scripts.translation: 从艾尔贝塔搭船，可以前往许多地方。

scripts.text: I don't know why so many of these boats end up at Alberta specifically, but for that, traveling is much easier.
scripts.translation: 不知道为什么那么多航线都从艾尔贝塔出发，不过这样旅行确实方便多了。

scripts.text: Places you can reach through Alberta are as follows.
scripts.translation: 从艾尔贝塔可以前往这些地方：

scripts.text: A country of Gods, Amatsu, a place of refuge, Kunlun, Luoyang where many martial art experts reside, Ayothaya in which a huge sculpture is present, and many others.
scripts.translation: 诸神之国天津町、避世之地昆仑、武术高手云集的洛阳、矗立着巨大雕像的哎哟泰雅，还有许多别处。

scripts.text: I can see that more places would be available in the future as delegates from many other countries are arriving there more recently.
scripts.translation: 最近许多国家的使节都抵达了那里，看来今后还会有更多地方开放通行。

scripts.text: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is one famous destination.
scripts.translation: 有个地方是搭船能去的著名目的地。

scripts.text: Regrettably for them, they didn't take me just because I am a lone traveler. It wasn't even that they would give me a discount on the boat ride.
scripts.translation: 可惜他们没肯载我这个独自旅行的人，连船票折扣都不给。

scripts.text: As a scholar, I couldn't be more enraged by the ignorance of the Jawaii-bound ship's captain. Even during wars, historians are exempt from hostility.
scripts.translation: 身为学者，我对那位前往爪哇伊的船长的无知怒不可遏。即使身处战乱，历史学家也不该遭受敌意。

scripts.text: Also from Alberta, there is an island known for its high concentration of turtles.
scripts.translation: 从艾尔贝塔还能前往一座以海龟众多闻名的岛屿。

scripts.text: There are no regular routes, but after a long research, I found out that there is a captain who travels specifically to that place.
scripts.translation: 那里没有固定航线，不过经过一番调查，我发现有位船长专程前往。

scripts.text: Upon getting there, there were many exotic turtles including cold turtles, hot turtles, and ninja turtles.
scripts.translation: 到了那里，我看见各种奇特的乌龟：冰龟、火龟，还有忍者龟。

scripts.text: From Clock Tower Village, I could arrive at a snowing village through an elderly man who wears thick, red clothes all year around.
scripts.translation: 从钟楼村出发，找一位全年穿着厚重红衣的老人，就能抵达一座雪村。

scripts.text: The entire village was covered by snow, and as expected from a place that is preparing for a celebration, the atmosphere was great.
scripts.translation: 整个村庄都被白雪覆盖。那里正在筹备庆典，气氛果然很热闹。

scripts.text: Inside the village, there was also a place that produces toys for children, but for some reason, they chased me out.
scripts.translation: 村里还有一家生产玩具的工厂，不知为何，他们却把我赶了出来。

scripts.text: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is a small island where a wrecked ship rests.
scripts.translation: 搭船能去的地方中，还有一座小岛，搁浅的船只就停在那里。

scripts.text: I'm not sure if the ship was to be salvaged, but it was already occupied by strange creatures.
scripts.translation: 我不清楚那艘船是不是准备打捞，不过已经有奇怪的生物占据了那里。

scripts.text: The main god of the faith practiced in this continent is Odin. Accordingly, there is a temple for Odin as well.
scripts.translation: 这片大陆信奉的主神是奥丁，因此也建有奥丁神殿。

scripts.text: I was also outcasted here. People had no conception of hospitality and generosity toward outsiders.
scripts.translation: 我在那里也被排斥了。人们对外来者毫无待客之道，更谈不上慷慨。

scripts.text: Near the south of the village were some docks. I researched a long time to see how these docks were being used, but I just couldn't find the answer.
scripts.translation: 村子南边有几个码头。我调查了很久，想弄清楚它们的用途，却始终没有头绪。

scripts.text: But soon, I discovered the destination from those docks by following adventurers who secretly utilized them.
scripts.translation: 后来我跟着偷偷使用码头的冒险者，总算发现了他们前往的地方。

scripts.text: As scary as it was, what I saw there was truly shocking.
scripts.translation: 那地方令人毛骨悚然，我在那里看到的景象也着实令人震惊。

scripts.text: It is only right for an adventurer to record all that was seen, but because it is a politically sensitive material to be revealed, I will leave it at that.
scripts.translation: 冒险者理应记录所见的一切，但这件事涉及政治敏感内容，不便公开，就说到这里吧。

scripts.text: Yes, I was waiting to catch the King Octopus. I guess it was when I was passing by a boat? I met a cat with slanted eyes.
scripts.translation: 没错，我当时在等国王章鱼。大概是经过一艘船时吧？我遇见了一只眯眯眼的猫。

scripts.text: Then he assured me that he could upgrade my +9 Violet Fear to +10 Violet Fear.

scripts.text: Then my +9 Violet Fear shattered into pieces. I was so shocked because it was the only weapon that I had.
scripts.translation: 结果我的+9纳户特基格的双剑碎成了片。我震惊极了，因为那是我唯一的武器。

scripts.text: A hammer that refines the starts in the sky! Doesn't it sound awesome? Since I lost my only weapon, I thought I should strengthen my armors. So I gave her everything I had.
scripts.translation: 能精炼天上的星星！听起来多厉害啊？既然我失去了唯一的武器，就想着至少强化一下防具。于是把身上所有东西都交给了她。

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
No, no! What are you saying...{0}Your prison visits are welcome at any time. I'll do it for you especially if it's for Mr. Clever!
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
不不！你说什么呢...{0}随时欢迎你来探监。尤其是探望聪明鬼先生，我一定帮你安排！

scripts.text: ^000099Yeah, I keep thinking about it. It's probably better not to randomly make up an official record right in front of me.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099嗯，我也是这么想的。最好别当着我的面随便编造官方记录。^000000

scripts.text: Well, I thought my time for the visit was over...
scripts.translation: 我还以为探视时间已经结束了...

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
What! What are you talking about? {0} Is the time for a visitation a problem for you? Here.. I will extend it for 3 hours!
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
